title: When Do Multimodal and Graph-Augmented RAG Help? A Controlled Evaluation for Document Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems commonly operate on text extracted from documents, potentially losing information contained in figures, tables, layout, and relationships distributed across passages. We present an explainable multimodal graph-RAG architecture that augments a text-only baseline with LLM-extracted subject--relation--object triples and CLIP-based retrieval of figures and tables. The three evidence sources are retrieved independently and fused only at generation time, allowing the effects of graph evidence, visual evidence, and generator choice to be evaluated separately. We conduct a controlled four-way ablation on 1,000 PubLayNet pages across single-passage, multi-hop, and figure questions using two closed-weight and two open-weight multimodal generators. We also compare matched caption-answerable and pixel-only figure question sets to distinguish caption recovery from genuine visual question answering. Knowledge-graph augmentation provides no reliable accuracy improvement across generators or question types in this corpus. On pixel-only questions, text-only systems achieve zero accuracy, while multimodal systems reach 0.057--0.114 and are constrained by both image retrieval (Recall@3 = 0.371) and the generators' ability to interpret dense scientific figures and tables. Caption-derived questions substantially overestimate text-only visual question-answering capability. Processing the same image also produces an elevenfold variation in input tokens across generators, showing that image tokenisation can dominate deployment cost. Source code, experiment configurations, and evaluation resources are publicly available at https://github.com/sokistar24/multimodal-graph-rag. These findings show that the value of multimodal and graph augmentation depends on retrieval design, corpus structure, benchmark construction, and generator efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释的多模态图-RAG架构，在文本基线基础上融合LLM提取的知识图谱三元组和CLIP检索的图表证据，并在PubLayNet数据集上进行消融实验。结果表明：知识图谱增强未能稳定提升精度；纯文本系统在纯图像问题上准确率为零，多模态系统仅达0.057–0.114；图像检索召回率（Recall@3=0.371）和生成器解读密集科学图表的能力成为瓶颈；图片描述类问题会高估纯文本的视觉问答能力；不同生成器处理同一图像的输入token差异可达11倍。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统通常仅处理文档中的文本，丢失了图表、布局、表格以及跨段落关系等丰富信息，限制了系统对多模态和复杂关系问题的回答能力。
AI.method: 提出可解释的多模态图-RAG架构，在文本基线之上融合两类额外证据：1) LLM提取的主题-关系-对象知识图谱三元组；2) CLIP模型检索相关图表和表格。三种证据来源独立检索，仅在生成阶段融合，从而可以分别评估图证据、视觉证据和生成器选择的影响。
AI.result: 在PubLayNet 1000页上的四路消融实验表明：知识图谱增强未带来稳定精度提升；纯文本在纯图像问题上准确率为零；多模态系统仅达0.057–0.114，受限于图像检索（Recall@3=0.371）和生成器解读能力；基于图片描述的问题会高估文本视觉问答能力；不同生成器处理同一图像的token数差异达11倍。
AI.conclusion: 多模态和图增强的价值取决于检索设计、语料库结构、基准构建方式和生成器效率，不能简单认为加入多模态或知识图谱信息就必然带来性能提升。
AI.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常处理从文档中提取的文本，从而可能丢失包含在图形、表格、布局以及跨段落分布的关系中的信息。我们提出了一种可解释的多模态图-RAG架构，该架构通过LLM提取的主语-关系-宾语三元组和基于CLIP的图形与表格检索来增强纯文本基线。三种证据来源独立检索，仅在生成阶段融合，从而可以分别评估图证据、视觉证据和生成器选择的影响。我们在1,000页PubLayNet数据上，针对单段落、多跳和图形三类问题，使用两种闭源和两种开源多模态生成器进行了受控的四路消融实验。我们还比较了匹配的基于图片描述和纯像素图形问题集，以区分描述恢复与真正的视觉问答。在该语料库中，知识图谱增强在所有生成器和问题类型上均未提供可靠的准确性提升。在纯像素问题上，纯文本系统的准确率为零，而多模态系统达到0.057–0.114，且受限于图像检索（召回率@3=0.371）以及生成器解读密集科学图形和表格的能力。基于描述的问题显著高估了纯文本的视觉问答能力。处理同一图像时，不同生成器的输入token数存在十一倍差异，表明图像分词可能主导部署成本。源代码、实验配置和评估资源已在https://github.com/sokistar24/multimodal-graph-rag公开。这些发现表明，多模态和图增强的价值取决于检索设计、语料库结构、基准构建方式和生成器效率。

title: A Unified Multisensor Machine-Learning Framework for Live Fuel Moisture Content Retrieval
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to JSTARS and currently under review
summary: Live fuel moisture content controls vegetation flammability and is a high-importance variable in fire management. Nevertheless, it remains difficult to estimate and map over large areas due to the concentration of field observations in specific regions. We develop a unified machine-learning framework that estimates live fuel moisture content from satellite vegetation indices, meteorological variables, topography and seasonal predictors. GlobeLFMC 2.0 measurements are matched to Terra and Aqua MODIS, VIIRS, Landsat 8/9, Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-3 surface-reflectance products, combining the long MODIS record with finer-resolution recent observations. To account for differences among sensors, optical predictors are restricted to a common red, near-infrared and shortwave-infrared feature space; site--product combinations and field time series are screened for remote-sensing suitability; and spectral response function diagnostics are combined with target-independent empirical reflectance calibration toward a Sentinel-2 reference domain. Preliminary single-product experiments show that weather, topography and cyclic day-of-year provide most of the predictive gain beyond vegetation indices, whereas optional product-specific predictors do not justify their additional dependencies. Separate Grass, Shrub and Tree models are trained with Random Forest and XGBoost regressors. Under the primary validation design, which withholds observation dates from sites represented in training, the best models achieve pooled R2 values of 0.715, 0.693 and 0.700 for Grass, Shrub and Tree, respectively. The framework can incorporate additional optical sensors when compatible reflectance bands, documented spectral responses and sufficient overlap observations are available for calibration and validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个统一的机器学习框架GlobeLFMC 2.0，利用多源卫星数据（MODIS、VIIRS、Landsat 8/9、Sentinel-2/3）估算活体燃料含水量，通过光谱特征空间标准化、传感器校准和随机森林/XGBoost回归器，在草地、灌木和树木三类植被上分别达到0.715、0.693和0.700的R²值。
AI.motivation: 活体燃料含水量（LFMC）控制植被可燃性，是火灾管理的关键变量，但野外观测数据集中在特定区域，难以在大范围进行估计和制图。
AI.method: 构建统一机器学习框架，将GlobeLFMC 2.0测量数据与Terra/Aqua MODIS、VIIRS、Landsat 8/9、Sentinel-2/3地表反射率产品匹配；限制光学预测因子为共同的红光、近红外和短波红外特征空间；进行场地-产品组合和场时间序列筛选；结合光谱响应函数诊断和目标无关的经验反射率校准至Sentinel-2参考域；分别训练草地、灌木和树木的随机森林和XGBoost回归器。
AI.result: 在主要验证设计下（保留训练集中已有站点的观测日期），最佳模型在草地、灌木和树木上分别达到0.715、0.693和0.700的R²值；天气、地形和循环年积日提供了超出植被指数的主要预测增益。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可扩展至其他光学传感器，只要具备兼容的反射率波段、有记录的光谱响应函数和足够的重叠观测数据用于校准和验证；可选的产品特定预测因子不值得额外的依赖成本。
AI.abstract_zh: 活体燃料含水量控制着植被的可燃性，是火灾管理中一个高度重要的变量。然而，由于野外观测集中在特定区域，在大范围估计和制图仍然困难。我们开发了一个统一的机器学习框架，利用卫星植被指数、气象变量、地形和季节预测因子来估算活体燃料含水量。GlobeLFMC 2.0测量数据与Terra和Aqua MODIS、VIIRS、Landsat 8/9、Sentinel-2和Sentinel-3地表反射率产品进行匹配，将长期的MODIS记录与更高分辨率的近期观测相结合。为考虑不同传感器之间的差异，光学预测因子被限制在共同的红光、近红外和短波红外特征空间；对场地-产品组合和现场时间序列进行遥感适用性筛选；并将光谱响应函数诊断与目标无关的经验反射率校准相结合，统一到Sentinel-2参考域。初步的单产品实验表明，天气、地形和循环年积日提供了超出植被指数的主要预测增益，而可选的产品特定预测因子并不值得其额外的依赖成本。分别使用随机森林和XGBoost回归器训练了草地、灌木和树木模型。在主要的验证设计下（保留训练集中已有站点的观测日期），最佳模型在草地、灌木和树木上分别实现了0.715、0.693和0.700的聚合R²值。该框架可以纳入其他光学传感器，只要具备兼容的反射率波段、有记录的光谱响应函数和足够的重叠观测数据用于校准和验证。

title: Luminosity-Adaptive Contrast Enhancement Using CLAHE for Retinal Fundus Images with Quantitative Validation and Comparative Analysis
summary: Background: Retinal fundus imaging is central to the early diagnosis of sight-threatening conditions including diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and retinal vein occlusion. Clinical utility of fundus images is routinely compromised by non-uniform illumination, motion blur, and low contrast - artefacts that increase the risk of diagnostic error. Effective image enhancement is therefore a prerequisite for reliable computer-aided ophthalmic diagnosis. Methods: This study proposes a two-stage image enhancement pipeline combining luminosity correction via HSV colour space decomposition with Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) applied exclusively to the Value (V) channel. Experiments are conducted on the publicly available DRIVE dataset (40 retinal fundus images, 584 x 565 pixels, Canon CR5 camera, ophthalmologist-annotated ground truth). Quantitative evaluation employs Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), and Contrast-to-Noise Ratio (CNR). Baseline comparisons include standard Histogram Equalization (HE) and Adaptive Histogram Equalization (AHE). A binary masking step is subsequently applied to isolate hyper-reflective regions consistent with vascular pathology. Results: The proposed method achieves PSNR = 29.3 dB, SSIM = 0.91, and CNR = 3.12 - outperforming HE (PSNR = 21.4 dB, SSIM = 0.74) and AHE (PSNR = 23.1 dB, SSIM = 0.79) across all metrics, with an average processing time of 0.14 seconds per image. Conclusions: The combined luminosity-CLAHE pipeline yields measurably superior contrast and structural fidelity compared to established baseline methods, with processing speed compatible with clinical screening workflows. Limitations and directions for deep-learning-based comparison are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合HSV色彩空间亮度校正和CLAHE（仅应用于V通道）的两阶段眼底图像增强流水线，在DRIVE数据集上优于HE和AHE基线方法，PSNR达到29.3 dB，SSIM达到0.91，处理速度为每张0.14秒。
AI.motivation: 眼底图像常因光照不均、运动模糊和低对比度而影响临床诊断可靠性，因此有效的图像增强是实现可靠计算机辅助眼科诊断的前提。
AI.method: 两阶段增强流水线：第一阶段通过HSV色彩空间分解进行亮度校正；第二阶段仅在Value（V）通道上应用对比度受限自适应直方图均衡化（CLAHE）。随后使用二值掩膜步骤分离与血管病理一致的高反射区域。
AI.result: 该方法PSNR=29.3 dB、SSIM=0.91、CNR=3.12，优于HE（PSNR=21.4 dB, SSIM=0.74）和AHE（PSNR=23.1 dB, SSIM=0.79），平均处理时间为每张0.14秒。
AI.conclusion: 亮度校正-CLAHE联合流水线在对比度和结构保真度上显著优于基线方法，处理速度满足临床筛查工作流程要求，并讨论了局限性及未来基于深度学习的对比方向。
AI.abstract_zh: 背景：视网膜眼底成像是早期诊断糖尿病视网膜病变、青光眼和视网膜静脉阻塞等致盲性疾病的核心手段。眼底图像的临床实用性常受光照不均、运动模糊和低对比度的影响——这些伪影会增加诊断错误的风险。因此，有效的图像增强是实现可靠计算机辅助眼科诊断的前提。方法：本研究提出了一种两阶段图像增强流水线，结合了通过HSV色彩空间分解实现的亮度校正与仅应用于Value（V）通道的对比度受限自适应直方图均衡化（CLAHE）。实验在公开的DRIVE数据集（40张视网膜眼底图像，584×565像素，Canon CR5相机，眼科医生标注的金标准）上进行。定量评估采用峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性指数（SSIM）和对比度噪声比（CNR）。基线对比包括标准直方图均衡化（HE）和自适应直方图均衡化（AHE）。随后应用二值掩膜步骤以分离与血管病理一致的高反射区域。结果：该方法达到PSNR=29.3 dB、SSIM=0.91、CNR=3.12，在所有指标上均优于HE（PSNR=21.4 dB、SSIM=0.74）和AHE（PSNR=23.1 dB、SSIM=0.79），每张图像平均处理时间为0.14秒。结论：与已建立的基线方法相比，亮度校正-CLAHE联合流水线在对比度和结构保真度方面具有可测量的优越性，处理速度满足临床筛查工作流程的要求。文中讨论了局限性及未来基于深度学习的比较方向。

title: ECG-LLM: Foundation Model for ECG-Based Cardiac Reasoning
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) is an inexpensive, standard-of-care test for cardiac symptoms, but front-line triage often lacks immediate access to definitive imaging such as echocardiography (ECHO) or cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR). Furthermore, most existing ECGAI systems are limited to fixed diagnostic labels or automated reports, constraining their use for patient-specific clinical reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce ECG-LLM, an ECG-conditioned large language model trained across four cohorts comprising 679,112 ECG studies from 186,409 patients. Using a novel multimodal-to-language supervision strategy, ECG-LLM is trained on clinically structured question-answer pairs derived from ECG signals, clinical context, CMR, and ECHO. This unified approach enables the model to answer diverse cardiovascular questions from a 12-lead ECG alone, spanning both conventional interpretation and phenotypes not directly visible on standard ECGs. ECG-LLM successfully recovers conventional ECG measurements, such as heart rate, and strongly predicts complex CMR-derived phenotypes, including ventricular and atrial volumes and ventricular function. Crucially, it detects vital echocardiographic phenotypes, including increased LV wall thickness, aortic stenosis, and right-ventricular systolic dysfunction. On standard ECG understanding tasks, ECG-LLM matches or exceeds existing baselines for diagnostic report generation and the ECG-QA benchmark. By moving beyond fixed-label prediction, this multimodal framework provides clinically valuable, question-driven cardiovascular reasoning to support general practitioner and front-line triage decisions when specialist review is delayed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECG-LLM，一种基于心电图(ECG)条件的大语言模型，通过在四个队列、679,112份ECG研究数据上训练，采用多模态到语言的监督策略，能够从12导联ECG中回答多种心血管临床问题，包括常规解读和通常无法直接看到的表型，在多个任务上达到或超越现有基线水平。
AI.motivation: 传统ECG分析系统局限于固定诊断标签或自动报告，无法支持针对特定患者的临床推理；同时前线分诊往往无法立即获得超声心动图或心脏磁共振等确切成像手段。因此需要一种能从ECG信号中挖掘更多临床信息、支持问答式推理的智能系统。
AI.method: 构建ECG-LLM，采用多模态到语言（multimodal-to-language）监督策略，在包含ECG信号、临床背景、心脏磁共振(CMR)和超声心动图(ECHO)数据的四个队列上进行训练，生成临床结构化问答对，使模型能基于12导联ECG回答多样化心血管问题。
AI.result: ECG-LLM成功恢复常规ECG测量指标（如心率），强预测复杂CMR衍生表型（心室/心房容积、心室功能），检测关键ECHO表型（LV壁增厚、主动脉瓣狭窄、右室收缩功能不全）。在标准ECG理解任务上，诊断报告生成和ECG-QA基准测试达到或超越现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态框架超越了固定标签预测的限制，提供临床有价值的、问题驱动的心血管推理能力，在专科医生审阅延迟的情况下支持全科医生和前线分诊决策。
AI.abstract_zh: 心电图（ECG）是一种用于心脏症状评估的经济实惠的标准护理检查，但前线分诊往往缺乏立即获取超声心动图（ECHO）或心脏磁共振（CMR）等确定性影像检查的途径。此外，现有的大多数ECG人工智能系统局限于固定的诊断标签或自动报告，限制了其在针对特定患者的临床推理中的应用。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了ECG-LLM，一种以ECG为条件的大语言模型，该模型在四个队列、涵盖186,409名患者的679,112份ECG研究数据上进行了训练。通过一种新颖的多模态到语言监督策略，ECG-LLM基于从ECG信号、临床背景、CMR和ECHO中衍生的临床结构化问答对进行训练。这种统一的方法使模型能够仅凭12导联ECG回答多样化的心血管问题，涵盖常规解读和标准ECG上无法直接观察到的表型。ECG-LLM成功恢复了常规ECG测量指标（如心率），并强有力地预测了复杂的CMR衍生表型，包括心室和心房容积以及心室功能。至关重要的是，它检测到了关键的超声心动图表型，包括左室壁增厚、主动脉瓣狭窄和右室收缩功能不全。在标准ECG理解任务上，ECG-LLM在诊断报告生成和ECG-QA基准测试中达到或超越了现有基线。通过超越固定标签预测，这种多模态框架提供了临床有价值的、问题驱动的心血管推理能力，在专科医生审阅延迟的情况下支持全科医生和前线分诊决策。

title: Emergent topological structure in spontaneous brain-organoid activity
summary: Neural activity is widely held to organize on low-dimensional structure embedded in a high-dimensional state space. Persistent homology reads such structure directly from the pattern of pairwise correlations, without assuming in advance which variables are relevant. We apply persistent homology to microelectrode-array (MEA) recordings of spontaneous activity from human (Lancaster) and mouse (Paşca) cortical organoids, spanning $26$--$234$ simultaneously sorted units, and ask whether topological data analysis resolves structure at the node counts that neural recordings actually deliver. Building weighted networks in correlation space and characterizing them by Vietoris--Rips filtration, we find that the first homology ($H_1$, loops) rises significantly above a rate- and population-preserving null in $14$ of $18$ datasets. This loop structure occupies a non-redundant core: it is robust to random removal of units yet disrupted by targeted removal of the units that carry it. Topological richness grows with network size, and second homology ($H_2$) emerges significantly above the null only in the larger networks. These results show that persistent homology resolves structured topology in neural recordings at the scale experiments actually deliver.

AI.tldr: 该论文应用持续同调（persistent homology）分析人类和小鼠皮质类器官的微电极阵列记录，发现第一同调（H₁，环路结构）在18个数据集中有14个显著高于随机基线，且该结构构成非冗余核心；拓扑丰富度随网络规模增长，第二同调（H₂）仅在较大网络中显著出现。结果表明持续同调可在实验实际交付的神经记录规模上解析出结构化拓扑。
AI.motivation: 神经活动被认为组织在嵌入高维状态空间的低维结构上，但现有方法通常需要预先假设相关变量。本文旨在探究持续同调这种无假设的拓扑数据分析方法，是否能在神经记录实际提供的节点数量（数十到数百个单元）上解析出有意义的结构。
AI.method: 对来自人类（Lancaster）和小鼠（Paşca）皮质类器官的MEA自发活动记录（26-234个同步分选单元）应用持续同调。在相关空间中构建加权网络，通过Vietoris-Rips过滤进行特征化，并用速率和群体保留的零模型进行显著性检验。
AI.result: 1）第一同调（H₁，环路结构）在18个数据集中14个显著高于零模型；2）环路结构构成非冗余核心——对随机移除单元具有鲁棒性，但定向移除承载该结构的单元会破坏它；3）拓扑丰富度随网络规模增长；4）第二同调（H₂）仅在较大网络中显著出现。
AI.conclusion: 持续同调能够在实验实际交付的神经记录规模上解析出结构化拓扑，表明该方法适用于真实的神经生理数据分析。
AI.abstract_zh: 神经活动被广泛认为组织在嵌入高维状态空间的低维结构上。持续同调无需预先假设哪些变量相关，即可直接从成对相关模式中解读此类结构。我们将持续同调应用于来自人类（Lancaster）和小鼠（Paşca）皮质类器官的微电极阵列（MEA）自发活动记录，涵盖26–234个同步分选单元，探究拓扑数据分析是否能在神经记录实际交付的节点数量上解析出结构。在相关空间中构建加权网络，并通过Vietoris–Rips过滤对其进行特征化，我们发现：在18个数据集中，有14个数据集的第一同调（H₁，环路）显著高于速率和群体保留的零模型。此环路结构构成一个非冗余核心——它对随机移除单元具有鲁棒性，但定向移除承载该结构的单元会使其瓦解。拓扑丰富度随网络规模增长，第二同调（H₂）仅在较大网络中显著高于零模型。这些结果表明，持续同调能够在实验实际交付的规模上解析出神经记录中的结构化拓扑。

title: Overcoming the BCI Calibration Bottleneck: A Clinically-Grounded Architecture using Riemannian Alignment and Stochastic Weight Averaging
summary: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) face a severe calibration bottleneck due to cross-subject spatial covariance shifts and physiological artifacts. To enable zero-calibration BCI, a deep learning pipeline was engineered combining Per-Session Independent Component Analysis, Riemannian Euclidean Alignment, and EEGNet stabilized by Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA). Evaluated on the strict MOABB BNCI2014-001 benchmark, the proposed architecture successfully isolates true sensorimotor rhythms. For the primary case study (Subject 1), a clinically robust SWA stable accuracy of 90.97% (AUC: 0.976, Cohen's $κ$: 0.819) was achieved. Furthermore, expanded 9-fold Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) cross-validation yielded a globally stable mean accuracy of 74.31%, proving hardware-agnostic zero-shot efficacy for binary motor imagery.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合Per-Session ICA、黎曼欧几里得对齐和SWA稳定EEGNet的深度学习流水线，在MOABB BNCI2014-001基准上实现无校准脑机接口，LOSO交叉验证平均准确率达74.31%。
AI.motivation: 解决脑机接口因跨被试空间协方差偏移和生理伪影导致的严重校准瓶颈，实现零校准BCI。
AI.method: 结合逐会话独立成分分析（Per-Session ICA）、黎曼欧几里得对齐（Riemannian Euclidean Alignment）以及经随机权重平均（SWA）稳定的EEGNet深度学习流水线。
AI.result: 受试者1的SWA稳定准确率为90.97%（AUC: 0.976, Cohen's κ: 0.819）；9折留一被试交叉验证平均准确率为74.31%，证明了硬件无关的零样本效能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的流水线能够有效隔离真实感觉运动节律，实现无需校准的跨被试运动想象分类，具有临床鲁棒性和硬件无关性。
AI.abstract_zh: 脑机接口面临严重的校准瓶颈，原因在于跨被试的空间协方差偏移和生理伪影。为了实现零校准脑机接口，我们设计了一种深度学习流水线，结合了逐会话独立成分分析、黎曼欧几里得对齐以及经随机权重平均稳定的EEGNet。在严格的MOABB BNCI2014-001基准上进行评估，所提出的架构成功隔离了真实的感觉运动节律。在主要案例研究（受试者1）中，实现了临床鲁棒的SWA稳定准确率90.97%（AUC: 0.976, Cohen's κ: 0.819）。此外，扩展的9折留一被试交叉验证获得了全局稳定的平均准确率74.31%，证明了针对二分类运动想象任务的硬件无关零样本效能。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided NSGA-II Enhanced with Gray Relational Coefficient for Multi-Objective Optimization: Application to NASDAQ Portfolio Optimization
summary: In modern financial markets, decision-makers increasingly rely on quantitative methods to navigate complex trade-offs among multiple, often conflicting objectives. This paper addresses constrained multi-objective optimization (MOO) with an application to portfolio optimization for minimizing risk and maximizing return. To address existing gaps, we propose a novel reinforcement learning (RL)-guided non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) enhanced with gray relational coefficients (GRC), termed RL-NSGA-II-GRC, which combines an RL agent controller and GRC-based selection to improve convergence and diversity of Pareto fronts. The agent adapts evolutionary parameters online using metrics of hypervolume, feasibility, and diversity, while the GRC tournament operator ranks parents via a unified score considering dominance rank, crowding distance, and proximity to ideal reference. We evaluate the framework on the Kursawe and CONSTR benchmarks and a NASDAQ portfolio application. On the benchmarks, RL-NSGA-II-GRC achieves convergence improvements of about 5.8% and 4.4% over NSGA-II, while preserving well-distributed non-dominated solutions. In the portfolio application, it produces a smooth, densely populated efficient frontier supporting identification of the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio (annualized Sharpe =1.92) and utility-optimal portfolios for different risk-aversion levels. The main contributions are three-fold: 1) we propose an RL-NSGA-II-GRC method integrating an RL agent into the evolutionary framework to adaptively control parameters via generational feedback; 2) we design a GRC-enhanced binary tournament operator providing a comprehensive indicator to guide the search toward the Pareto front; 3) we demonstrate, on benchmark MOO and a NASDAQ case study, that the method delivers improved convergence and well-populated frontiers supporting actionable insights.

AI.tldr: 提出一种强化学习引导的NSGA-II算法（RL-NSGA-II-GRC），通过RL智能体在线自适应进化参数并引入灰色关联度锦标赛选择算子，在约束多目标优化中提升Pareto前沿的收敛性和多样性，在基准测试和纳斯达克投资组合应用中表现优于传统NSGA-II。
AI.motivation: 现有约束多目标优化方法（如NSGA-II）在处理复杂金融决策中多冲突目标（如风险最小化与收益最大化）时，存在收敛性不足和Pareto前沿多样性不够的问题，亟需一种能自适应调节进化参数并更好平衡收敛性与多样性的方法。
AI.method: 提出RL-NSGA-II-GRC框架：1）集成强化学习智能体，利用超体积、可行性和多样性等指标在线自适应调整进化参数；2）设计基于灰色关联度（GRC）的锦标赛选择算子，综合考虑支配等级、拥挤距离和与理想参考点的接近度，生成统一评分对父代进行排序。
AI.result: 在Kursawe和CONSTR基准测试上，相比NSGA-II收敛性分别提升约5.8%和4.4%，同时保持均匀分布的非支配解。在纳斯达克投资组合应用中，生成平滑密集的高效前沿，最大夏普比组合年化夏普比为1.92，并支持不同风险厌恶水平下的效用最优组合选择。
AI.conclusion: RL-NSGA-II-GRC通过将RL智能体集成到进化框架中实现进化参数自适应调节，结合GRC锦标赛选择算子提供综合指标引导搜索，在基准测试和实际金融案例中均验证了其在收敛性和前沿分布密度上的优越性，能为投资决策提供可操作洞见。
AI.abstract_zh: 在现代金融市场中，决策者日益依赖量化方法来应对多个往往相互冲突的目标之间复杂的权衡。本文研究约束多目标优化（MOO）问题，并将其应用于最小化风险与最大化收益的投资组合优化。为弥补现有方法的不足，我们提出一种新颖的强化学习（RL）引导的非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II），并集成灰色关联度（GRC）增强，称为RL-NSGA-II-GRC。该方法将RL智能体控制器与基于GRC的选择机制相结合，以改善Pareto前沿的收敛性和多样性。该智能体利用超体积、可行性和多样性等指标在线自适应调整进化参数，而GRC锦标赛算子则通过考虑支配等级、拥挤距离以及与理想参考点的接近度生成统一评分来对父代进行排序。我们在Kursawe和CONSTR基准测试以及一个纳斯达克投资组合应用中对该框架进行了评估。在基准测试上，RL-NSGA-II-GRC相比NSGA-II的收敛性提升了约5.8%和4.4%，同时保持了分布良好的非支配解。在投资组合应用中，该方法生成了平滑且密集的高效前沿，支持识别最大夏普比投资组合（年化夏普比=1.92）以及不同风险厌恶水平下的效用最优投资组合。本文的主要贡献有三点：1）提出RL-NSGA-II-GRC方法，将RL智能体集成到进化框架中，通过代际反馈自适应控制参数；2）设计GRC增强的二元锦标赛算子，提供综合指标引导搜索朝向Pareto前沿；3）在基准MOO测试和纳斯达克案例研究中验证了该方法在收敛性和前沿密度方面的改进，能够提供可操作的洞见。

title: What Makes Linguistic Representations Good Models of High-Level Visual Perception in the Human Brain?
comment: Supplementary Materials in the public GitHub repository referenced in the paper
summary: Image descriptions represented with language models (LMs) predict human brain responses to naturalistic images in high-level visual regions, but the factors driving this predictivity remain unclear. To investigate this, we systematically studied how images are described and which language models are used to embed those descriptions. For a common set of images, we considered six caption types -- including human-annotated and multiple machine-generated captions -- differing along several dimensions. Each caption was represented with five LMs, spanning autoregressive LMs trained to predict upcoming words and text embedders, i.e., LMs fine-tuned on semantic tasks requiring sentence/document-level representations. Machine-generated captions yielded significant brain predictivity and alignment, often surpassing human-annotated captions used in previous work. Across caption types, text embedders consistently outperformed autoregressive LMs, a pattern replicated when measuring behavioural alignment with image-similarity judgments. Analyses of caption representations from different model layers further revealed that both brain predictivity and behavioural alignment peak at intermediate network depth, shortly after a point thought to mark the emergence of syntactic and semantic structure. Altogether, our results demonstrate that both the content of image captions and the LM used to represent them influence brain- and behaviour-modelling performance, establishing caption embeddings as a useful tool for studying high-level visual perception.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了图像描述（人工标注 vs 机器生成）及不同语言模型（自回归LM vs 文本嵌入模型）如何预测大脑对自然图像的高层视觉响应，发现机器生成的描述和文本嵌入模型效果更优，且在模型中层表征达到最佳预测与行为对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已知语言模型生成的图像描述能预测大脑对自然图像的高层视觉响应，但驱动这种预测能力的因素尚不清楚，因此需要系统探究描述内容与语言模型类型的影响。
AI.method: 对同一组图像，使用6种不同描述类型（人工标注与多种机器生成）和5种语言模型（自回归LM与文本嵌入模型）进行表征，比较不同描述-模型组合对脑响应预测和行为对齐（图像相似性判断）的效果，并分析模型不同层的表征性能。
AI.result: 机器生成的描述在脑预测和行为对齐上常优于人工标注的描述；文本嵌入模型整体优于自回归LM；脑预测与行为对齐均在模型中间层达到峰值，该深度大致对应于句法和语义结构涌现的阶段。
AI.conclusion: 图像描述的内容和用于表征描述的语言模型共同影响脑预测和行为建模性能，描述嵌入可成为研究高层视觉感知的有效工具。
AI.abstract_zh: 使用语言模型（LM）表示的图像描述能够预测大脑对自然图像的高层视觉响应，但驱动这种预测能力的因素仍不清楚。为探究这一问题，我们系统研究了图像如何被描述以及使用何种语言模型来嵌入这些描述。针对一组公共图像，我们考虑了六种描述类型——包括人工标注和多种机器生成的描述——它们沿不同维度有所差异。每种描述由五种LM表示，涵盖自回归LM（训练用于预测后续词）和文本嵌入模型（即在下游语义任务上微调的LM，需要句子/文档级别的表征）。机器生成的描述产生了显著的脑预测和对齐效果，通常优于以往研究中采用的人工标注描述。在各种描述类型中，文本嵌入模型一致优于自回归LM，这一模式在行为对齐（图像相似性判断）的测量中也得到复现。对不同模型层描述表征的分析进一步揭示，脑预测和行为对齐均在网络中间深度达到峰值，大致位于句法和语义结构涌现的节点之后。综上，我们的结果表明，图像描述的内容和用于表征描述的语言模型都会影响脑与行为建模的性能，从而确立了描述嵌入作为研究高层视觉感知的有效工具。

title: The Positive Experience Principle: Forecasting Conscious Choices with AI Embeddings
summary: A fundamental challenge in the science of consciousness is the lack of a universal, predictive framework for motivated behavior. While existing theories excel at describing specific mechanisms, from neural pathways to computational models, they do not provide a foundational principle that explains the consistent direction of conscious systems toward certain states and away from others. To address this gap, we propose the Positive Experience Principle (PEP), a unifying principle stating that conscious systems have an inherent tendency to move toward states of higher positive subjective experience. This tendency is quantified by a Positive Experience Value (PEV), a scalar metric derived from the physical configurations defined by our earlier Universal Consciousness Code (UCC) theory. The PEP bridges physics, neuroscience, and psychology by positing that diverse behaviors are manifestations of a single, fundamental drive to optimize PEV. The PEP generates testable predictions for the dynamics of conscious systems, offering a path toward a unified science of behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正向体验原则（PEP），认为意识系统具有内在倾向，趋向更高正向主观体验的状态，并通过正向体验值（PEV）量化这一趋势，旨在统一解释意识系统中的动机行为。
AI.motivation: 当前意识科学缺乏一个普适且可预测的框架来解释动机行为，现有理论局限于描述特定机制（如神经通路或计算模型），未能提供一个基础性原理来解释意识系统为何一致地趋向某些状态而远离其他状态。
AI.method: 提出正向体验原则（PEP），并引入正向体验值（PEV）作为标量度量，该度量基于先前提出的普适意识编码（UCC）理论中的物理构型推导得出。
AI.result: PEP能够桥接物理学、神经科学和心理学，将多样化的行为统一解释为优化PEV这一单一基本驱力的表现，并生成关于意识系统动力学的可检验预测。
AI.conclusion: PEP为建立统一的行为科学提供了一条可行路径，有望弥合意识科学中不同学科之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.abstract_zh: 意识科学中的一个根本性挑战是缺乏一个普适且具有预测性的动机行为框架。尽管现有理论在描述从神经通路到计算模型等具体机制方面表现出色，但它们未能提供一个基础性原理来解释意识系统为何一致地趋向某些状态而远离其他状态。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了正向体验原则（PEP），该统一原则指出，意识系统具有一种内在倾向，趋向于更高正向主观体验的状态。这一倾向通过正向体验值（PEV）进行量化，PEV是一个从我们先前提出的普适意识编码（UCC）理论所定义的物理构型中推导出的标量度量。PEP通过假设多样化的行为是优化PEV这一单一基本驱力的表现，桥接了物理学、神经科学和心理学。PEP生成了关于意识系统动力学的可检验预测，为建立统一的行为科学提供了一条可行路径。

title: From Intent to Infrastructure: LLM-Driven Agent Compilers for ISAC Networks
summary: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) is moving from proof-of-concept demonstrations to system-level deployment in sixth-generation (6G) networks. Because sensing and communication share hardware, spectrum, and waveform resources, ISAC design now involves many tightly coupled choices, including waveform selection, sensing algorithm setup, resource scheduling, and deployment planning. This design space is already too large to manage well through manual tuning or isolated optimizers. This article introduces the \textit{Agent Compiler}, a large language model (LLM)-enabled compilation layer that translates high-level engineering intent into complete and executable ISAC system configurations. The Agent Compiler works in four stages: intent parsing, task decomposition, policy graph synthesis, and infrastructure mapping. It produces a verifiable intermediate representation called the ISAC Policy Graph (IPG). A runtime engine then deploys the compiled configuration and supports closed-loop adaptation at three levels: fast parameter updates, partial recompilation of affected subgraphs, and full workflow recompilation. The core design principle is strict time-scale separation: the LLM handles slow-loop strategic decisions, while proven algorithms retain real-time control in the fast loop. A UAV-assisted disaster rescue example illustrates the full compilation process. We also discuss open issues, including compilation latency, output reliability, constraint verification, and pipeline security, to guide future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Compiler，一种基于大语言模型的编译层，用于将高层工程意图转化为可执行的ISAC系统配置，通过四阶段编译和三层闭环适应机制解决6G通感一体化设计的复杂性。
AI.motivation: 通感一体化（ISAC）从概念验证走向6G系统级部署时，由于感知与通信共享硬件、频谱和波形资源，设计空间包含波形选择、感知算法、资源调度和部署规划等高度耦合的决策，手动调优或孤立优化器已无法有效管理如此庞大的设计空间。
AI.method: 提出Agent Compiler，包含四个阶段：意图解析、任务分解、策略图合成和基础设施映射，生成可验证的中间表示ISAC策略图（IPG）；运行时引擎支持三级闭环适应：快速参数更新、局部子图重编译和全工作流重编译。核心设计原则是严格的时间尺度分离：LLM处理慢环战略决策，成熟算法保留快环实时控制。
AI.result: 通过无人机辅助灾难救援案例展示了完整的编译流程，并讨论了编译延迟、输出可靠性、约束验证和流水线安全等开放问题以指导未来研究。
AI.conclusion: Agent Compiler通过LLM赋能的编译层实现了ISAC系统配置的自动化生成与自适应调整，为6G网络中通感一体化系统的实际部署提供了一种新的方法论框架。
AI.abstract_zh: 通感一体化（ISAC）正从概念验证演示迈向第六代（6G）网络的系统级部署。由于感知与通信共享硬件、频谱和波形资源，ISAC设计现在涉及许多紧密耦合的选择，包括波形选择、感知算法设置、资源调度和部署规划。这一设计空间已过于庞大，无法通过手动调优或孤立优化器进行有效管理。本文介绍Agent Compiler，一种由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编译层，能将高层工程意图转化为完整且可执行的ISAC系统配置。Agent Compiler通过四个阶段工作：意图解析、任务分解、策略图合成和基础设施映射。它生成一种可验证的中间表示，称为ISAC策略图（IPG）。运行时引擎随后部署编译后的配置，并在三个层次上支持闭环适应：快速参数更新、受影响子图的局部重编译以及全工作流重编译。核心设计原则是严格的时间尺度分离：LLM处理慢环中的战略决策，而经过验证的算法在快环中保留实时控制。一个无人机辅助灾难救援示例展示了完整的编译流程。我们还讨论了编译延迟、输出可靠性、约束验证和流水线安全等开放问题，以指导未来研究。

title: DocOCR-Eval: A Correction-Based Framework for OCR Tool Selection Without Ground Truth
summary: Document parsing is a foundational step for document understanding tasks such as visual question answering and key information extraction, as it transforms unstructured scanned images into structured representations by extracting textual, visual, and layout information. While numerous Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engines and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been developed for this purpose, selecting an appropriate document parsing solution for a given document collection remains challenging, particularly in label-scarce settings. In this work, we conduct a systematic evaluation of text recognition performance across a diverse set of OCR engines and state-of-the-art MLLMs on multiple scanned document benchmarks spanning different domains and languages. Motivated by the limited contextual reasoning capabilities of many OCR engines and the high cost of manual annotations, we propose DocOCR-Eval, an annotation-free evaluation framework for automatic OCR assessment and selection. DocOCR-Eval employs a three-staged correction and ranking strategy to approximate annotation-based tool ordering without ground-truth labels. We show that aggregating across multiple MLLMs progressively improves alignment with annotation-based rankings. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that reliable OCR tool selection can be achieved in realistic, label-limited settings, providing practical guidance for deploying document parsing systems across diverse real-world document collections.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多种OCR引擎和MLLM在扫描文档解析中的文本识别性能，并提出了一种免标注的评估框架DocOCR-Eval，通过三阶段校正与排序策略在无标签情况下近似实现基于标注的工具排序，实验证明该方法在标注稀缺的实际场景中能够可靠地选择OCR工具。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR引擎和MLLM种类繁多，但在标签稀缺的场景下，如何为给定的文档集合选择最合适的文档解析方案仍然是一个挑战。
AI.method: 提出DocOCR-Eval，一个免标注的自动OCR评估与选择框架，采用三阶段校正与排序策略，通过聚合多个MLLM的输出来逐步逼近基于真实标签的工具排序结果。
AI.result: 实验表明，聚合多个MLLM可以逐步提升与基于标注的排序的一致性；在标注稀缺的实际场景下，能够实现可靠的OCR工具选择。
AI.conclusion: DocOCR-Eval能够在无标注情况下有效评估和选择OCR工具，为文档解析系统的实际部署提供了实用指导。
AI.abstract_zh: 文档解析是视觉问答和关键信息提取等文档理解任务的基础步骤，它通过提取文本、视觉和布局信息，将非结构化的扫描图像转化为结构化表示。尽管为此已开发了大量光学字符识别（OCR）引擎和多模态大语言模型（MLLM），但在给定文档集合中选择合适的文档解析方案仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在标签稀缺的场景下。本文对多种OCR引擎和当前最先进的MLLM在不同领域和语言的多个扫描文档基准上的文本识别性能进行了系统评估。考虑到许多OCR引擎在上下文推理能力上的局限性以及人工标注的高昂成本，我们提出了DocOCR-Eval——一个免标注的自动OCR评估与选择框架。DocOCR-Eval采用三阶段校正与排序策略，在无真实标签的情况下近似实现基于标注的工具排序。我们发现，聚合多个MLLM的输出能够逐步提升与基于标注的排序之间的一致性。大量实验进一步表明，在标注稀缺的实际场景中可以实现可靠的OCR工具选择，为不同真实世界文档集合中文档解析系统的部署提供了实用指导。

title: ForensicNet: Lightweight Attention-Enhanced MobileNetV2 for Automated Face Identification
summary: In forensic environments, automated identification of perpetrators is difficult due to pose changes, changes in light, occlusion, and lack of labeled data. This paper presents ForensicNet, a lightweight deep learning framework for forensic face recognition that enhances attention. The suggested model combines the MobileNetV2 backbone with Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM) to improve the learning of discriminative features while maintaining computational speed. A two-phase transfer learning strategy with adaptive layer unfreezing is used to improve domain adaptation and reduce overfitting. This study used publicly available datasets such as LFW and SCFace, with 15,000 facial images spanning 68 identity classes. The proposed model outperforms baseline architectures such as AlexNet, ResNet-50, and MobileNetV2, with an accuracy of 92.4%, a precision of 90.8%, and a recall of 89.5%. Additionally, the framework requires only 2.1 GFLOPs per inference, and hence can be used in real-time forensic surveillance applications.

AI.tldr: 提出ForensicNet轻量级深度学习框架，融合MobileNetV2骨干网络与CBAM注意力模块，结合两阶段自适应迁移学习策略，在法医人脸识别任务中以2.1 GFLOPs的低计算量实现92.4%的准确率，适用于实时法医监控场景。
AI.motivation: 法医环境下的人脸识别面临姿态变化、光照变化、遮挡以及缺乏标注数据等挑战，现有方法难以兼顾高精度与计算效率，因此需要一种轻量级且高精度的模型用于实时法医监控。
AI.method: 以MobileNetV2为骨干网络，结合卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）增强判别性特征的学习；采用两阶段迁移学习策略，并引入自适应层解冻技术以提升域适应能力并减少过拟合。
AI.result: 在包含15,000张人脸图像（68个身份类别）的LFW和SCFace数据集上，模型达到92.4%准确率、90.8%精确率、89.5%召回率，每推理仅需2.1 GFLOPs，优于AlexNet、ResNet-50和MobileNetV2等基线模型。
AI.conclusion: ForensicNet在保持轻量化和实时推理能力的同时，显著提升了法医人脸识别的准确性和鲁棒性，适合部署于实时法医监控应用。
AI.abstract_zh: 在法医环境中，由于姿态变化、光照变化、遮挡以及缺乏标注数据，自动识别罪犯具有较大难度。本文提出ForensicNet——一种轻量级、增强注意力的法医人脸识别深度学习框架。该模型将MobileNetV2骨干网络与卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）相结合，在保持计算速度的同时提升判别性特征的学习能力。采用两阶段迁移学习策略并引入自适应层解冻技术，以改善域适应能力并减少过拟合。本研究使用了LFW和SCFace等公开数据集，共包含15,000张人脸图像，涵盖68个身份类别。所提模型在准确率（92.4%）、精确率（90.8%）和召回率（89.5%）上均优于AlexNet、ResNet-50和MobileNetV2等基线架构。此外，该框架每次推理仅需2.1 GFLOPs，因此可应用于实时法医监控场景。

title: Exploring Brain Networks Using Noninvasive Electrophysiological Measurements: Methods and Applications
comment: Book chapter manuscript including 6 figures and comprehensive references
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide noninvasive measurements of brain activity with millisecond temporal resolution, enabling the investigation of functional and effective interactions within large-scale brain networks. This chapter presents a comprehensive overview of the methodological foundations and practical workflows for EEG/MEG-based brain network analysis. We first review the physical principles underlying EEG and MEG, emphasizing their complementary strengths and limitations. We then describe the forward and inverse problems, including subject-specific head modeling, source reconstruction techniques, and the importance of accurate anatomical modeling for reliable source localization. Strategies for mitigating volume conduction and signal leakage are discussed, together with best practices for source-space connectivity analysis. The chapter reviews widely used functional and effective connectivity measures, including coherence, phase synchronization metrics, amplitude envelope correlation, Granger causality, dynamic causal modeling, and transfer entropy, highlighting their assumptions, advantages, and limitations. Modern end-to-end analysis pipelines are presented, with particular emphasis on Brainstorm and complementary open-source software for reproducible EEG/MEG research. Finally, we discuss emerging approaches, including time-varying connectivity, cross-frequency interactions, and network-based analyses, illustrating how noninvasive electrophysiology contributes to understanding brain organization in health and disease. The chapter provides both conceptual foundations and practical guidance for researchers and advanced students seeking to map and interpret human brain networks using EEG and MEG.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了基于脑电图（EEG）和脑磁图（MEG）的脑网络分析的方法学基础与实用工作流程，涵盖从物理原理、源重建、连接性度量到新兴分析方法的完整技术栈，为非侵入性电生理脑网络研究提供了概念框架和实践指南。
AI.motivation: 为研究者和高级学生提供EEG/MEG脑网络分析的系统性方法论指导，弥合从基础物理原理到高级网络分析之间的知识鸿沟，促进可重复、可靠的脑网络研究。
AI.method: 综述了EEG/MEG物理原理、正逆问题求解（个体化头模型、源重建技术）、体传导与信号泄漏缓解策略、源空间连接性分析最佳实践，以及多种功能/有效连接性度量（相干性、相位同步、振幅包络相关、格兰杰因果、动态因果模型、转移熵）；介绍了端到端分析流程（如Brainstorm和开源软件）以及新兴方法（时变连接性、跨频交互、网络分析）。
AI.result: 总结了各类连接性度量的假设、优势和局限性；强调了准确解剖建模对于可靠源定位的重要性；展示了非侵入性电生理学如何为健康与疾病状态下的脑组织理解做出贡献。
AI.conclusion: EEG/MEG凭借毫秒级时间分辨率在揭示大规模脑网络的功能和有效交互中具有独特价值；结合适当的源重建和连接性分析方法，可有效刻画脑网络动态组织；新兴的时变和跨频方法将进一步拓展该领域的研究边界。
AI.abstract_zh: 脑电图（EEG）和脑磁图（MEG）能够以毫秒级时间分辨率非侵入性地测量大脑活动，从而支持对大规模脑网络内功能和有效交互的研究。本章全面综述了基于EEG/MEG的脑网络分析的方法学基础与实践工作流程。我们首先回顾了EEG和MEG的物理原理，重点阐述其互补优势与局限性。随后介绍了正问题和逆问题，包括个体化头建模、源重建技术，以及准确的解剖建模对可靠源定位的重要性。讨论了缓解体传导和信号泄漏的策略，以及源空间连接性分析的最佳实践。本章回顾了广泛使用的功能和有效连接性度量，包括相干性、相位同步指标、振幅包络相关、格兰杰因果分析、动态因果模型和转移熵，重点说明了它们的假设、优势和局限性。介绍了现代端到端分析流程，特别强调了Brainstorm及互补的开源软件在可重复EEG/MEG研究中的应用。最后，我们讨论了新兴方法，包括时变连接性、跨频交互和基于网络的分析，展示了非侵入性电生理学如何促进对健康和疾病状态下脑组织的理解。本章为使用EEG和MEG绘制和解释人脑网络的研究者和高级学生提供了概念基础和实践指导。

title: Physics-Informed Feature Engineering 1D-CNN for Multilayer Cloud Detection from Geostationary Satellites
summary: Multilayer cloud detection from active--passive observation is vital for numerical weather prediction. In this study, channel selections derived from threshold-based algorithms are embedded as feature-engineering priors into a 1D-CNN, and machine learning (ML) is used to learn latent physical relationships to simplify physical retrievals for operational deployment. The results show that the 1D-CNN achieves a multilayer-cloud probability of detection ($\mathrm{POD}{\mathrm{mul}}$) of 0.620 and a false alarm rate ($\mathrm{FAR}{\mathrm{mul}}$) of 0.240, outperforming the conventional threshold algorithm ($\mathrm{POD}{\mathrm{mul}} = 0.558$, $\mathrm{FAR}{\mathrm{mul}} = 0.369$). These results demonstrate that prior physical knowledge derived from radiative transfer theory can serve as an effective feature-engineering prior. Further experiments show that ML-revealed physical mechanisms can also enhance traditional algorithms. Replacing AGRI channel 12 (C12, centered at $10.8~μ\mathrm{m}$) with channel 13 (C13, centered at $12.0~μ\mathrm{m}$) increased $\mathrm{POD}{\mathrm{mul}}$ from 0.558 to 0.609 without materially affecting $\mathrm{FAR}{\mathrm{mul}}$. However, for AHI, substituting the $11.2~μ\mathrm{m}$ channel with the $12.3~μ\mathrm{m}$ channel yielded negligible improvement. In addition to spectral response function (SRF) mismatches, a primary contributing factor is the channels' on-orbit radiometric stability. Hence, physics-informed machine-learning methods appear promising for advancing remote-sensing AI, while sensor-specific characteristics must be considered during operational transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将基于阈值算法的通道选择作为特征工程先验嵌入1D-CNN，用于从主被动观测中检测多层云，结果表明该方法优于传统阈值算法，并揭示了机器学习发现的物理机制可反过来增强传统算法。
AI.motivation: 多层云检测对数值天气预报至关重要，但传统的基于阈值的物理反演算法在操作部署中面临性能瓶颈，需要利用机器学习学习潜在物理关系以简化物理反演过程。
AI.method: 将来自阈值算法的通道选择作为特征工程先验嵌入一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）中，利用机器学习学习潜在物理关系，实现从主被动观测中检测多层云。
AI.result: 1D-CNN的多层云检测概率（POD_mul）为0.620，虚警率（FAR_mul）为0.240，优于传统阈值算法（POD_mul=0.558, FAR_mul=0.369）。用AGRI的C13（12.0 μm）替代C12（10.8 μm）使POD_mul从0.558提升至0.609且FAR_mul基本不变；但对AHI，用12.3 μm替代11.2 μm通道的改进可忽略，主要原因是光谱响应函数不匹配和通道在轨辐射稳定性差异。
AI.conclusion: 来自辐射传输理论的先验物理知识可作为有效的特征工程先验，物理信息机器学习有望推进遥感AI发展，但在操作迁移中需考虑传感器特定特性。
AI.abstract_zh: 从主被动观测中检测多层云对数值天气预报至关重要。本研究将基于阈值算法的通道选择作为特征工程先验嵌入一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN），利用机器学习学习潜在物理关系，以简化面向业务部署的物理反演。结果表明，1D-CNN的多层云检测概率（POD_mul）达到0.620，虚警率（FAR_mul）为0.240，优于传统阈值算法（POD_mul=0.558，FAR_mul=0.369）。这些结果表明，来自辐射传输理论的先验物理知识可作为有效的特征工程先验。进一步实验表明，机器学习揭示的物理机制也可增强传统算法。用AGRI通道13（C13，中心波长12.0 μm）替换通道12（C12，中心波长10.8 μm），POD_mul从0.558提升至0.609，且FAR_mul基本未受影响。然而，对于AHI，用12.3 μm通道替换11.2 μm通道带来的改进可忽略不计。除光谱响应函数（SRF）不匹配外，一个主要影响因素是通道在轨辐射稳定性。因此，物理信息机器学习方法在推进遥感人工智能方面前景广阔，但在业务迁移时必须考虑传感器特定特性。

title: Fully-sensorized smart-eyewear platform for on-device Machine Learning
comment: This work was carried out in the EssilorLuxottica "Smart Eyewear Lab", a Joint Research Center between EssilorLuxottica and Politecnico di Milano
summary: This paper presents ARGO, a smart eyewear platform designed to bridge ergonomic comfort, high computational throughput, and energy efficiency. Unlike cloud-dependent solutions, ARGO leverages the STM32N6 microcontroller and its integrated Neural Processing Unit (NPU) to enable on-device machine learning, minimizing latency and preserving user privacy through local data processing. The primary contribution lies in the holistic co-design of hardware, firmware, and artificial intelligence, centered on the deployment of an optimized YOLOv11 model for real-time urban obstacle recognition. To ensure compatibility with the target NPU, we introduce Head-wise Parallel Attention (HPA), an architectural refinement that enables efficient accelerator execution while preserving the original computational logic. The model is trained on the Walking On The Road (WOTR) dataset, and the final deployed configuration achieves an mAP50-95 of 24 under strict memory constraints, with a memory footprint of only 2.483 MB. The platform integrates a multimodal sensor suite, RGB cameras, Time-of-Flight sensors, microphones, and ambient sensors, and delivers 10 FPS at a continuous autonomy of ~113 minutes on a 200 mAh battery. These results demonstrate the feasibility of a high-performance, privacy-preserving, and socially acceptable assistive device, and highlight how competitive edge AI solutions increasingly demand tightly integrated, multidisciplinary co-design approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ARGO，一款集成STM32N6微控制器和NPU的智能眼镜平台，通过软硬件协同设计与优化的YOLOv11模型，在低功耗设备上实现了实时城市障碍物识别，兼顾了计算性能、隐私保护和佩戴舒适性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能辅助设备多依赖云端处理，存在延迟高、隐私风险大等问题，且缺乏在边缘设备上同时实现高计算吞吐量、能效和舒适性的综合解决方案。
AI.method: 采用STM32N6微控制器及其集成NPU实现端侧机器学习；提出头状并行注意力（HPA）机制优化YOLOv11模型以适配NPU加速器；在WOTR数据集上训练并部署模型；集成多模态传感器（RGB相机、ToF传感器、麦克风、环境传感器）。
AI.result: 最终部署的模型在严格内存约束下达到mAP50-95为24，内存占用仅2.483 MB；系统以10 FPS运行，200 mAh电池可持续工作约113分钟。
AI.conclusion: ARGO验证了在边缘设备上实现高性能、隐私保护且 socially acceptable 的辅助设备的可行性，并强调具有竞争力的边缘AI解决方案越来越需要紧密集成的多学科协同设计方法。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出ARGO，一款智能眼镜平台，旨在兼顾人体工学舒适性、高计算吞吐量与能效。与依赖云端的解决方案不同，ARGO利用STM32N6微控制器及其集成的神经处理单元（NPU）实现端侧机器学习，通过本地数据处理最小化延迟并保护用户隐私。其主要贡献在于硬件、固件与人工智能的整体协同设计，核心是部署一个优化的YOLOv11模型用于实时城市障碍物识别。为确保与目标NPU的兼容性，我们引入了头状并行注意力（HPA）机制，这是一种架构优化方法，能够在保持原始计算逻辑的同时实现高效的加速器执行。该模型在Walking On The Road（WOTR）数据集上训练，最终部署的配置在严格内存约束下达到mAP50-95为24，内存占用仅2.483 MB。该平台集成了多模态传感器套件（RGB相机、飞行时间传感器、麦克风和环境传感器），以10 FPS运行，在200 mAh电池下可持续工作约113分钟。这些结果证明了构建高性能、隐私保护且具有社会接受度的辅助设备的可行性，并凸显了具有竞争力的边缘AI解决方案越来越需要紧密集成的多学科协同设计方法。

title: The JEPA Predictor: A Transferable Operator for Occluded Feature Completion
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) train a predictor jointly with their encoder, but downstream deployment discards the predictor and reads features from the encoder alone. The predictor is, by construction, a learned operator from visible-context features to features at masked positions, the structure a partial-view classifier needs. We show that this operator is portable across encoder families. We first establish that, at heavy mask, retaining the frozen predictor on a JEPA encoder substantially closes the accuracy gap against the strongest non-JEPA discriminative baselines. We then bolt the frozen predictors of I-JEPA and V-JEPA 2 onto four non-JEPA hosts (CLIP, DINOv3, DINOv2, MAE) through a single linear projection between feature spaces, fit in closed form on 500 ImageNet-1k images. Across both ImageNet-9 and Stanford Dogs and across three mask fractions, the lift over each host's masked-encoder baseline grows monotonically with the mask fraction K in every host-donor pair. CLIP paired with the I-JEPA predictor recovers most of the accuracy that masking removed on ImageNet-9 at heavy occlusion, and lifts fine-grained Stanford Dogs from 15.9% to 52.1% (+36 pp). The mechanism is identifiable: the projection pays a fixed cost on visible patches and the predictor provides a growing benefit on masked patches; the benefit dominates the heavy-occlusion regime. At low K on fine-grained classification the projection cost exceeds the benefit, defining the boundary where the linear bridge breaks down. The frozen JEPA predictor functions as a portable operator for occluded feature completion across encoder families, requiring no retraining of either model while fitting matched linear probes per mask fraction.

AI.tldr: 本文发现JEPA中的预测器（predictor）是一个可移植的算子，能够跨越不同编码器家族执行遮挡特征补全。通过一个简单的线性投影（在500张ImageNet-1k图像上闭式求解），将I-JEPA和V-JEPA的冻结预测器移植到CLIP、DINOv3、DINOv2、MAE等非JEPA编码器上，在ImageNet-9和Stanford Dogs等数据集上显著提升了遮挡分类性能，最高提升36个百分点。机制分析表明，投影在可见块上付出固定成本，而预测器在遮挡块上提供递增收益，后者在重遮挡场景下占主导。
AI.motivation: JEPA架构训练时联合训练编码器和预测器，但在下游部署时丢弃预测器仅使用编码器特征。然而预测器本质上是从可见上下文特征到遮挡位置特征的学习算子，恰好是部分视图分类器所需的结构。作者希望探究该预测器是否可移植到其他非JEPA编码器上，以提升其在遮挡场景下的分类性能。
AI.method: 提出一种线性桥接方法：将JEPA的冻结预测器（来自I-JEPA或V-JEPA）通过一个线性投影层连接到非JEPA编码器（CLIP、DINOv3、DINOv2、MAE）的特征空间。该线性投影在500张ImageNet-1k图像上以闭式解（closed-form）完成拟合，无需重新训练任何模型。在不同遮挡比例（mask fraction K）下，分别训练匹配的线性探测头进行评估。
AI.result: 1）在重遮挡下，保留冻结预测器于JEPA编码器上能大幅缩小与非JEPA强判别基线的精度差距；2）跨ImageNet-9和Stanford Dogs数据集、跨三种遮挡比例，每个编码器-预测器组合的性能提升随遮挡比例K单调增长；3）CLIP+I-JEPA预测器在ImageNet-9上恢复了大部分被遮挡移除的精度，在Stanford Dogs上从15.9%提升至52.1%（+36百分点）；4）机制分析表明：投影在可见块上付出固定代价，预测器在遮挡块上提供递增收益，重遮挡下收益占主导；低遮挡比例下投影成本超过收益，线性桥接失效。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的JEPA预测器是一个可移植的算子，能够跨编码器家族执行遮挡特征补全，无需重新训练任何模型，仅需对每种遮挡比例拟合匹配的线性探测头即可。这种方法在重遮挡场景下显著提升非JEPA编码器的分类性能。
AI.abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）在训练时与编码器联合训练一个预测器，但在下游部署时丢弃预测器，仅从编码器读取特征。预测器本质上是一个从可见上下文特征到遮挡位置特征的学习算子，其结构正是部分视图分类器所需要的。我们证明了该算子可以跨编码器家族移植。我们首先发现，在高遮挡率下，在JEPA编码器上保留冻结的预测器能够显著缩小与最强的非JEPAs判别基准之间的精度差距。接着，我们通过单个线性投影（在500张ImageNet-1k图像上以闭式解拟合）将I-JEPA和V-JEPA 2的冻结预测器移植到四个非JEPA宿主（CLIP、DINOv3、DINOv2、MAE）上。在ImageNet-9和Stanford Dogs两个数据集上以及三种遮挡比例下，每个宿主-供体组合的性能提升都随着遮挡率K单调增长。CLIP与I-JEPA预测器配对后，在ImageNet-9的重遮挡场景下恢复了大部分因遮挡而丢失的精度，并将细粒度Stanford Dogs的精度从15.9%提升至52.1%（提升36个百分点）。该机制是可解释的：投影在可见块上付出固定代价，而预测器在遮挡块上提供递增收益；在重遮挡场景下收益占主导地位。在细粒度分类的低遮挡率K下，投影代价超过收益，这定义了线性桥接失效的边界。冻结的JEPA预测器作为一种可移植的算子，能够跨编码器家族执行遮挡特征补全，无需重新训练任何模型，仅需为每种遮挡比例拟合匹配的线性探测头。

title: Efficient EEG Seizure Detection Using INT8 Quantization, Channel Pruning, and Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Continuous EEG monitoring for epilepsy is constrained by the limited power and memory budgets of wearable and implantable devices. Deep neural networks can detect seizures with high accuracy, but their computational cost and model size make them difficult to deploy on such platforms. In this work we use a single 1D CNN seizure detector on the CHB-MIT scalp EEG dataset as a common baseline, and then investigate three brain-inspired efficiency strategies: (i) conversion of the CNN into a spiking neural network (SNN) via parameter transfer, (ii) EEG channel pruning combined with 2:4 structured weight sparsity, and (iii) INT8 quantization using FX- and ONNX-based workflows, including quantization-aware training and operator fusion. The quantized CNN variants reduce stored model size from 1.63 MB to 0.44 MB, lower estimated energy per inference by up to 64%, and achieve as much as 2.8 times speedup in CPU latency while preserving, and in one case slightly improving, AUC. The pruned CNN halves the number of input channels and non-zero weights with only a modest accuracy drop, and the SNN conversion provides a spiking implementation with sparse temporal activity. Together, these experiments characterize three complementary efficiency directions for seizure detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三种受脑启发的高效策略（SNN转换、通道剪枝+结构稀疏、INT8量化），在保持癫痫检测精度的前提下显著降低模型体积、能耗和推理延迟，为可穿戴/植入式设备的持续EEG监测提供了可行方向。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴和植入式设备的有限功耗与存储预算限制了持续性EEG癫痫监测，而高精度的深度神经网络难以部署在这些平台上，因此亟需高效、低成本的模型压缩与加速策略。
AI.method: 以单1D CNN癫痫检测器为基线，在CHB-MIT头皮EEG数据集上分别探索三种策略：(i) 参数迁移将CNN转换为脉冲神经网络(SNN)；(ii) EEG通道剪枝结合2:4结构化权重稀疏；(iii) 基于FX和ONNX工作流的INT8量化，含量化感知训练和算子融合。
AI.result: 量化CNN将模型从1.63 MB降至0.44 MB，推理能耗降低64%，CPU延迟加速2.8倍，AUC保持不变甚至略有提升；剪枝CNN将输入通道和权重减半，仅轻微精度下降；SNN转换实现了稀疏时间活动的脉冲实现。
AI.conclusion: 三种互补的高效策略均能在不同程度的压缩与加速下保持癫痫检测性能，为资源受限设备上的持续EEG监测提供了可行方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 可穿戴和植入式设备的有限功耗与存储预算约束了持续性EEG癫痫监测。深度神经网络能够高精度检测癫痫发作，但其计算成本和模型体积使其难以部署于此类平台。本研究以CHB-MIT头皮EEG数据集上的单一1D CNN癫痫检测器作为公共基线，探究了三种受脑启发的高效策略：(i) 通过参数迁移将CNN转换为脉冲神经网络(SNN)；(ii) EEG通道剪枝结合2:4结构化权重稀疏；(iii) 基于FX和ONNX工作流的INT8量化，包括量化感知训练与算子融合。量化后的CNN变体将存储模型体积从1.63 MB降至0.44 MB，单次推理能耗降低高达64%，CPU延迟加速达2.8倍，同时AUC保持不变甚至略有提升。剪枝后的CNN将输入通道数和非零权重减半，仅带来轻微的精度下降；SNN转换则提供了具有稀疏时间活动的脉冲实现。这些实验共同刻画了面向癫痫检测的三种互补性高效优化方向。

title: LLM Unlearning for Cyber Defense: A Survey on Methods, Challenges, and Emerging Threats
summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed in security-critical systems across healthcare, finance, education, and decision support, yet their inability to forget creates serious cybersecurity, privacy, and safety risks. Sensitive personal information, copyrighted material, hazardous domain knowledge, and memorized training data remain encoded across billions of parameters long after deployment, leaving models vulnerable to extraction, jailbreak attacks, membership inference, and regulatory non-compliance. Real-world incidents, from chatbots regenerating private information to fabricated legal citations producing direct legal and financial cost, place the problem at the center of the emerging-threats landscape rather than the realm of speculation. Because retraining billion-parameter models on revised corpora is computationally infeasible, and because knowledge within an LLM is distributed and entangled across parameters rather than localized to identifiable units, LLM unlearning has emerged as the principal cyber defense response, aiming to remove or suppress targeted knowledge from a trained model without retraining and without eroding what the model should still know. A central question, however, remains unresolved. Do current methods genuinely remove knowledge, or do they only stop the model from expressing it under ordinary prompting conditions? This survey examines LLM unlearning through the lens of security, robustness, and verifiable forgetting, with primary focus on gradient-based methods, which have come to dominate the field due to their compatibility with existing training pipelines and their scalability to billion-parameter models.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了大语言模型（LLM）的“遗忘”问题——即如何在不重训练的情况下，安全、鲁棒地移除模型中的敏感知识（如个人信息、版权内容、危险领域知识等），重点分析了基于梯度的遗忘方法，并探讨了当前方法究竟是真正删除了知识，还是仅仅抑制了模型在常规提示下的表达。
AI.motivation: LLM在医疗、金融、教育等安全关键系统中广泛部署，但其“无法遗忘”的特性导致个人隐私泄露、版权侵权、记忆数据被提取、越狱攻击等严重安全风险。由于从头重新训练数十亿参数的模型在计算上不可行，且知识在参数中分布纠缠、无法定位到独立单元，因此LLM遗忘技术成为关键的网络安全防御手段。
AI.method: 本文以安全性、鲁棒性和可验证遗忘为视角，对现有LLM遗忘方法进行综述，重点关注基于梯度的遗忘方法，因其与现有训练流程兼容且可扩展到十亿参数级模型。
AI.result: 当前方法存在一个核心未解问题：它们究竟是真正移除了知识，还是仅仅阻止了模型在常规提示条件下表达该知识。论文通过系统性综述揭示了这一关键缺口。
AI.conclusion: LLM遗忘作为新兴威胁格局中的核心网络安全应对手段，仍需在知识移除的真实性验证方面取得突破；基于梯度的方法虽占主导地位，但其是否实现“可验证遗忘”仍待深入探究。
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地部署于医疗、金融、教育和决策支持等安全关键系统中，然而它们无法遗忘的特性引发了严重的网络安全、隐私和安全风险。敏感个人信息、版权内容、危险领域知识以及记忆化的训练数据在部署后仍编码在数十亿参数中，使模型容易受到数据提取、越狱攻击、成员推理攻击以及监管不合规等威胁。从聊天机器人再生私人信息到虚构的法律引用直接造成法律和经济损失，这些真实事件已将这一问题置于新兴威胁格局的中心，而非停留在推测层面。由于在修订后的语料库上重新训练数十亿参数模型在计算上不可行，且LLM内部的知識在参数中分布纠缠、无法定位到可识别的独立单元，LLM遗忘技术已作为主要的网络安全防御手段出现，旨在无需重训练的前提下从已训练模型中移除或压制目标知识，同时不侵蚀模型应保留的知识。然而，一个核心问题仍未解决：当前方法究竟是真正移除了知识，还是仅仅阻止了模型在常规提示条件下表达该知识？本综述从安全性、鲁棒性和可验证遗忘的视角审视LLM遗忘，重点关注基于梯度的方法，这类方法因其与现有训练流程的兼容性以及可扩展到十亿参数级模型的能力而成为该领域的主流。

title: A Step Forward Towards Trustworthy Risk-Aware Facial Retrieval (RA-FR)
comment: Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026). Extended version with additional citations and expanded sections
summary: Facial image retrieval in unconstrained surveillance environments is a high-stakes challenge where missing a subject of interest -- a single false negative -- is simply not an option. Despite near-perfect performance on curated benchmarks, current recognition systems falter under real-world domain shifts such as low resolution, motion blur, and uncontrolled illumination (e.g., SCFace). Addressing this reliability gap, we propose Risk-Aware Facial Retrieval (RA-FR), a framework that moves beyond fixed Top-$k$ retrieval to adaptive set generation, guaranteeing ground truth inclusion within a user-specified risk level ($α$) and confidence level ($1 - δ$). Our approach integrates three core contributions: (1) reducing aleatoric uncertainty via a hybrid blind face restoration technique coupling Latent Consistency Models (InterLCM) and DiffBIR; (2) extracting discriminative, restoration-robust features via self-supervised DINOv1 ViT-B with GGeM pooling; and (3) employing conformal prediction with Hoeffding's inequality to dynamically calibrate retrieval set sizes based on query uncertainty. On the IMFDB benchmark, it consistently satisfies a 5% risk target with an average retrieval set size of approximately 10 images. By unifying domain-specific restoration, robust representation learning, and provable decision rules, RA-FR offers a pipeline that makes facial retrieval in surveillance both reliable and auditable. The code is available at: https://github.com/MuhammadEmmadSiddiqui/RA-FR.

AI.tldr: RA-FR提出了一种风险感知的人脸检索框架，通过混合盲人脸修复、鲁棒特征提取和保形预测，在非约束监控场景下以可控风险水平确保真实目标被检索到，在IMFDB上以约10张的平均检索集大小满足5%的风险目标。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸识别系统在受控基准上表现近乎完美，但在真实监控场景中因低分辨率、运动模糊和光照变化等域偏移而性能大幅下降，且传统Top-k检索无法保证真实目标一定被包含在检索结果中，这在高风险监控任务中是不可接受的。
AI.method: (1) 通过混合盲人脸恢复技术（结合Latent Consistency Models和DiffBIR）降低偶然不确定性；(2) 使用自监督DINOv1 ViT-B与广义均值池化提取具有判别性和恢复鲁棒性的特征；(3) 采用基于Hoeffding不等式的保形预测，根据查询不确定性动态校准检索集大小。
AI.result: 在IMFDB基准上，RA-FR始终满足5%的风险目标，平均检索集大小约为10张图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一领域特定的图像恢复、鲁棒表示学习和可证明的决策规则，RA-FR构建了一个既可靠又可审计的监控场景人脸检索流程。
AI.abstract_zh: 在非约束监控环境中的人脸图像检索是一项高风险挑战，其中遗漏一个感兴趣的目标——哪怕是一个假阴性——是绝不允许的。尽管在精心整理的基准上表现近乎完美，但当前的识别系统在真实世界的域偏移（如低分辨率、运动模糊和不受控光照，例如SCFace数据集）下性能大幅下降。为解决这一可靠性差距，我们提出了风险感知人脸检索（RA-FR）框架，该框架超越了固定的Top-k检索范式，转向自适应集合生成，保证在用户指定的风险水平（α）和置信水平（1-δ）内包含真实目标。我们的方法包含三项核心贡献：（1）通过混合盲人脸恢复技术（结合Latent Consistency Models和DiffBIR）降低偶然不确定性；（2）利用自监督DINOv1 ViT-B和广义均值（GGeM）池化提取具有判别性和恢复鲁棒性的特征；（3）采用基于Hoeffding不等式的保形预测，根据查询不确定性动态校准检索集大小。在IMFDB基准上，该方法始终满足5%的风险目标，平均检索集大小约为10张图像。通过统一领域特定的图像恢复、鲁棒表示学习和可证明的决策规则，RA-FR提供了一个使监控场景下的人脸检索既可靠又可审计的流程。代码已开源：https://github.com/MuhammadEmmadSiddiqui/RA-FR。

title: Robust and Feasible QoS-Aware mmWave Massive MIMO Hybrid Beamforming
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 46 references, journal paper published in IEEE TWC
summary: Hybrid beamforming (HB) with quality-of-service (QoS) provisioning per stream in millimeter waves is indispensable in 5G/6G networks. HB includes baseband and radio frequency (RF) beamforming, and requires error-free channel state information (CSI), which is erroneous in practice. So there is a need for efficient, feasible, robust, and QoS-aware HB. To achieve this, we mitigate CSI uncertainty via baseband beamforming, and we steer the RF beamformer by using the estimates of the channel's eigenvectors. In doing so, we consider the effective channel's uncertainty region instead of the uncertainty region of the channel itself, as the former is smaller than the latter, requiring less transmit power to satisfy the QoS constraint. We also detect and eliminate the infeasible data streams. Our iterative scheme (which is based on the cutting-set method) for baseband beamforming satisfies the mean-squared error (MSE) constraint per stream, where a limited number of constraints are considered instead of infinitely many constraints. In our low-complexity scheme, we derive a simple sufficient condition to check the feasibility of each stream, we diagonalize the effective channel at the baseband precoder, and we use minimum MSE combining at the baseband combiner. Extensive simulations validate our formulations and theoretical derivations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对毫米波5G/6G网络中混合波束赋形（HB）在实际存在信道状态信息（CSI）误差时的鲁棒性问题，提出了一种基于割集法的迭代基带波束赋形方案，通过利用有效信道的不确定区域（比原始信道不确定区域更小）来降低发射功率，并剔除不可行的数据流，在满足每流服务质量（QoS）约束的同时实现了低复杂度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 实际毫米波系统中CSI存在不可避免的估计误差，而传统混合波束赋形方案假设CSI无误差，导致QoS无法保障。因此需要一种高效、可行且鲁棒的QoS感知混合波束赋形方案来应对CSI不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 通过基带波束赋形来缓解CSI不确定性；2) 利用信道特征向量估计来引导RF波束赋形；3) 采用有效信道的不确定区域（小于原始信道不确定区域）以降低发射功率；4) 基于割集法的迭代方案，用有限约束代替无限约束以满足每流MSE约束；5) 推导简单充分条件检验每流可行性；6) 基带预编码器中对有效信道进行对角化，基带合并器采用最小MSE合并。
AI.result: 大量仿真验证了所提公式推导和理论分析的正确性，表明方案在满足QoS约束的同时具有更低的发射功率和更高的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于割集法的迭代基带波束赋形方案能够有效应对CSI误差，在保证每流QoS的前提下降低发射功率，并剔除不可行数据流，为毫米波5G/6G网络提供了一种鲁棒且低复杂度的混合波束赋形解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 在5G/6G网络中，毫米波中具有每流服务质量（QoS）保障的混合波束赋形（HB）是不可或缺的。混合波束赋形包括基带和射频（RF）波束赋形，并且需要无误差的信道状态信息（CSI），然而在实际中CSI是存在误差的。因此，需要一种高效、可行、鲁棒且具有QoS感知的混合波束赋形方案。为实现这一目标，我们通过基带波束赋形来缓解CSI不确定性，并利用信道特征向量的估计来引导RF波束赋形。在此过程中，我们考虑有效信道的不确定区域而非原始信道的不确定区域，因为前者小于后者，从而在满足QoS约束时所需的发射功率更低。我们还检测并剔除了不可行的数据流。我们基于割集法的基带波束赋形迭代方案满足每流的均方误差（MSE）约束，其中只考虑有限数量的约束而非无穷多个约束。在我们的低复杂度方案中，我们推导了一个简单的充分条件来检验每流的可行性，在基带预编码器中对有效信道进行对角化，并在基带合并器中使用最小MSE合并。大量仿真验证了我们的公式推导和理论分析的正确性。

title: Operator-Aware Mixed-Precision Tolerance Calibration for Tensor Kernels
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, LNCS format. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.20128 (P1). Additional companions (P3, P4) to follow on arXiv this week; IDs will be added in a v2 replace
summary:
Most tensor-kernel correctness tests go through a fixed-shape all close-style check with hand-picked absolute and relative tolerances. The thresholds are copied across the corpus and rarely revisited. We mine the element-wise error distribution of every test case from accumulated cloud GPU runs across the 26-entry gpuemu corpus and 2 dtypes (8,076 result rows). We then ask one empirical question: what absolute tolerance would the kernel itself, observed under its correct implementation, justify?
  The answer is much tighter than the current hand-picked atol. The largest tightening is attention_triton fp16 at $2{,}184\times$. Restricted to the seven LLM-style buggy variants for which the corpus ships a paired correct counterpart, calibrated per-(op, dtype) tolerances raise bug-detection recall from 73.2% (1,805 of 2,467) to 82.4% (2,034 of 2,467), an absolute gain of 9.3 percentage points (+229 new detections). The control false-positive count rises from 0 to 20 out of 1,882 correct-control cases (+1.1 percentage points).

AI.tldr: 该论文发现当前张量核正确性测试中手工设定的绝对容差（atol）过于宽松，通过对GPU云运行数据挖掘真实误差分布，提出了基于核自身正确实现校准的容差方法，在LLM风格bug检测中召回率提升9.3个百分点（从73.2%到82.4%），误报率仅增加1.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前张量核正确性测试普遍采用固定形状的"全接近"检查，容差阈值靠手工设定且在整个语料库中复制粘贴、很少被重新审视，缺乏经验依据，可能导致漏检或误判。
AI.method: 从累积的云端GPU运行数据中，对gpuemu语料库的26个条目和2种数据类型（共8,076个结果行）挖掘每个测试用例的元素级误差分布，基于核在正确实现下观察到的误差来校准绝对容差（atol）。
AI.result: 校准后的容差比手工设定的atol更严格，最大收紧幅度为attention_triton fp16的2,184倍；在7个LLM风格的bug变体上，bug检测召回率从73.2%（1,805/2,467）提升至82.4%（2,034/2,467），绝对提升9.3个百分点（新增229个检测）；正确控制案例中误报数从0增至20（1,882例中占1.1个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 基于核自身正确实现观测数据来校准容差是一种更合理、更有效的方法，能够在显著提升bug检测召回率的同时保持极低的误报率。
AI.abstract_zh: 大多数张量核正确性测试采用固定形状的"全接近"风格检查，并依赖手工选取的绝对容差和相对容差。这些阈值在整个语料库中复制粘贴，很少被重新审视。我们从累积的云端GPU运行数据中，对gpuemu语料库的26个条目和2种数据类型（共8,076个结果行）挖掘每个测试用例的元素级误差分布。随后提出一个经验性问题：在核的正确实现下观察到的误差，能够证明多大的绝对容差是合理的？答案是：校准后的容差比当前手工设定的atol要严格得多。最大收紧幅度来自attention_triton fp16，达2,184倍。在语料库中配有配对正确版本的7个LLM风格bug变体上，按（操作，数据类型）校准的容差将bug检测召回率从73.2%（1,805/2,467）提升至82.4%（2,034/2,467），绝对增益为9.3个百分点（新增229个检测）。控制实验中的误报数从0增至1,882个正确控制案例中的20例（增加1.1个百分点）。

title: 3D FaceShell: Attribute Transfer in 3D Face Avatars as a VLM Defense Mechanism
summary: Photorealistic 3D face avatars are increasingly deployed as reusable digital assets across applications such as telepresence, animation, and personalized media. At the same time, vision-language models (VLMs) can infer sensitive attributes from rendered images with open-ended semantic reasoning without any fine-tuning. This creates a new privacy challenge: once a 3D face avatar is shared, any of its renderings can be analyzed to extract high-level facial attributes. Existing defenses largely operate in 2D image space and do not address identity-preserving semantic manipulation of 3D facial representations. We propose 3D FaceShell, a framework for steering VLM interpretations of faces rendered from 3D models while preserving geometric fidelity and facial identity. 3D FaceShell augments the original 3D representation with a learnable Gaussian shell that produces subtle, spatially distributed perturbations optimized through multi-view embedding alignment. The perturbations are designed to be visually inconspicuous yet sufficient to redirect VLM-based attribute inference in a view-consistent manner. Extensive experiments on reconstructed celebrity face avatars and multiple black-box VLMs demonstrate that 3D FaceShell significantly increases attribute injection and mismatch rates while maintaining high perceptual similarity and identity consistency. Our results show that it is possible to manipulate VLM-level semantic interpretation of 3D faces without compromising their human-recognizable appearance.

AI.tldr: 提出3D FaceShell框架，通过在3D面部模型上添加可学习的高斯外壳扰动，在保持几何保真度和身份一致性的前提下，操纵视觉-语言模型对3D面部渲染图像的语义属性推断，从而解决3D面部隐私保护问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D面部头像一旦被共享，其任意渲染图像都可能被视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过开放式语义推理提取敏感属性，而现有防御方法主要针对2D图像空间，无法在保持身份信息的同时对3D面部表示进行语义层面的隐私保护。
AI.method: 提出3D FaceShell框架，在原始3D面部表示上附加一个可学习的高斯外壳，通过多视图嵌入对齐优化产生细微的空间分布扰动。这些扰动在视觉上不易察觉，但能够以视图一致的方式重定向VLM的语义属性推断。
AI.result: 在重建的名人面部头像和多个黑盒VLM上的实验表明，3D FaceShell显著提高了属性注入率和属性错配率，同时保持了较高的感知相似性和身份一致性。
AI.conclusion: 可以在不牺牲人类可识别外观的前提下，实现对3D面部在VLM层面的语义解释进行操控，为3D面部隐私保护提供了新的技术路径。
AI.abstract_zh: 逼真的3D面部头像越来越多地被部署为可重复使用的数字资产，广泛应用于远程呈现、动画和个性化媒体等应用。与此同时，视觉-语言模型（VLM）无需任何微调即可通过开放式语义推理从渲染图像中推断出敏感属性。这带来了一个新的隐私挑战：一旦3D面部头像被共享，其任意渲染图像都可能被分析以提取高级面部属性。现有防御方法主要在2D图像空间内运作，未能解决3D面部表示的保身份语义操控问题。我们提出3D FaceShell，这是一个引导VLM对3D模型渲染的面部进行语义解释的框架，同时保持几何保真度和面部身份。3D FaceShell在原始3D表示上附加一个可学习的高斯外壳，通过多视图嵌入对齐优化产生细微的空间分布扰动。这些扰动设计为视觉上不易察觉，但足以以视图一致的方式重定向基于VLM的属性推断。在重建的名人面部头像和多个黑盒VLM上进行的大量实验表明，3D FaceShell在保持高感知相似性和身份一致性的同时，显著提高了属性注入率和属性错配率。我们的结果表明，可以在不牺牲人类可识别外观的前提下，操控3D面部在VLM层面的语义解释。

title: RouteCost: A Production-Inspired Multi-Stage Framework for Pre-Order Shipping Cost Estimation in E-Commerce
summary: Accurate pre-order shipping cost estimation is important in e-commerce because it affects price presentation, margin planning, and conversion. In practice, shipping cost is shaped not only by distance but also by destination demand mix, billable weight, dimensional pricing, surcharge triggers, and latent operational effects such as shipment consolidation. Static lookup methods therefore miss important sources of variation, while monolithic regressors may exploit strong but non-causal correlations. We propose RouteCost, a production-inspired multi-stage framework that decomposes the problem into time-aware demand forecasting, fee-card-informed baseline pricing, Stage 2 residual correction, and proxy-based box-consolidation inference. Route-level cost estimates are aggregated through a route-weighted expectation formulation to produce product-level shipping cost predictions. Across over 250,000 orders, 260 products, and 18 months of order history, the framework improves predictive quality and aggregate calibration while preserving route-level interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多阶段分解框架RouteCost，用于电商场景中精确估算预售运费，通过时间感知需求预测、费用卡基线定价、残差校正和代理盒合并推断等步骤，在超过25万订单、260个产品和18个月的数据上提升了预测质量与校准能力。
AI.motivation: 电商中预售运费估算至关重要，但传统静态查找方法忽略了许多变化来源（如需求混合、计费重量、尺寸定价、附加费触发、合并效应等），而单一回归器可能利用强但非因果的相关性，因此需要更精细的分解式建模方法。
AI.method: 提出RouteCost多阶段框架，将问题分解为：1) 时间感知的需求预测；2) 基于费用卡的基线定价；3) 第二阶段残差校正；4) 基于代理的箱体合并推断。路线级成本估计通过路线加权期望公式聚合为产品级运费预测。
AI.result: 在超过250,000个订单、260个产品和18个月的订单历史数据上，该框架提升了预测质量和整体校准能力，同时保留了路线级别的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: RouteCost多阶段分解框架能有效捕捉预售运费的多源变化，在提升预测性能的同时保持路线级可解释性，适用于实际电商生产环境。
AI.abstract_zh: 准确的预售运费估算在电子商务中至关重要，因为它影响价格展示、利润规划和转化率。在实践中，运费不仅受距离影响，还受到目的地需求组合、计费重量、尺寸定价、附加费触发条件以及诸如包裹合并等潜在运营效应的影响。因此，静态查找方法忽略了重要的变化来源，而单一回归器可能利用强但非因果的相关性。我们提出了RouteCost，一个受生产启发的多阶段框架，将问题分解为时间感知的需求预测、基于费用卡的基线定价、第二阶段残差校正以及基于代理的箱体合并推断。路线级成本估计通过路线加权期望公式聚合，生成产品级运费预测。在超过25万笔订单、260种产品和18个月的订单历史数据上，该框架在提升预测质量和整体校准能力的同时，保持了路线级别的可解释性。

title: Moving Like a Human: Ego-Motion-Normalized Temporal Signatures for Real-Time Aerial Person Tracking on Milliwatt-Class Hardware
summary: Follow-me person tracking must run on the drone itself, where affordable companion computers offer only a few effective int8 GFLOP/s. At typical follow distances a person spans 10-60 pixels, indistinguishable from clutter and beyond the reach of single-frame appearance detectors. The missing evidence is temporal and belongs in the input representation, computed analytically, rather than in learned temporal machinery. EMTS-Det is a five-stage system that estimates ego-motion, converts each frame into ego-motion-normalized residual-motion channels, detects person centers with a 22k-parameter, 7.6-MFLOP network, tracks a locked target with a Kalman filter in stabilized coordinates, and verifies tracks with a 1-D convolutional classifier of human motion (ROC AUC 0.941). Training uses a synthetic-motion curriculum with motion channels generated by the deployed ego-motion code. Multi-seed ablations locate the value in generalization: on held-out VisDrone-DET a luminance-only variant collapses to 0.051 AP25 versus 0.415, as does YOLOv8n fine-tuned identically despite 1,100 times the compute, while the deployed int8 detector reaches 0.694 AP25 in-domain and 0.444 on this split. Temporal-shift modules lower accuracy, so the deployed detector is stateless. Silent int8 calibration failures are documented; min-max calibration with propagated caches matches float within 0.008 AP. On a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W the pipeline runs at 31.85 FPS with 0.462 AP25 and 0.714 recall over 1,000 real-world UAV videos, versus 1.95 FPS and 0.172 AP25 for YOLOv8n. A 57-second field sequence shows auto-lock at 1.3 s, 97.9% lock recall, and recovery from all nine occlusions with zero false re-locks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMTS-Det，一种在资源受限的无人机嵌入式平台上运行的轻量级人员跟踪检测器，通过解析运动线索而非依赖大规模神经网络实现高效、鲁棒的跟随式人物跟踪。
AI.motivation: 在无人机跟随场景中，目标人物在图像中仅占10-60像素，单帧外观检测器难以将其与杂波区分；而无人机上可用的嵌入式计算资源极其有限（仅数个int8 GFLOP/s）。因此需要一种将时域运动证据显式编码到输入中、避免复杂时序模型的高效检测方案。
AI.method: EMTS-Det是一个五阶段系统：(1) 估计自运动；(2) 将每帧转换为自运动归一化的残差运动通道；(3) 使用仅22k参数、7.6 MFLOP的轻量网络检测人物中心；(4) 在稳定坐标系中使用卡尔曼滤波跟踪锁定目标；(5) 使用一维卷积分类器验证人物运动轨迹（ROC AUC 0.941）。训练采用合成运动课程，运动通道由实际部署的自运动代码生成。
AI.result: 在VisDrone-DET上：亮度版本仅0.051 AP25 vs 0.415（完整方法）；YOLOv8n微调后仅0.172 AP25，计算量高出1100倍；部署的int8检测器域内0.694 AP25，跨域0.444 AP25。在树莓派Zero 2W上：31.85 FPS、0.462 AP25、0.714召回率，而YOLOv8n仅1.95 FPS、0.172 AP25。野外序列中：1.3秒自动锁定、97.9%锁定召回率，9次遮挡全部恢复且零误重新锁定。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明，在极低计算资源下，通过将时域运动信息显式编码为输入表示（而非依赖学习到的时序模块），结合轻量网络和经典滤波方法，能够在无人机嵌入式平台上实现远超YOLOv8n等主流方法的检测精度和推理速度。
AI.abstract_zh: 跟随式人物跟踪必须在无人机本体上运行，而可用的廉价伴生计算机仅能提供数个有效的int8 GFLOP/s。在典型的跟随距离下，人物仅占10-60像素，与杂波难以区分，超出了单帧外观检测器的能力范围。缺失的证据是时域的，应当以分析计算的方式纳入输入表示，而非依赖学习得到的时序机制。EMTS-Det是一个五阶段系统：估计自运动、将每帧转换为自运动归一化的残差运动通道、使用一个22k参数、7.6 MFLOP的网络检测人物中心、在稳定坐标系中使用卡尔曼滤波器跟踪锁定目标、以及使用一维卷积分类器验证人物运动（ROC AUC 0.941）。训练采用合成运动课程，运动通道由实际部署的自运动代码生成。多种子消融实验定位了泛化能力的来源：在留出的VisDrone-DET上，仅亮度通道的变体性能骤降至0.051 AP25，而完整方法为0.415；同样微调的YOLOv8n尽管计算量高出1100倍，也仅达到0.172 AP25；而部署的int8检测器在域内达到0.694 AP25，在该划分上达到0.444 AP25。时序移位模块会降低精度，因此部署的检测器是无状态的。静默的int8校准失败问题被记录在案；采用传播缓存的min-max校准与浮点精度相差在0.008 AP以内。在树莓派Zero 2W上，该流水线在1000个真实世界无人机视频上以31.85 FPS运行，达到0.462 AP25和0.714召回率，而YOLOv8n仅为1.95 FPS和0.172 AP25。一个57秒的野外序列显示：1.3秒自动锁定、97.9%锁定召回率、以及从全部九次遮挡中恢复且零误重新锁定。

title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Sensor-based Activity Recognition
summary: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) has achieved significant progressed in fully supervised learning settings. However, these supervised learning models rely on large amount of labeled data, which require labor-intensive collection and meticulous annotation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture framework tailored for sensor-based HAR, designed to learn robust and generalizable representations from unlabeled datasets. The proposed framework features an encoder designed to explicitly model both the fine-grained local temporal representations within individual window and the long-term temporal sequence of adjacent windows. Furthermore, we introduce an improved Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg) objective function that incorporates computationally lightweight norm term to stabilize the JEPA pre-training phase. This term balances variance, invariance and covariance constraints to prevent representation collapse. The proposed HAR-JEPA framework is evaluated using two benchmark continuously performed activity datasets. The results show that high-quality representations are successfully learned by the proposed framework. Furthermore, the representations learned by HAR-JEPA demonstrates superior generalization on minority, high variance transitional activities such as sit-to-stand and sit-to-lie where supervised learning tend to overfit due to limited support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAR-JEPA框架，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的自监督学习方法，用于传感器人体活动识别，通过显式建模局部和长期时间表征并改进VICReg正则化目标函数，在无标签数据上学习鲁棒且可泛化的表示，尤其对少数类和过渡性活动表现优越。
AI.motivation: 现有基于传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）在有监督学习下取得了显著进展，但这些模型依赖大量标注数据，而数据采集和标注过程耗时费力。为解决标注数据稀缺的问题，本文旨在探索一种无需标签即可从传感器数据中学习鲁棒且可泛化表示的自监督学习方法。
AI.method: 提出HAR-JEPA框架，核心包括：(1) 设计一种编码器，显式建模单个时间窗口内的细粒度局部时间表示以及相邻窗口之间的长期时间序列依赖；(2) 引入改进的方差-不变性-协方差正则化（VICReg）目标函数，增加轻量级范数项以稳定JEPA预训练阶段，平衡方差、不变性和协方差约束，防止表示坍塌。
AI.result: 在两个基准连续活动数据集上的评估表明，所提框架成功学习到高质量表示。尤其对于少数类和高方差过渡性活动（如坐-站、坐-躺），HAR-JEPA学到的表示展现出优越的泛化能力，而监督学习因样本有限容易过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的HAR-JEPA自监督框架能够有效从无标签传感器数据中学习鲁棒的时间表示，在解决标注数据稀缺问题的同时，在过渡性等困难活动识别任务上超越有监督方法。
AI.abstract_zh: 基于传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）在全监督学习环境下已取得显著进展。然而，这些监督学习模型依赖于大量标注数据，而标注数据的收集需要耗费大量人力且标注过程极为精细。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了一种专为基于传感器的HAR设计的联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture）框架，旨在从无标签数据集中学习鲁棒且可泛化的表示。该框架配备了一种编码器，能够显式地同时对单个窗口内的细粒度局部时间表示和相邻窗口之间的长期时间序列进行建模。此外，我们引入了一种改进的方差-不变性-协方差正则化（VICReg）目标函数，其中包含一个计算轻量的范数项，用于稳定JEPA预训练阶段。该项通过平衡方差、不变性和协方差约束来防止表示坍塌。所提出的HAR-JEPA框架在两个基准连续活动数据集上进行了评估。结果表明，该框架成功学习到了高质量的表示。此外，HAR-JEPA学到的表示在少数类、高方差的过渡性活动（如坐-站和坐-躺）上展现出优越的泛化能力，而监督学习由于样本支持有限，在这些活动上容易过拟合。

title: Orthogonal Gradient Constraints Shape Noisy-Label Memorization Dynamics
comment: 7 pages, accepted into the ICML HiLD workshop 2026 @Seoul
summary: Modern neural networks can fit corrupted training labels, making noisy-label learning a useful setting for studying memorization-driven overfitting. Most regularization methods modify the objective, architecture, or data distribution; here we instead study a geometric intervention on the optimizer update itself. We evaluate OrthoGrad, which removes the component of each weight gradient parallel to the current weight vector, in noisy-label image classification. On MNIST with small-data regimes, OrthoGrad improves test accuracy most clearly for CNNs while reducing corrupted-label fitting. Mechanism diagnostics based on weight norms and gradient-weight cosine similarity suggest that the projection has the strongest effect when the raw gradient contains a nontrivial radial component, and becomes weaker in larger-data regimes where gradients are already nearly orthogonal to weights. Additional CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 experiments show that the method can alter memorization trajectories but does not prevent eventual noisy-label memorization. These results support orthogonal update constraints as a useful diagnostic for studying learning dynamics, while showing that OrthoGrad is regime-dependent rather than universally regularizing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种几何层面的优化器干预方法OrthoGrad，即在每次更新中去除权重梯度中平行于当前权重向量的分量。实验表明，该方法在MNIST小数据 regime 下能提升CNN测试精度并减少对错误标签的过拟合，但在大数据 regime 或CIFAR-10上效果有限，不能完全阻止对噪声标签的记忆。研究指出正交更新约束是一种有用的学习动力学诊断工具，但其效果具有 regime 依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有噪声标签学习中的正则化方法大多通过修改目标函数、网络架构或数据分布来缓解过拟合，但鲜有从优化器更新本身的几何性质入手。本文旨在探索通过几何干预优化器更新（去除梯度中平行于权重向量的分量）来影响网络记忆行为，从而更好地理解记忆驱动的过拟合机制。
AI.method: 提出OrthoGrad方法，在每次梯度更新时，计算当前权重向量与梯度的点积，从原始梯度中减去沿权重方向的分量，仅保留与权重正交的分量进行参数更新。该正交投影操作直接作用于优化器更新步骤，不改变损失函数、网络结构或数据分布。
AI.result: 在MNIST小数据 regime 下，OrthoGrad显著提升了CNN的测试精度，同时降低了对错误标签的拟合程度。权重范数和梯度-权重余弦相似度的机制诊断表明，当原始梯度含有较大的径向分量时正交投影效果最强；在大数据 regime 下，梯度已近乎与权重正交，OrthoGrad效果减弱。CIFAR-10 ResNet-18实验显示，该方法能改变记忆轨迹，但无法完全阻止对噪声标签的最终记忆。
AI.conclusion: 正交更新约束可作为研究学习动力学的有效诊断工具，有助于理解记忆与泛化之间的权衡。但OrthoGrad的效果具有 regime 依赖性——在小数据、高噪声场景下更有效，在大数据场景下效果有限，并非一种普遍适用的正则化方法。
AI.abstract_zh: 现代神经网络能够拟合被损坏的训练标签，这使得噪声标签学习成为研究记忆驱动过拟合的有用场景。大多数正则化方法通过修改目标函数、架构或数据分布来实现；本文转而研究优化器更新本身的几何干预。我们评估了OrthoGrad方法——该方法在每次更新中去除每个权重梯度中平行于当前权重向量的分量——在噪声标签图像分类中的表现。在MNIST小数据 regime 下，OrthoGrad能最明显地提升CNN的测试准确率，同时减少对损坏标签的拟合。基于权重范数和梯度-权重余弦相似度的机制诊断表明，当原始梯度含有显著的径向分量时，该投影具有最强效果；而在大数据 regime 下，梯度已近乎与权重正交，该效果变弱。额外的CIFAR-10 ResNet-18实验表明，该方法能够改变记忆轨迹，但无法完全阻止对噪声标签的最终记忆。这些结果支持正交更新约束作为研究学习动力学的有效诊断工具，同时表明OrthoGrad的效果具有 regime 依赖性而非普遍的正则化作用。

title: GenSyn10: A Multi-Generative AI Dataset For Benchmarking Image Classification
summary: The rapid advancement of generative AI has outpaced our ability to reliably detect its outputs, particularly when detectors encounter generators they have not seen before. We introduce GenSyn10, a CIFAR-10-aligned synthetic image dataset of 60,000 images (10 classes, 32$\times$32, 50k/10k split) generated using three architecturally diverse state-of-the-art models: FLUX.2-dev (Rectified Flow Transformer), HunyuanImage-3.0 (MoE Transformer), and Qwen-Image-2512 (Multimodal Diffusion Transformer), to advance research in AI-generated image detection. A central challenge in this domain is that detectors perform well on known generators but degrade on unseen ones. GenSyn10 addresses this limitation by curating data from multiple contemporary architectures under a standardized generation protocol, enabling controlled and systematic evaluation of out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization to novel generators. Images are generated using a template-based prompt engine and downsampled to ensure consistency. We evaluate 17 image classification models under a four-stage protocol: real-data baseline, zero-shot transfer, fine-tuning, and retention. Despite a measurable domain gap, CIFAR-10-trained models achieve up to 96.86\% zero-shot accuracy on GenSyn10, increasing to 99.88\% after fine-tuning. In binary real-vs-synthetic classification, fine-tuned models achieve 97-99.9\% accuracy on seen generators but drop to 79-96\% on images from an unseen generator, highlighting persistent limitations in OOD generalization. These results establish GenSyn10 as a controlled benchmark for studying synthetic image detection beyond single-generator settings, supporting research on robustness, domain adaptation, and cross-generator generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GenSyn10——一个基于CIFAR-10对齐的60,000张合成图像数据集，用于研究AI生成图像检测，重点关注检测器在未见过的生成器上的分布外（OOD）泛化问题。实验表明，微调后的模型在已知生成器上准确率达97-99.9%，但在未知生成器上降至79-96%，揭示了现有方法的泛化局限。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展使得可靠检测其输出变得困难，尤其是当检测器遇到从未见过的生成器时性能严重下降。现有数据集多基于单一生成器，无法系统评估跨生成器的泛化能力。因此需要构建一个包含多种架构、标准化流程的基准数据集，以推动合成图像检测的鲁棒性和域适应研究。
AI.method: 使用三种架构差异显著的最新模型（FLUX.2-dev、HunyuanImage-3.0、Qwen-Image-2512）生成60,000张与CIFAR-10对齐的32×32合成图像（10类，50k/10k划分）。采用基于模板的提示引擎生成图像，并进行下采样确保一致性。评估了17个图像分类模型，采用四阶段协议：真实数据基线、零样本迁移、微调和保留测试。
AI.result: CIFAR-10训练模型在GenSyn10上零样本准确率达96.86%，微调后提升至99.88%。在二分类真实vs合成检测中，微调模型在已知生成器上达到97-99.9%准确率，但在未见过的生成器上降至79-96%，凸显了分布外泛化的持续局限性。
AI.conclusion: GenSyn10可作为超越单生成器设置的合成图像检测控制基准，支持鲁棒性、域适应和跨生成器泛化研究。当前检测器在未见生成器上的性能退化表明仍需进一步研究以提高泛化能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 生成式AI的快速发展已超越了我们对其实时输出的可靠检测能力，尤其是当检测器遇到从未见过的生成器时。我们提出了GenSyn10——一个与CIFAR-10对齐的合成图像数据集，包含60,000张图像（10个类别，32×32分辨率，50k/10k划分），由三种架构差异显著的最新模型生成：FLUX.2-dev（修正流Transformer）、HunyuanImage-3.0（MoE Transformer）和Qwen-Image-2512（多模态扩散Transformer），以推进AI生成图像检测的研究。该领域的一个核心挑战是检测器在已知生成器上表现良好，但在未见过的生成器上性能退化。GenSyn10通过从多个当代架构中按照标准化生成协议整理数据来解决这一局限，从而能够对新型生成器进行受控且系统的分布外（OOD）泛化评估。图像使用基于模板的提示引擎生成，并进行下采样以确保一致性。我们在四阶段协议下评估了17个图像分类模型：真实数据基线、零样本迁移、微调和保留测试。尽管存在可测量的域差距，CIFAR-10训练的模型在GenSyn10上实现了高达96.86%的零样本准确率，微调后提升至99.88%。在二分类真实vs合成检测中，微调模型在已知生成器上达到97-99.9%的准确率，但在未见过的生成器图像上降至79-96%，凸显了分布外泛化的持续局限性。这些结果确立了GenSyn10作为超越单生成器设置的合成图像检测控制基准，支持鲁棒性、域适应和跨生成器泛化研究。

title: Scalable Attention for 5G NR Channel Estimation
summary: Attention-based neural estimators achieve strong channel-estimation accuracy, but the computational cost of global attention over the time-frequency resource grid grows quadratically with the number of subcarriers, and these estimators are typically tied to a single resource allocation. This paper proposes Channel Estimation Attention (CHEA), a low-complexity channel estimator for 5G New Radio (5G NR) multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO). CHEA replaces global attention with a multi-resolution windowed design: a high-resolution encoder preserves local pilot detail, a low-resolution encoder captures wider frequency-domain context, and a local cross-attention decoder transfers this coarse context back to the high-resolution pilot tokens. A per-Physical Resource Block (PRB) upsampling module then reconstructs the channel over the full slot. Because every attention operation is confined to a fixed-size window and reconstruction is performed per PRB, the cost of CHEA scales linearly with the number of subcarriers, and a single trained model supports different PRB allocations without retraining. On a standard-compliant Physical Uplink Shared Channel (PUSCH), CHEA achieves the lowest Mean Squared Error (MSE) among conventional and state-of-the-art neural estimators, while requiring 2.8\(\times\) to 22.0\(\times\) lower operations than existing attention-based estimators.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种低复杂度的注意力信道估计器CHEA，通过多分辨率窗口化注意力机制，将计算复杂度从二次降至线性，并在5G NR MU-MIMO场景下以更低运算量取得最优MSE性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于注意力的信道估计方法在时频资源网格上进行全局注意力计算，复杂度随子载波数二次增长，且模型通常绑定单一资源分配，无法灵活适配不同的PRB分配方案。
AI.method: 提出CHEA，采用多分辨率窗口化设计：高分辨率编码器保留局部导频细节，低分辨率编码器捕获宽频域上下文，局部交叉注意力解码器将粗粒度上下文传递回高分辨率导频token，最后通过每PRB上采样模块重建全时隙信道。所有注意力操作限制在固定大小窗口内，计算复杂度与子载波数呈线性关系。
AI.result: 在标准PUSCH信道上，CHEA取得最低MSE，超越传统及最先进的神经估计器；同时相比现有注意力估计器，运算量降低2.8倍至22.0倍。
AI.conclusion: CHEA在保持高估计精度的同时显著降低了计算复杂度，且单个训练模型即可支持不同PRB分配，无需重新训练，具有实际部署价值。
AI.abstract_zh: 基于注意力的神经估计器在信道估计中取得了优异的精度，但全局注意力在时频资源网格上的计算开销随子载波数量呈二次增长，且此类估计器通常绑定单一资源分配方案。本文提出信道估计注意力（CHEA），一种面向5G新无线电（5G NR）多用户多输入多输出（MU-MIMO）的低复杂度信道估计器。CHEA采用多分辨率窗口化设计替代全局注意力：高分辨率编码器保留局部导频细节，低分辨率编码器捕获更宽的频域上下文，局部交叉注意力解码器将该粗粒度上下文传递回高分辨率导频token。随后通过每物理资源块（PRB）上采样模块重建整个时隙的信道。由于所有注意力操作均限制在固定大小的窗口内，且重建按PRB进行，CHEA的计算复杂度随子载波数量线性增长，单个训练模型即可支持不同的PRB分配而无需重新训练。在符合标准的物理上行共享信道（PUSCH）上，CHEA在传统和最先进的神经估计器中取得了最低的均方误差（MSE），同时相比现有的注意力估计器，运算量降低了2.8倍至22.0倍。

title: From Weights to Words: Expressing and Editing Preference Model Inferences in Natural Language
comment: 42 pages, 22 figures, 14 tables; main text 11 pages, remainder appendices
summary: The growing use of statistical learning algorithms to infer human preferences from high-dimensional choice data runs up against a fundamental challenge: choice alternatives typically differ in many ways simultaneously, so it is generally unclear which factors actually drove an observed decision and should be credited as preferences. Compounding this problem, the opacity of these methods leaves human operators unable to inspect, contest, or correct models when they err. We introduce \emph{weights to words}, a method that takes a dataset of choice problems as input and automatically discovers a collection of domain-relevant preference dimensions, each described in natural language and paired with a vector in the model's representational space. These dimensions address both under-determination and opacity: they can be applied to concentrate attribution on a small set of meaningful factors, and they can externalize the model's inferences in natural language so that users can inspect and edit them in real time. We first qualitatively illustrate the method's versatility on four diverse domains: moral dilemmas, movies, wines, and free-form LLM responses. We then report two pre-registered human-subjects experiments, on moral dilemmas ($N=450$) and movie selection ($N=449$), that demonstrate its benefits for learning preference models: (1) regularizing a preference model toward the learned basis increases prediction accuracy on held-out choices, and (2) incorporating participants' structured edits further improves accuracy. In head-to-head comparisons, participants prefer the method's inferred preference profiles and endorse its predictions as more accurate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"weights to words"方法，能从高维选择数据中自动发现以自然语言描述的偏好维度，解决偏好学习中的欠定性和黑箱问题，实验证明该方法能提高预测准确性并获用户认可。
AI.motivation: 从高维选择数据推断人类偏好时存在两个核心挑战：一是选择选项在多维度上同时差异，导致难以确定哪些因素真正驱动了决策（欠定性）；二是统计学习算法的不透明性使人类无法检查、质疑或纠正模型错误。
AI.method: 提出"weights to words"方法，输入选择问题数据集，自动发现一组领域相关的偏好维度，每个维度以自然语言描述并配以模型表示空间中的对应向量。这些维度既可将归因集中在少数有意义的因素上，也可将模型推理外化为自然语言供用户实时检查和编辑。
AI.result: 在道德困境（N=450）和电影选择（N=449）两项预注册人类受试者实验中：(1) 将偏好模型向所学基正则化可提高对未见过选择的预测准确性；(2) 纳入参与者的结构化编辑可进一步提升准确性；在直接对比中，参与者偏好该方法推断的偏好画像并认为其预测更准确。
AI.conclusion: "weights to words"方法有效解决了偏好学习中的欠定性和黑箱问题，通过将偏好维度转化为可解释的自然语言表示，既提升了预测性能，又实现了模型推理的可检查和可编辑性。
AI.abstract_zh: 在从高维选择数据中推断人类偏好的过程中，统计学习算法的使用日益广泛，但这面临一个根本性挑战：选择选项通常在多个维度上同时存在差异，因此通常不清楚哪些因素真正驱动了观察到的决策、应被归因为偏好。雪上加霜的是，这些方法的不透明性使得人类操作员无法在模型出错时对其进行检查、质疑或纠正。我们引入了"weights to words"方法，该方法以选择问题数据集为输入，自动发现一组领域相关的偏好维度，每个维度以自然语言描述并配以模型表示空间中的对应向量。这些维度既解决了欠定性问题，也解决了不透明性问题：它们可以将归因集中在少数有意义的因素上，也可以将模型的推理外化为自然语言，使用户能够实时检查和编辑。我们首先在四个不同领域（道德困境、电影、葡萄酒和自由形式的大语言模型回答）上定性展示了该方法的多样性。随后我们报告了两项预注册的人类受试者实验，分别针对道德困境（N=450）和电影选择（N=449），证明了该方法在学习偏好模型方面的优势：(1) 将偏好模型向所学基正则化可提高对未见过选择的预测准确性；(2) 纳入参与者的结构化编辑可进一步提升准确性。在直接对比中，参与者更偏好该方法推断的偏好画像，并认为其预测更准确。

title: MAC 2026: Advancing Micro-Action Analysis Towards Fine-Grained Understanding
comment: Challenge Summary Paper of the 3rd Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge (MAC 2026) at ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Micro-Actions (MAs) are subtle and spontaneous human behaviors that provide important non-verbal cues in social interaction and affective communication. However, their short duration, weak motion patterns, and fine-grained semantic differences make them difficult to annotate, model, and evaluate in a standardized manner. To promote academic research on micro-action analysis, we proposed and have annually organized the Micro-Action Analysis Grand Challenge (MAC) as a public benchmark platform for this emerging field. The first two editions of MAC established standardized evaluation settings for micro-action recognition and detection, providing publicly accessible datasets and protocols. Building upon these editions, this paper presents the 3rd MAC, held in conjunction with ACM Multimedia 2026. Under the theme of moving from recognition to fine-grained micro-action understanding, this edition further expands the scope of the challenge beyond conventional recognition and detection.
