AI.abstract_zh: 长期记忆正成为大语言模型智能体的核心组件，但大多数记忆基准评估对话或紧凑摘要，而科研智能体需要从完整科学论文中恢复证据。我们引入了两个全文科学记忆基准：Public AI Memory（PAIM；81篇论文，66个问题）和Public Transformers（PTr；252篇论文，98个问题）。我们评估了包括我们提出的Theoria在内的八种记忆/检索系统，以及一个无检索基线。结果表明，如果没有完整的评估协议，记忆排行榜是不可解释的：摄入粒度、原始文本保留、检索预算、检索模态、评分审计和评判模型选择都会影响结果。例如，在PAIM上Graphiti明显领先，但每查询使用260万字符的检索上下文，控制检索预算后领先优势消失。在PTr上，对于可以干净添加BM25检索的系统，稀疏-密集混合是最重要的单一干预手段：Simple RAG、Mem0和Theoria的混合变体在0.03分内并列领先。多评判模型和人工侧对照校准表明，LLM作为评判者的排名在前沿评判模型之间一致，且与人类评估一致，在十分制量表上有效分辨率约为1分。我们认为科学记忆应作为带预算的、模态感知的上下文恢复来评估，而非无约束的架构排行榜，我们公开发布了数据集、测试工具、原始输出、评判结果和脚本，以复现我们的结果并作为此类评估的工具。我们的代码可在 http://gitlab.com/quantellence/research/scientific-recall-bench 获取，数据集可在 http://huggingface.co/datasets/quantellence/srb-data 获取。

title: Multi-Dimensional Quality Assessment for AI-Generated Human-Centric Videos: Dataset and Model
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE TCSVT, 2026
summary: AI-generated human-centric videos play a crucial role in a wide range of modern applications. However, they often suffer from quality issues and semantic mismatches, underscoring the importance of effective quality assessment for such videos. To this end, we extend our previous dataset HVEval with pairwise preference annotations, resulting in HVEval+, the largest holistic quality assessment dataset for AI-generated human-centric videos, which comprises 1k prompts based on a comprehensive taxonomy, 20k videos generated by 24 text-to-video (T2V) models, and extensive human annotations, including 60k mean opinion scores (MOSs) and 60k preference pairs across 3 dimensions (i.e., spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video correspondence), as well as 20k category-specific question-answer (Q&A) pairs. Along with the HVEval+ dataset, we further propose MoE-Rater, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-inspired and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based all-in-one method that supports multi-dimensional quality rating, multi-dimensional pairwise comparison, and category-specific question answering within a single model. Specifically, we introduce Mixture of Projector Experts (MoPE) and Mixture of LoRA Experts (MoLE), together with a three-stage training strategy consisting of task-aware pre-training, task-specific adaptation, and adaptive routing optimization, to effectively unify multiple tasks, resulting in superior performance on both HVEval+ and Human-AGVQA datasets. Extensive experiments and comprehensive analysis demonstrate the significant potential of the HVEval+ dataset and the MoE-Rater method in advancing AI-generated video quality assessment and further facilitating the evaluation and optimization of T2V models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HVEval+数据集（最大规模的AI生成人物视频质量评估数据集，含20K视频、60K MOS分数和偏好对）和MoE-Rater方法（基于混合专家和多模态大语言模型的多维度统一质量评估模型），在多个任务上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: AI生成的人物视频存在质量问题和语义不匹配，亟需有效的质量评估方法，但缺乏大规模、多维度、细粒度的评估数据集和统一的评估模型。
AI.method: 基于HVEval扩展构建HVEval+数据集（含60K MOS和偏好对、20K Q&A对）；提出MoE-Rater方法，包括Mixture of Projector Experts (MoPE)和Mixture of LoRA Experts (MoLE)，以及三阶段训练策略（任务感知预训练、任务特定适配、自适应路由优化），在单一MLLM中统一支持多维度质量评分、成对比较和问答任务。
AI.result: 在HVEval+和Human-AGVQA数据集上取得优越性能，实验全面验证了数据集和方法在推动AI生成视频质量评估及T2V模型评估优化方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: HVEval+数据集和MoE-Rater方法在AI生成视频质量评估领域具有重要潜力，能够有效促进文本生成视频模型的评估与优化。
AI.abstract_zh: AI生成的人物视频在现代应用的广泛领域中扮演着关键角色。然而，这些视频常常存在质量问题和语义不匹配，凸显了对此类视频进行有效质量评估的重要性。为此，我们将先前的工作HVEval数据集扩展了成对偏好标注，形成了HVEval+——目前最大规模的AI生成人物视频整体质量评估数据集。该数据集包含基于全面分类体系的1000条提示词、由24种文本生成视频模型生成的20000个视频，以及大规模人工标注，包括跨三个维度（空间质量、时间质量和文本-视频对应性）的60000个平均意见分数和60000个偏好对，以及20000个类别特定的问答对。伴随HVEval+数据集，我们进一步提出了MoE-Rater，一种受混合专家启发、基于多模态大语言模型的统一方法，支持在单一模型中进行多维度质量评分、多维度成对比较和类别特定的问答。具体而言，我们引入了投影器专家混合和LoRA专家混合，结合三阶段训练策略（包括任务感知预训练、任务特定适配和自适应路由优化），有效统一了多个任务，在HVEval+和Human-AGVQA数据集上均取得了优越性能。大量实验和综合分析表明，HVEval+数据集和MoE-Rater方法在推动AI生成视频质量评估以及进一步促进文本生成视频模型的评估与优化方面具有重要潜力。

title: Principled Direction-Free Intrinsic Motivation through Model-Free Epistemic Free-Energy Estimators
comment: Accepted for a Spotlight Presentation at IWAI 2026
summary: Across environments with mixed sources of uncertainty, unsupervised reinforcement learning requires intrinsic motivation that does not precommit to a particular direction of surprise. Surprise minimization is scoped by design to ``unstable'' environments. Prediction-error curiosity rewards total expected surprise, including irreducible noise. Bandit or mixture switching between surprise-minimizing and surprise-maximizing rewards reintroduces non-stationarity by construction. We propose a single intrinsic reward, stationary within each window, derived from the novelty contribution of a preference-free Expected Free Energy objective, expressed in reward-maximization form. Our claim is that parameter information gain, the expected surprise of the next state minus its irreducible part, is the appropriate intrinsic signal in both high-entropy and low-entropy components of the state space. Maximizing it seeks exactly the surprise the model can explain away. In regions of unresolved dynamics, this epistemic term drives exploration. As dynamics become resolved, the epistemic term vanishes, while an aleatoric penalty favors lower-variance transitions, all without fitting an explicit next-state predictor. A pseudocount supplies epistemic value, a probe-based penalty captures aleatoric variance, and a short-horizon gate protects informative successors. A window-based freeze of all reward-defining objects yields a stationary Bellman operator, explicit bounds on learning targets, and a conditional uniform-concentration result for the nonparametric estimators under mixing, smoothness, bandwidth, and capacity assumptions. In active-inference terms, the agent is preference-free where novelty is retained, standard likelihood ambiguity vanishes under full observability, a nonstandard transition-entropy penalty is added, and surprise minimization emerges in resolved regions of the state space.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于预期自由能新奇贡献度的单一内在奖励，替代传统惊悚最小化/最大化切换方法，在混合不确定性环境中实现无偏好强化学习，通过窗口冻结机制保证贝尔曼算子的平稳性。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督强化学习的内在动机方法存在缺陷：惊悚最小化局限于不稳定环境；预测误差好奇心会奖励不可约噪声；惊悚最小化与最大化之间的切换本质上引入非平稳性。需要一种单一、平稳的内在奖励信号。
AI.method: 从无偏好预期自由能目标出发，推导出其奖励最大化形式，提取其中新奇贡献度（参数信息增益）作为内在奖励。该信号等于下一状态的预期惊悚减去不可约噪声部分。用伪计数提供认知价值，探针惩罚捕获偶然方差，短视门保护信息性后继状态。窗口冻结机制固定所有奖励定义对象，保证贝尔曼算子平稳性。
AI.result: 在混合假设（混合性、光滑性、带宽、容量）下，为非参数估计器建立了条件均匀集中结果，给出了显式的学习目标边界，证明了窗口冻结机制产生平稳贝尔曼算子。
AI.conclusion: 参数信息增益是混合不确定性环境中合适的内在信号：在未解决动力学区域驱动探索，在已解决区域消失并由偶然惩罚替代，无需显式拟合下一状态预测器。该方法是无偏好的，在已解决区域自然涌现惊悚最小化行为。
AI.abstract_zh: 在具有混合不确定性来源的环境中，无监督强化学习需要不预先承诺特定惊悚方向的内在动机。惊悚最小化在设计上局限于“不稳定”环境。预测误差好奇心会奖励包括不可约噪声在内的总预期惊悚。惊悚最小化与最大化之间的臂架或混合切换在构造上重新引入了非平稳性。我们提出一种单一的内在奖励，在每个窗口内平稳，该奖励来源于无偏好预期自由能目标的新奇贡献度，并以奖励最大化形式表达。我们的主张是：参数信息增益——下一状态的预期惊悚减去其不可约部分——是状态空间中高熵和低熵分量中合适的内在信号。最大化它恰好寻求模型可以解释掉的那部分惊悚。在未解析动力学区域，这一认知项驱动探索。随着动力学被解析，认知项消失，而偶然性惩罚偏好更低方差的转移，所有这些都无需拟合显式的下一状态预测器。伪计数提供认知价值，基于探针的惩罚捕获偶然方差，短视门保护信息性后继状态。基于窗口冻结所有奖励定义对象产生平稳的贝尔曼算子、学习目标的显式边界，以及在混合性、光滑性、带宽和容量假设下非参数估计器的条件均匀集中结果。在主动推理术语中，该代理在保留新奇性时是无偏好的，在完全可观测性下标准似然模糊性消失，添加了非标准的转移熵惩罚，并且在状态空间的已解析区域中涌现出惊悚最小化。

title: VisionAssist: An Open-Source Smartphone Assistant for AI-Based Visual Accessibility
summary: People with low vision often face challenges in performing everyday tasks that require interpreting visual information. We present \textbf{VisionAssist}, an open-source mobile application designed to improve independence by providing AI-powered visual assistance through a smartphone. The application integrates three complementary functionalities within a single interface. First, it enables users to locate specific objects by analyzing the live camera feed. Second, it generates spoken descriptions of captured images, allowing users to identify visual content such as food labels, documents, and everyday objects. Third, it integrates with the smartphone's contacts and calendar to facilitate emergency calls and provide voice-based reminders. The application supports hands-free interaction through voice commands and delivers all feedback using text-to-speech synthesis, making it fully accessible to users with visual impairments. By combining multiple assistive services into a unified platform and releasing the project as open-source software, the proposed solution aims to encourage community contributions and accelerate the development of accessible technologies. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/AOzlemC/LowVisionProject.git

AI.tldr: VisionAssist是一款开源移动应用，集成了物体定位、图像描述生成、紧急呼叫与语音提醒三大功能，通过语音命令和文本转语音实现免提交互，旨在帮助低视力用户更独立地处理日常视觉任务。
AI.motivation: 低视力人群在日常生活中解读视觉信息常常面临困难，现有辅助工具功能分散、缺乏统一平台，且闭源软件限制了社区贡献和技术发展。
AI.method: 开发了一款集成三种互补功能的开源移动应用：(1) 实时分析摄像头画面定位物体；(2) 为拍摄图像生成语音描述，识别食物标签、文件、日常物品等；(3) 整合手机通讯录和日历功能实现紧急呼叫与语音提醒。支持语音命令控制，所有反馈通过文本转语音输出。
AI.result: 论文未提供定量实验结果，主要贡献在于提出并实现了一个集成多功能、完全可访问、开源的低视力辅助系统原型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多种辅助服务整合到统一平台并以开源方式发布，VisionAssist旨在鼓励社区贡献，加速无障碍技术的发展。
AI.abstract_zh: 低视力人群在完成需要解读视觉信息的日常任务时往往面临挑战。本文提出\textbf{VisionAssist}，一款开源移动应用，旨在通过智能手机提供AI驱动的视觉辅助来提升用户独立性。该应用在单一界面内集成了三种互补功能：第一，它能够通过分析实时摄像头画面帮助用户定位特定物体；第二，它能够为拍摄图像生成语音描述，使用户可以识别诸如食品标签、文件及日常物品等视觉内容；第三，它整合了手机的通讯录和日历功能，以便进行紧急呼叫和提供语音提醒。该应用支持通过语音命令实现免提交互，并通过文本转语音合成提供所有反馈，从而对视障用户完全可访问。通过将多种辅助服务整合到统一平台并以开源软件形式发布，该方案旨在鼓励社区贡献，加速无障碍技术的发展。源代码公开于：https://github.com/AOzlemC/LowVisionProject.git

title: Bridging battery design and health assessment through virtual sensing and physics-informed learning
summary: Supercharging of lithium-ion batteries (LiBs) requires robust health monitoring to ensure durability, safety, and user confidence, particularly for emerging vehicle-to-grid applications with bidirectional energy flows. Yet battery management remains largely disconnected from the material and structural origins of aging, limiting both interpretable health assessment and informed battery design. Here we propose a physics-informed learning framework with virtual sensing that infers hard-to-measure design parameters, including solid-state diffusion coefficient, electrode thickness, ion concentration, and particle size, directly from standard battery management system (BMS) measurements. Across diverse fast-charging strategies and driving profiles, embedding a digital-twin-derived particle-cracking mechanism as a soft constraint reduces trajectory and lifetime prediction errors by 6-8 times relative to state-of-the-art machine learning baselines using only 2% early-life observations. We further show that accurate degradation extrapolation does not require fully resolved governing equations; validated partial mechanisms, jointly refined with limited data, provide sufficient guidance. Virtual sensing transforms standard charging signals into latent design variables without additional sensors, bridging observable battery behavior and underlying aging processes while reducing capacity loss error by up to 39%, end-of-life (EOL) error by 17%, and prediction variability by up to 54%, enabling real-time exploration of new battery configurations. More broadly, the proposed framework establishes a practical feedback loop between deployment and development, demonstrating how real-world operation can continuously inform upstream design decisions across complex multiphysics systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理信息学习框架，利用虚拟传感从BMS标准测量中推断锂电池难以测量的设计参数（如扩散系数、电极厚度等），将数字孪生导出的颗粒开裂机制作为软约束，仅用2%早期数据即可将轨迹和寿命预测误差降低6-8倍，并实现实时探索新电池配置。
AI.motivation: 当前电池管理系统与老化的材料和结构起源脱节，限制了可解释的健康评估和知情电池设计，亟需一种能够从标准BMS测量中推断隐藏设计参数、连接电池行为与老化过程的框架。
AI.method: 提出物理信息学习框架，结合虚拟传感技术，从标准BMS测量中推断固态扩散系数、电极厚度、离子浓度和颗粒尺寸等设计参数；嵌入数字孪生导出的颗粒开裂机制作为软约束，利用部分验证的物理机制与有限数据联合优化。
AI.result: 仅用2%早期观测数据，轨迹和寿命预测误差比最先进ML基线降低6-8倍；容量损失误差降低39%，寿命终点（EOL）误差降低17%，预测变异性降低54%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在部署与开发之间建立了实用的反馈回路，证明实际运行数据可以持续为上游设计决策提供信息，无需完全解析控制方程，部分验证的物理机制联合有限数据即可提供足够指导。
AI.abstract_zh: 锂离子电池的超级充电需要稳健的健康监测以确保耐久性、安全性和用户信心，特别是对于新兴的车网互联双向能量流应用。然而，电池管理在很大程度上仍与老化的材料和结构起源脱节，限制了可解释的健康评估和知情的电池设计。本文提出一种物理信息学习框架，结合虚拟传感技术，直接从标准电池管理系统测量中推断难以测量的设计参数，包括固态扩散系数、电极厚度、离子浓度和颗粒尺寸。在不同的快充策略和驾驶工况下，将数字孪生导出的颗粒开裂机制作为软约束嵌入，仅使用2%的早期观测数据，即可将轨迹和寿命预测误差相对于最先进的机器学习基线降低6-8倍。我们进一步表明，准确的退化外推并不需要完全解析的控制方程；经过验证的部分机制与有限数据联合优化，即可提供足够指导。虚拟传感将标准充电信号转化为潜在设计变量，无需额外传感器，桥接了可观察的电池行为与底层老化过程，同时将容量损失误差降低39%，寿命终点误差降低17%，预测变异性降低54%，实现了对新电池配置的实时探索。更广泛地，该框架在部署与开发之间建立了实用的反馈回路，展示了实际运行如何持续为上游设计决策提供信息，适用于复杂多物理系统。

title: Hybrid Machine Learning for Articulation Angle Estimation of Truck-Semitrailer Combinations
comment: Accepted for publication at 2026 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: Accurate articulation angle estimation of trucks with trailers is critical for autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance system (ADAS). Existing methods either require manual initialization, additional sensors, or prior knowledge and signals from trailers, or they lack real-world validation, limiting practical deployment. This paper presents multiple learning-based models to directly estimate articulation angles from visual and kinematic inputs, eliminating the need for dedicated driving maneuvers for initialization, bounding box annotations, trailer-mounted sensor signals, or prior knowledge of trailer parameters. Two learning-based models are integrated with a kinematic model within an extended Kalman filter (EKF) framework, and an adaptive weighting scheme based on uncertainty quantification is applied for measurements involving visual input. Extensive real-world experiments with different trailer types demonstrate the approaches' robustness and generalization under out-of-domain conditions, including new trailers, varying colors, and lighting conditions. Results show that the hybrid method achieves accurate and reliable articulation angle estimation while maintaining reduced implementation requirements and practical deployment advantages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于学习的卡车-拖车铰接角估计方法，结合视觉与运动学输入及扩展卡尔曼滤波框架，无需手动初始化、额外传感器或拖车先验知识，在真实场景中验证了鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有铰接角估计方法要么需要手动初始化、额外传感器、拖车先验知识或信号，要么缺乏真实世界验证，限制了实际部署。本文旨在消除这些限制，实现无需专用初始化、边界框标注、拖车传感器信号或拖车参数先验的准确估计。
AI.method: 本文提出多种基于学习的模型，直接从视觉和运动学输入估计铰接角，并将两个学习模型与运动学模型集成到扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）框架中，同时基于不确定性量化设计自适应加权方案处理视觉输入测量。
AI.result: 在多种拖车类型上进行了广泛真实世界实验，结果表明该方法在域外条件（包括新型拖车、不同颜色和光照条件）下具有鲁棒性和泛化能力，实现了准确且可靠的铰接角估计。
AI.conclusion: 混合方法在保持较低实现要求和实际部署优势的同时，实现了准确可靠的铰接角估计，验证了该方法的实用价值和部署可行性。
AI.abstract_zh: 对于配备拖车的卡车，准确的铰接角估计对于自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）至关重要。现有方法要么需要手动初始化、额外传感器、拖车的先验知识或信号，要么缺乏真实世界验证，限制了实际部署。本文提出了多种基于学习的模型，直接从视觉和运动学输入估计铰接角，无需专用驾驶操作进行初始化、边界框标注、拖车安装的传感器信号或拖车参数的先验知识。两个基于学习的模型与一个运动学模型集成在扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）框架内，并基于不确定性量化设计了自适应加权方案处理涉及视觉输入的测量。针对不同拖车类型的广泛真实世界实验表明，该方法在域外条件（包括新型拖车、不同颜色和光照条件）下具有鲁棒性和泛化能力。结果表明，混合方法在降低实现要求并保持实际部署优势的同时，实现了准确可靠的铰接角估计。

title: HyBDM: Multi-Scale Hybrid Experts for Time Series Forecasting with Bidirectional Dependency Modeling
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) is vital to many applications, yet existing models often struggle to capture the heterogeneous long-range global patterns and short-range local variations in multivariate time series. While some approaches partially model these dependencies, they often do not jointly exploit temporal and feature-wise information. To address this challenge, we propose HyBDM, a multi-scale hybrid model that decomposes temporal dynamics into global patterns and local variations, which are modeled by two specialized experts. The Global Patterns Expert employs an enhanced BiConv-Mamba module that integrates bidirectional convolutions, an M-SSM layer, a forgetting mechanism, and a GDD-MLP module for cross-channel modeling. The Local Variations Expert uses a Local Window Transformer (LWT) to perform efficient locality-aware attention with reduced computational complexity. In addition, a Multi-Scale Patcher and a Long-Short Router enable multi-resolution representations and adaptive fusion of the two experts. Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that HyBDM outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating its effectiveness in bridging global-local dependencies for multivariate TSF.

AI.tldr: HyBDM是一种多尺度混合模型，通过全局模式专家（BiConv-Mamba模块）和局部变化专家（局部窗口Transformer）联合建模多元时间序列中的全局和局部依赖，在六个基准数据集上超越SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型难以同时捕捉多元时间序列中的异质性长程全局模式和短程局部变化，且多数方法未能联合利用时间和特征维度的信息。
AI.method: 提出HyBDM多尺度混合模型：(1) 全局模式专家使用增强型BiConv-Mamba模块，集成双向卷积、M-SSM层、遗忘机制和GDD-MLP跨通道建模；(2) 局部变化专家使用局部窗口Transformer（LWT）进行高效局部注意力计算；(3) 多尺度分块器（Multi-Scale Patcher）和长短路由（Long-Short Router）实现多分辨率表示和两专家的自适应融合。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的实验表明，HyBDM在预测精度和计算效率上均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: HyBDM有效桥接了多元时间序列预测中的全局-局部依赖关系，展示了混合建模策略在提升预测性能方面的优势。
AI.abstract_zh: 时间序列预测（TSF）对许多应用至关重要，然而现有模型通常难以捕捉多元时间序列中异质的长程全局模式和短程局部变化。虽然一些方法部分建模了这些依赖关系，但它们往往未能联合利用时间和特征维度的信息。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了HyBDM，一种多尺度混合模型，它将时间动态分解为全局模式和局部变化，由两个专门化专家分别建模。全局模式专家采用增强型BiConv-Mamba模块，集成了双向卷积、M-SSM层、遗忘机制和用于跨通道建模的GDD-MLP模块。局部变化专家采用局部窗口Transformer（LWT），以降低的计算复杂度执行高效的局部感知注意力。此外，多尺度分块器和长短路由实现了多分辨率表示以及两个专家的自适应融合。在六个基准数据集上的实验表明，HyBDM在预测精度和计算效率方面均优于现有最先进方法，证明了其在桥接多元TSF中全局-局部依赖关系的有效性。

title: Spatiotemporal Facial Action Unit Detection using Twin Cycle Autoencoders for Driver Monitoring
summary: Driver monitoring systems (DMS) increasingly rely on facial cues to infer drowsiness, distraction, and cognitive load in real time. Facial Action Units (AUs), grounded in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), provide an objective and interpretable representation of such states, but their automatic detection in the driving context is complicated by low and variable illumination, partial occlusion, head-pose variation, and the subtlety and short duration of relevant AU activations. Existing AU detectors largely treat spatial appearance and temporal dynamics separately, limiting their ability to exploit self-supervisory signal from abundant unlabeled driving video. We propose the Twin Cycle Autoencoder (TCA), a spatiotemporal architecture composed of two coupled cycle-consistent autoencoder branches: a Spatial Cycle Autoencoder that disentangles AU-relevant appearance from identity through image-level cycle consistency, and a Temporal Cycle Autoencoder that enforces forward-backward consistency over latent AU trajectories to capture onset-apex-offset dynamics. The two branches are coupled through a cross-branch latent alignment loss and fused via an attention module before multi-label AU classification. We evaluate TCA on the DISFA and BP4D benchmarks and on an in-cabin naturalistic driving dataset, and observe consistent improvements over CNN-RNN, 3D-CNN, and graph-based AU baselines, particularly for low-intensity and rapidly transitioning AUs relevant to fatigue (AU45, AU43) and yawning (AU26). We further show the model sustains real-time throughput on an embedded Jetson Xavier NX platform, supporting its use in production-grade advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS).

AI.tldr: 提出双循环自编码器（TCA），一种结合空间与时间循环一致性的自监督框架，用于驾驶场景下面部动作单元（AU）的实时检测，在低光照、遮挡等挑战下优于现有方法，并可在嵌入式平台实时运行。
AI.motivation: 现有AU检测器大多将空间外观与时间动态分开处理，难以充分利用大量无标签驾驶视频中的自监督信号；同时，驾驶环境下存在光照变化、部分遮挡、头部姿态变化以及AU激活微弱且短暂等挑战，亟需一种既能建模时空信息又具备自监督能力的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出双循环自编码器（TCA），包含两个耦合的循环一致自编码分支：空间循环自编码器（通过图像级循环一致性将AU相关外观与身份信息解耦）和时间循环自编码器（通过前向-后向一致性约束潜空间AU轨迹，建模onset-apex-offset动态）；两分支通过跨分支潜空间对齐损失耦合，并经过注意力模块融合后进行多标签AU分类。
AI.result: 在DISFA、BP4D基准和自然驾驶数据集上，TCA在AU检测上优于CNN-RNN、3D-CNN和基于图的方法，尤其对低强度、快速转变的疲劳相关AU（AU45眨眼、AU43闭眼、AU26打哈欠）提升显著；在Jetson Xavier NX嵌入式平台上可实现实时推理。
AI.conclusion: TCA通过双分支循环一致的自监督架构有效建模了面部AU的时空特性，在驾驶场景下实现鲁棒且高效的AU检测，具备部署到生产级ADAS系统的潜力。
AI.abstract_zh: 驾驶员监控系统（DMS）日益依赖面部线索实时推断困倦、分心和认知负荷。基于面部动作编码系统（FACS）的面部动作单元（AU）提供了此类状态的客观且可解释的表示，但在驾驶场景中自动检测AU面临低光照与可变光照、部分遮挡、头部姿态变化以及相关AU激活的微弱性和短时性等挑战。现有AU检测器大多将空间外观与时间动态分开处理，限制了其利用大量无标签驾驶视频中自监督信号的能力。我们提出双循环自编码器（TCA），一种由两个耦合的循环一致自编码分支组成的时空架构：空间循环自编码器通过图像级循环一致性将AU相关外观与身份解耦；时间循环自编码器通过对潜空间AU轨迹施加前向-后向一致性约束来捕捉onset-apex-offset动态。两个分支通过跨分支潜空间对齐损失耦合，并经由注意力模块融合后进行多标签AU分类。我们在DISFA和BP4D基准以及一个车内自然驾驶数据集上评估TCA，观察到其相对于CNN-RNN、3D-CNN和基于图的AU基线方法具有一致的性能提升，尤其对疲劳相关（AU45、AU43）和打哈欠相关（AU26）的低强度、快速转变的AU提升显著。我们进一步展示了该模型在嵌入式Jetson Xavier NX平台上可维持实时吞吐量，支持其在生产级高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）中的应用。

title: Certified-Gap Dual-Price Policies for Real-Time Truckload Bid Acceptance with Relocating, Clock-Constrained Resources
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure. Companion benchmark paper: arXiv:2607.07343
summary: A truckload carrier must accept or reject each load tender within seconds. The decision depends on fleet state, hours-of-service (HOS) clocks, and appointment windows. We model this as a weakly coupled dynamic program in which the resources relocate and carry clocks: serving a request moves the truck to a new market and depletes its clocks, and whether a truck can serve a request depends on its state. Occupancy-based reusable-resource models do not cover this setting. We build a real-time dual-price policy from the same Lagrangian relaxation that gives the problem's upper bound. Policy and bound come from one object, so every run reports a certified optimality gap. We prove three things. First, the certificate is valid for any duals, any discretization, and any surrogate quality. Second, the policy's same-time spatial-gradient rule is exactly fluid complementary slackness, and the policy is asymptotically optimal in the subcritical fluid regime; the fitted prices are also portable across sample paths, by linear-programming basis stability. Third, certificates have limits: per-resource Lagrangian slack can stay bounded away from zero at every fleet size. We exhibit a three-truck kernel with an exact rational certificate and a replication lemma. On a public closed-loop benchmark with thirty paired seeds, the policy -- which needs no rollout labels, only one offline dual solve -- beats a rollout-trained surrogate on two of three scenarios (tight: +2.0 pp, 95% CI [+0.5, +3.6], Wilcoxon p = 0.023; mild: +3.5 pp, CI [+2.4, +4.5]) and ties the third. It decides in 0.04-0.09 ms, three orders of magnitude faster than the Monte Carlo rollout teacher. Its certificates are stable across ten bounded instances per scenario, at 57-64% of optimal, within 3-6 points of what the 1000x-slower teacher certifies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于拉格朗日松弛的实时对偶价格策略，用于解决卡车运输中带有服务时间（HOS）时钟和预约窗口的弱耦合动态规划问题。该策略与问题上界来自同一对象，每次运行都能报告认证最优间隙，在三个公开基准场景中的两个上优于基于rollout训练的代理，决策速度比蒙特卡洛rollout教师快三个数量级。
AI.motivation: 卡车运输中，承运人需在数秒内决定是否接受每项货运请求，该决策依赖于车队状态、驾驶员服务时间时钟和预约窗口。现有的基于占用的可重用资源模型无法覆盖这一场景，因此需要一种既能实时决策又能提供最优性保证的新方法。
AI.method: 将问题建模为弱耦合动态规划，其中资源（卡车）可迁移并携带时钟。从提供问题上界的相同拉格朗日松弛中构建实时对偶价格策略。该策略使用同时间空间梯度规则（恰好是流体互补松弛条件），通过一次离线对偶求解即可运行，无需rollout标签。
AI.result: 在包含30对配对种子的公开闭环基准上，该策略在三个场景中的两个上击败了基于rollout训练的代理（紧场景：+2.0个百分点，95% CI [+0.5, +3.6]；温和场景：+3.5个百分点，CI [+2.4, +4.5]），第三个场景持平。决策时间仅0.04-0.09毫秒，比蒙特卡洛rollout教师快三个数量级。认证间隙稳定在最优值的57-64%之间，与慢1000倍的教师认证结果相差仅3-6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 证明了所提证书对任意对偶变量、任意离散化和任意替代质量均有效；该策略在亚临界流体 regime 中渐近最优；但证书存在局限性——每个资源的拉格朗日松弛可能在任何车队规模下都远离零。认证间隙有基本极限，并通过三卡车核和复制引理进行了说明。
AI.abstract_zh: 卡车运输承运人必须在数秒内接受或拒绝每项货运请求。该决策取决于车队状态、服务时间（HOS）时钟和预约窗口。我们将其建模为一个弱耦合动态规划问题，其中资源（卡车）可以移动并携带时钟：服务一个请求会将卡车转移到新市场并消耗其时钟，而卡车能否服务一个请求取决于其状态。基于占用的可重用资源模型无法覆盖这一场景。我们从给出问题上界的相同拉格朗日松弛中构建了一种实时对偶价格策略。策略和上界来自同一对象，因此每次运行都能报告一个认证最优间隙。我们证明了三点：第一，该证书对任意对偶变量、任意离散化和任意替代质量均有效；第二，该策略的同时间空间梯度规则恰好是流体互补松弛条件，且该策略在亚临界流体 regime 中渐近最优；拟合价格还通过线性规划基稳定性在样本路径间可迁移；第三，证书存在局限性：每个资源的拉格朗日松弛可能在任何车队规模下都远离零。我们展示了一个具有精确有理数证书的三卡车核和一个复制引理。在包含30对配对种子的公开闭环基准上，该策略——无需rollout标签，仅需一次离线对偶求解——在三个场景中的两个上击败了基于rollout训练的代理（紧场景：+2.0个百分点，95% CI [+0.5, +3.6]，Wilcoxon p = 0.023；温和场景：+3.5个百分点，CI [+2.4, +4.5]），第三个场景持平。其决策时间为0.04-0.09毫秒，比蒙特卡洛rollout教师快三个数量级。其证书在每场景十个有界实例上保持稳定，达到最优值的57-64%，与慢1000倍的教师所认证的结果相差仅3-6个百分点。

title: HTT-Net: Hierarchical Text-guided Transition Modeling for Surgical Video Phase Recognition
summary: Surgical video phase recognition is a fundamental task in computer-assisted intervention, supporting workflow understanding, intraoperative guidance, and surgical quality assessment. Although recent visual-temporal models have achieved promising progress, accurate and temporally coherent phase recognition remains challenging due to local visual ambiguity, transient prediction noise, and insufficient use of procedural semantics. To address these challenges, we propose HTT-Net, a Hierarchical Text-guided Transition modeling Network for surgical video phase recognition. The key idea is to introduce structured surgical semantic knowledge into phase-aware segment construction and semantic refinement. Specifically, we construct a hierarchical surgical semantic memory with intra-phase descriptions, inter-phase transition descriptions, and fine-grained semantic units. Based on this memory, the proposed Transition-Aware Segment Construction (TAS-Con) organizes frame-level evidence into coherent segment representations and handles boundary clips with inter-phase transition descriptions. Furthermore, we introduce Transition-Aware Segment Calibration (TAS-Calib), which calibrates phase-aware segment representations through hierarchical surgical semantics and improves discrimination under visual ambiguity without dense frame-level vision-language fusion. Experiments on Cholec80 and LCRS-100 demonstrate the effectiveness of HTT-Net for robust surgical video phase recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HTT-Net，一种层次化文本引导的过渡建模网络，用于手术视频阶段识别。通过构建层次化手术语义记忆（包含阶段内描述、阶段间过渡描述和细粒度语义单元），以及过渡感知片段构建（TAS-Con）和过渡感知片段校准（TAS-Calib）两大模块，有效缓解了局部视觉模糊、预测噪声和过程语义利用不足等问题。在Cholec80和LCRS-100数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前手术视频阶段识别方法存在的三大问题：局部视觉模糊、瞬时预测噪声以及对手术过程语义信息利用不足，导致识别结果在时间上不够连贯、准确度受限。
AI.method: 提出HTT-Net，核心包括：(1) 构建层次化手术语义记忆，包含阶段内描述、阶段间过渡描述和细粒度语义单元；(2) 过渡感知片段构建（TAS-Con），利用阶段间过渡描述处理边界剪辑，将帧级证据组织为连贯的片段表示；(3) 过渡感知片段校准（TAS-Calib），通过层次化手术语义校准阶段感知的片段表示，在不依赖密集帧级视觉-语言融合的情况下提升对视觉模糊的判别能力。
AI.result: 在Cholec80和LCRS-100两个公开数据集上的实验结果表明，HTT-Net在手术视频阶段识别任务上取得了鲁棒且优异的效果，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化手术语义知识并构建层次化引导机制，HTT-Net有效提升了手术视频阶段识别的准确性和时间连贯性，为计算机辅助干预中的工作流理解、术中引导和手术质量评估提供了有力支持。
AI.abstract_zh: 手术视频阶段识别是计算机辅助干预中的一项基础任务，支持工作流理解、术中引导和手术质量评估。尽管近期的视觉-时序模型已取得显著进展，但由于局部视觉模糊、瞬时预测噪声以及对手术过程语义信息利用不足，准确且时间连贯的阶段识别仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了HTT-Net——一种面向手术视频阶段识别的层次化文本引导过渡建模网络。其核心思想是将结构化的手术语义知识引入到阶段感知的片段构建和语义校准中。具体而言，我们构建了一个层次化手术语义记忆，包含阶段内描述、阶段间过渡描述以及细粒度语义单元。基于该记忆，所提出的过渡感知片段构建（TAS-Con）将帧级证据组织为连贯的片段表示，并利用阶段间过渡描述处理边界剪辑。此外，我们引入了过渡感知片段校准（TAS-Calib），通过层次化手术语义校准阶段感知的片段表示，在不依赖密集帧级视觉-语言融合的情况下提升视觉模糊下的判别能力。在Cholec80和LCRS-100上的实验证明了HTT-Net在鲁棒手术视频阶段识别中的有效性。

title: TVGL-CFM:Generating and Forecasting Time-Varying Trajectories of Dynamic Networks with Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Many complex systems such as brain networks, financial markets, and gene-regulatory circuits are described not by a fixed graph but by one that changes over time. A standard way to summarise such structure at each instant is the sparse precision (inverse-covariance) matrix, and the time-varying graphical lasso (TVGL) turns a multivariate signal into a smooth chain of these matrices. We introduce TVGL-CFM, a single model that learns the distribution of such chains and can both generate new, realistic time-varying network trajectories for a given class and forecast how an observed trajectory will continue. Each precision matrix lives on a curved space of positive-definite matrices, but a log-Euclidean chart flattens an entire trajectory into an ordinary vector space, so a simple conditional flow-matching model can be trained and sampled there while every decoded matrix is guaranteed to be a valid precision matrix. For forecasting we start the flow not from noise but from a rough extrapolation of the recent history, so the model only has to learn a small correction. Across EEG motor-imagery, chaotic systems, and gene-expression data, TVGL-CFM generates trajectories that keep the class-discriminative structure of real data, and it forecasts future connectivity more accurately than raw-signal baselines. Generating the structured precision trajectory directly is therefore more faithful than generating raw signals and estimating connectivity afterwards.

AI.tldr: 提出TVGL-CFM模型，利用条件流匹配模型在Log-Euclidean空间中对时变精度矩阵链进行生成与预测，能够直接生成具有类别判别性的动态网络结构，并在EEG、混沌系统和基因表达数据上优于从原始信号估计连接性的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 许多复杂系统（如脑网络、金融市场、基因调控回路）的结构随时间动态变化，现有方法通常先估计原始信号再推导连接性，但这种方式不够直接且可能丢失结构信息。因此需要一种能够直接生成和预测时变精度矩阵链的生成模型。
AI.method: 首先利用时间变化图套索（TVGL）将多变量信号转化为平滑的精度矩阵链；然后通过Log-Euclidean映射将每个正定矩阵平展到普通向量空间；最后在该空间中训练一个条件流匹配（conditional flow-matching）模型。对于预测任务，流从粗略外推的近期历史起始而非从噪声开始，模型只需学习小幅度修正。
AI.result: 在EEG运动想象、混沌系统和基因表达数据上，TVGL-CFM生成的轨迹保留了真实数据的类别判别性结构，并且在预测未来连接性方面优于基于原始信号的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接生成结构化的精度矩阵轨迹比先生成原始信号再估计连接性更加忠实可靠，TVGL-CFM为动态网络建模提供了一种有效且可泛化的生成式框架。
AI.abstract_zh: 许多复杂系统，如脑网络、金融市场和基因调控回路，并非由固定图描述，而是随时间变化。总结每个时刻这种结构的标准方法是稀疏精度（逆协方差）矩阵，而时间变化图套索（TVGL）将多变量信号转化为这些矩阵的光滑链。我们提出TVGL-CFM，这是一个能够学习此类链分布的单一模型，既可以针对给定类别生成新的、逼真的时变网络轨迹，也可以预测观测轨迹将如何延续。每个精度矩阵位于正定矩阵的弯曲空间上，但Log-Euclidean图表将整个轨迹平展为普通向量空间，因此可以在该空间上训练和采样一个简单的条件流匹配模型，同时确保每个解码矩阵都是有效的精度矩阵。在预测任务中，我们从噪声出发改为从近期历史的粗略外推出发，因此模型只需学习一个小幅修正。在EEG运动想象、混沌系统和基因表达数据上，TVGL-CFM生成的轨迹保留了真实数据的类别判别性结构，并且比基于原始信号的基线方法更准确地预测未来的连接性。因此，直接生成结构化的精度轨迹比生成原始信号后再估计连接性更加忠实可靠。

title: Scene-SAM3D: Multi-View Scene Asset Generation Without Fine-Tuning
summary: High-quality 3D scene assets are critical for embodied applications such as robotic manipulation, navigation, and simulation. Despite their strong object priors, recent single-image 3D generation models such as SAM3D remain insufficient for real-world scenes, where severe occlusions, redundant observations, and cross-view inconsistencies make reliable scene generation challenging. We introduce Scene-SAM3D, a training-free framework that extends SAM3D from single-view object generation to calibrated multi-view scene asset generation. Scene-SAM3D selects a compact set of complementary views, reducing observation redundancy while providing additional evidence for regions occluded in individual views. Based on the selected views, it performs step-efficient latent velocity fusion to integrate multi-view evidence and suppress cross-view conflicts in canonical space. Finally, a lightweight rigid-object Gaussian optimization refines the scene layout within 200 iterations while preserving the generated object geometry. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate consistent improvements at both instance and scene levels, with our method reducing scene-level CD by 43.8% on Replica and 30.9% on ScanNet++, while cutting flow-model sampling FLOPs and wall-time latency by nearly 20% under the same multi-view setting. Code will be released at https://github.com/xibi777/Scene-SAM3D.

AI.tldr: Scene-SAM3D 是一个无需训练的框架，将单视图3D物体生成扩展为多视图场景资产生成，通过紧凑视图选择、潜在速度融合和轻量级高斯优化，显著提升场景级3D生成质量，同时降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像3D生成模型（如SAM3D）在处理真实场景时存在严重遮挡、观测冗余和跨视图不一致等问题，难以生成可靠的场景级3D资产，亟需一种能有效融合多视图信息并抑制跨视图冲突的方法。
AI.method: 1) 紧凑互补视图选择：从多视角中挑选一组信息互补的视图，减少观测冗余同时为遮挡区域提供额外证据；2) 步高效潜在速度融合：在规范空间中融合多视图证据并抑制跨视图冲突；3) 轻量级刚体高斯优化：在200次迭代内微调场景布局，同时保留生成物体的几何结构。
AI.result: 在Replica和ScanNet++数据集上，场景级倒角距离分别降低43.8%和30.9%；在多视图设置下，流模型采样FLOPs和端到端延迟降低约20%。
AI.conclusion: Scene-SAM3D通过无需训练的多视图信息融合策略，有效提升了场景级3D生成的质量和效率，为真实场景的3D资产生成提供了可行的解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 高质量的3D场景资产对于具身应用（如机器人操作、导航和仿真）至关重要。尽管近期单图像3D生成模型（如SAM3D）具备强大的物体先验，但在真实场景中仍显不足——严重的遮挡、冗余观测和跨视图不一致使得可靠的场景生成极具挑战。我们提出Scene-SAM3D，一个无需训练的框架，将SAM3D从单视图物体生成扩展到已标定的多视图场景资产生成。Scene-SAM3D选择一组紧凑的互补视图，减少观测冗余，同时为单个视图中被遮挡的区域提供额外证据。基于所选视图，它执行步高效的潜在速度融合，在规范空间中整合多视图证据并抑制跨视图冲突。最后，一个轻量级的刚体高斯优化在200次迭代内微调场景布局，同时保留所生成物体的几何结构。在Replica和ScanNet++上的实验表明，该方法在实例级和场景级均取得一致性改进，场景级倒角距离在Replica上降低43.8%，在ScanNet++上降低30.9%，同时在多视图设置下将流模型采样FLOPs和端到端延迟降低近20%。代码将在https://github.com/xibi777/Scene-SAM3D开源。

title: When Can Safe Controllers Adapt? Information before Commitment
summary:
Safe adaptive control is online adaptation under a safety guarantee on the learning trajectory itself. The controller may use any causal, history-dependent rule and act differently across environments as data arrive. Only its safety guarantee is uniform: the same rule must satisfy it under every initially plausible model. Performance is measured against a safe oracle that knows the realized model. Many finite-time analyses assume persistent excitation of the uniformly safe closed loop, so the data distinguish every pair of models requiring different control decisions. Under that assumption, feasibility is already settled; only the rate remains. We ask instead: Do the safety constraints permit such an informative experiment at all?
  While an alternative remains plausible, the controller must preserve a safe continuation under it. We call the first action that forecloses such a continuation commitment. Chance safety allows commitment only on an event rare under the alternative, and the evidence must arrive beforehand: the observation generated by the committing action is too late. We define precommitment information as the KL divergence between learner-visible laws stopped before commitment.
  Our main result is a causal reduction. The commitment rule determines (1) the probability that safety permits commitment under the alternative, (2) the target-side cost of remaining noncommittal, (3) and the information available when the decision is made. Bounded precommitment information therefore leaves a fixed fraction of the oracle gap unavoidable. If the gap is Ω(T), every uniformly safe policy has linear regret. We establish the obstruction in a constrained linear system with quadratic regulation cost. We also prove recovery in special cases and derive semidefinite upper certificates for deterministic linear-Gaussian systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究安全自适应控制中，安全约束是否允许进行充分信息性的实验。通过引入“承诺”（commitment）和“承诺前信息”（precommitment information）概念，证明若承诺前信息有界，则任何均匀安全策略都会产生线性遗憾，无法避免固定的Oracle差距分数。
AI.motivation: 现有安全自适应控制研究通常假设闭环持续激励（persistent excitation），使数据能够区分所有需要不同控制决策的模型对，在此假设下可行性已被解决，只剩收敛速率问题。本文质疑：安全约束本身是否允许如此信息丰富的实验？即在保证安全的前提下，能否获得足够信息来区分不同模型？
AI.method: 提出“承诺”（commitment）概念——指那些会阻断某个备选模型下安全延续路径的动作；定义“承诺前信息”为停止在承诺发生前的KL散度。建立因果归约（causal reduction）：承诺规则决定(1)在备选模型下安全允许承诺的概率、(2)保持非承诺状态的目标侧代价、(3)决策时可获得的信息。通过有界承诺前信息推导出无法避免的Oracle差距。
AI.result: 主要结果为因果归约定理：有界承诺前信息使得固定的Oracle差距分数不可避免。若该差距为Ω(T)，则任何均匀安全策略都有线性遗憾。在带二次调节代价的约束线性系统中验证了该障碍，并在确定性线性-高斯系统中证明了特殊情况下的恢复（recovery）以及半定上界证书。
AI.conclusion: 安全约束从根本上限制了自适应控制所能获取的信息量，导致无法避免的性能损失。即使是最优的均匀安全策略，在信息受限的情况下也只能达到线性遗憾，而非次线性遗憾。
AI.abstract_zh:
安全自适应控制是指在学习轨迹本身具有安全保障的前提下进行在线自适应。控制器可使用任意因果的、依赖于历史信息的规则，并在数据到达时根据不同的环境采取不同行动。唯有其安全保证是统一的：相同的规则必须在每一个初始可信模型下都满足该保证。性能衡量标准是相对于一个知道真实模型的安全Oracle。许多有限时间分析假设均匀安全的闭环系统具有持续激励，从而数据能够区分每一对需要不同控制决策的模型。在此假设下，可行性问题已经解决，仅剩收敛速率问题。我们转而问：安全约束本身是否允许如此信息丰富的实验？
  当某个备选模型仍然可信时，控制器必须在该模型下保持一条安全延续路径。我们将第一个阻断这种延续的动作称为"承诺"。机会安全性（chance safety）仅允许在备选模型下的小概率事件中做出承诺，且证据必须在此之前到达：承诺动作产生的观测信息为时已晚。我们将承诺前信息定义为停止在承诺发生之前的、学习器可见的定律之间的KL散度。
  我们的主要结果是一个因果归约。承诺规则决定了：(1)在备选模型下安全允许承诺的概率；(2)保持非承诺状态的目标侧代价；(3)决策时可获得的信息。因此，有界的承诺前信息使得固定的Oracle差距分数不可避免。若该差距为Ω(T)，则每个均匀安全策略都具有线性遗憾。我们在具有二次调节代价的约束线性系统中验证了这一障碍。我们还证明了特殊情况下的恢复能力，并推导了确定性线性-高斯系统的半定上界证书。

title: Test-Time Registers as Global Priors for Tokenized Image Generation
summary: Attention-based models often develop attention sinks, where a small number of tokens repeatedly attract attention and accumulate unusually large activations. In vision transformers, these outliers are closely related to registers, which have been diagnostically linked to global, low-frequency image structure. Existing work has largely studied registers through interpretability analyses and linear probes, leaving open whether they can be operationalized as plug-and-play signals for generation without retraining. We revisit this question in tokenized image generation. Using OpenCLIP and DINOv2 on ImageNet, we find that test-time register features exhibit stronger low-frequency concentration than both [CLS] readouts and patch-mean features, and show a consistent (albeit moderate) correlation with pixel-space DCT low-frequency energy. Motivated by these diagnostics, we introduce RegToken, a training-free procedure that converts register structure into a small set of global prior tokens by (i) NFN-based layer localization, (ii) TokenRank-guided subspace extraction, and (iii) a projection-and-conservation update on the register subspace. Inserted into a frozen compact 1D token generation pipeline, RegToken improves ImageNet generation and alignment metrics (e.g., FID-5k 20.5 to 20.1, SigLIP 3.6 to 3.9) without modifying pretrained weights, and accelerates test-time optimization (Steps@$τ$ 74 to 52). Overall, our results suggest that structures often viewed as attention artifacts can be repurposed as lightweight global priors for tokenized generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RegToken，一种无需训练的方法，将Vision Transformer中的注意力汇（attention sinks）即寄存器（registers）转换为全局先验token，用于加速和改善tokenized图像生成。实验表明，该方法在不修改预训练权重的情况下，提升了ImageNet生成指标（FID下降，SigLIP上升），并加速了测试时优化。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要通过可解释性分析和线性探针研究视觉Transformer中的寄存器现象，但尚未探索能否将其作为即插即用的先验信号用于生成任务。本文旨在验证寄存器结构能否在不重训练的情况下，被转化为轻量级全局先验来改进tokenized图像生成。
AI.method: RegToken包含三个步骤：(i) 基于NFN的层定位，定位寄存器行为显著的层；(ii) TokenRank引导的子空间提取，提取寄存器的核心结构；(iii) 投影与守恒更新，将寄存器子空间转化为一组全局先验token。这些token被插入到冻结的紧凑1D token生成管道中，无需修改预训练权重。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上使用OpenCLIP和DINOv2的实验表明：寄存器特征比[CLS]读出和patch均值特征具有更强的低频集中性，并与像素空间DCT低频能量呈现一致（虽适度）的相关性。RegToken将FID-5k从20.5降至20.1，SigLIP从3.6提升至3.9，并将测试时优化步数（Steps@τ）从74降至52。
AI.conclusion: 本文结果表明，通常被视为注意力伪影的寄存器结构，可以被重新利用为轻量级全局先验，有效改进tokenized图像生成，且无需重新训练模型。
AI.abstract_zh: 基于注意力的模型常常会出现注意力汇（attention sinks）现象，即少量token反复吸引注意力并累积异常大的激活值。在视觉Transformer中，这些异常值（outliers）与寄存器（registers）密切相关，而寄存器已被诊断性地关联到全局性的低频图像结构。现有工作主要通过可解释性分析和线性探针来研究寄存器，尚未探索能否将其作为无需重训练的即插即用信号用于生成任务。我们在tokenized图像生成中重新审视了这一问题。利用ImageNet上的OpenCLIP和DINOv2，我们发现测试时的寄存器特征比[CLS]读出特征和patch均值特征表现出更强的低频集中性，并与像素空间DCT低频能量呈现一致（虽适度）的相关性。基于这些诊断结果，我们提出了RegToken——一种无需训练的方法，通过以下步骤将寄存器结构转化为一小簇全局先验token：(i) 基于NFN的层定位，(ii) TokenRank引导的子空间提取，(iii) 对寄存器子空间进行投影与守恒更新。将RegToken插入到冻结的紧凑1D token生成管道中后，该方法在不修改预训练权重的情况下改善了ImageNet生成和对齐指标（例如FID-5k从20.5降至20.1，SigLIP从3.6提升至3.9），并加速了测试时优化（Steps@τ从74降至52）。总体而言，我们的结果表明，那些通常被视为注意力伪影的结构可以被重新利用为轻量级全局先验，用于tokenized生成任务。

title: Enhancing Personalized Bladder Cancer Treatment Through Reinforcement Learning: A Recurrent Patient State Transition Decision Support Framework
summary: Bladder cancer treatment requires personalized and adaptive decision-making, particularly for recurrent disease, where treatment effectiveness changes across successive clinical episodes. Conventional clinical decision support systems typically rely on static treatment guidelines or single-step predictive models, limiting their ability to capture disease progression over time. This paper presents a recurrent patient state-transition simulation framework for bladder cancer treatment planning that integrates predictive state-transition modeling with a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and a Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning environment. The predictive module estimates changes in tumor characteristics following treatment, while the reinforcement learning agent sequentially optimizes treatment decisions by interacting with simulated patient trajectories. This framework enables dynamic, patient-specific treatment planning by continuously adapting recommendations to evolving clinical states. It also generates interpretable treatment trajectories and detailed simulation logs to improve transparency and support clinical decision-making. The proposed framework was evaluated against existing reinforcement learning-based treatment planning approaches. It achieved a cumulative reward of 63,918.87, an average training loss per episode of 0.0056, and a policy improvement score of 6.62%, demonstrating effective sequential learning and robust treatment optimization in a simulated recurrent treatment environment. These findings highlight the potential of recurrent patient state-transition simulation with reinforcement learning as a flexible decision-support framework for personalized bladder cancer treatment planning and AI-assisted precision oncology.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合预测性状态转移建模、马尔可夫决策过程和深度Q网络强化学习的复发患者状态转移仿真框架，用于膀胱癌治疗规划的个性化动态决策支持。
AI.motivation: 传统临床决策支持系统依赖静态指南或单步预测模型，无法捕捉膀胱癌复发治疗中疾病进展的动态变化和跨疗程的治疗效果演变。
AI.method: 构建了一个递归患者状态转移仿真框架，包含预测性状态转移模块（估计治疗后肿瘤特征变化）和基于MDP与DQN的强化学习环境，通过智能体与模拟患者轨迹交互，顺序优化治疗决策。
AI.result: 累计奖励63,918.87，每轮平均训练损失0.0056，策略改进得分为6.62%，展示了有效的序列学习和稳健的治疗优化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了递归患者状态转移仿真结合强化学习作为灵活决策支持框架在个性化膀胱癌治疗规划和AI辅助精准肿瘤学中的潜力。
AI.abstract_zh: 膀胱癌治疗需要个性化和自适应的决策制定，尤其是在复发性疾病中，治疗效果在连续临床疗程之间会发生变化。传统的临床决策支持系统通常依赖于静态的治疗指南或单步预测模型，限制了其捕捉疾病随时间进展的能力。本文提出了一种用于膀胱癌治疗规划的递归患者状态转移仿真框架，该框架将预测性状态转移建模与马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）和深度Q网络（DQN）强化学习环境相结合。预测模块评估治疗后肿瘤特征的变化，而强化学习智能体通过与模拟患者轨迹交互，顺序优化治疗决策。该框架通过持续调整推荐以适应不断演变的临床状态，实现了动态的、患者特定的治疗规划。它还生成可解释的治疗轨迹和详细的仿真日志，以提高透明度并支持临床决策。所提出的框架与现有的基于强化学习的治疗规划方法进行了评估对比。它实现了63,918.87的累计奖励、每轮0.0056的平均训练损失以及6.62%的策略改进得分，在模拟的复发治疗环境中展示了有效的序列学习和稳健的治疗优化能力。这些发现凸显了递归患者状态转移仿真与强化学习作为个性化膀胱癌治疗规划和AI辅助精准肿瘤学的灵活决策支持框架的潜力。

title: Spatially-Aware Class-Agnostic Object Counting
summary: Generalised object counting aims to estimate the number of instances of an arbitrary object category from a single image, but many recent methods can struggle on structurally complex objects due to limited spatial modelling. We present \textit{UpCount}, a class-agnostic counter designed to better preserve spatial structure. UpCount strengthens the visual representation by extracting multi-layer features from a ViT-B/16 encoder and reassembling them into a refined multi-scale pyramid that is spatially refined using Dense Prediction Transformers and FeatUp, yielding features with improved structural and spatial sensitivity; a proposal--verification counting head then identifies repeated patterns and produces a density map for the final count. On FSC-147, UpCount achieves 12.39 MAE and 100.89 RMSE on the test set, and it transfers effectively to vehicle counting on CARPK (6.27 MAE, 8.79 RMSE). Code: https://github.com/r28112072-rgb/upcount

AI.tldr: UpCount是一种类无关的通用对象计数方法，通过ViT-B/16编码器提取多层特征，利用Dense Prediction Transformers和FeatUp进行空间细化，再通过提案-验证计数头生成密度图，在FSC-147和CARPK数据集上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有通用对象计数方法在处理结构复杂对象时，由于空间建模能力有限而表现不佳。
AI.method: 使用ViT-B/16编码器提取多层特征，将其重组为精细的多尺度金字塔，通过Dense Prediction Transformers和FeatUp进行空间细化，得到具有更好结构感知和空间敏感性的特征；最后通过提案-验证计数头识别重复模式并生成密度图进行计数。
AI.result: 在FSC-147测试集上达到12.39 MAE和100.89 RMSE，在CARPK车辆计数任务上达到6.27 MAE和8.79 RMSE。
AI.conclusion: 通过增强空间结构保持能力，UpCount在通用对象计数任务上取得了优异性能，并具有良好的跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 通用对象计数旨在从单张图像中估计任意对象类别的实例数量，但许多近期方法由于空间建模有限，在处理结构复杂对象时存在困难。我们提出了\textit{UpCount}，一种旨在更好地保持空间结构的类无关计数器。UpCount通过从ViT-B/16编码器中提取多层特征，并将其重组为精细的多尺度金字塔，利用Dense Prediction Transformers和FeatUp进行空间细化，从而获得具有更好结构和空间敏感性的特征；随后，一个提案-验证计数头识别重复模式并生成密度图以得到最终计数。在FSC-147上，UpCount在测试集上达到了12.39的MAE和100.89的RMSE，并且有效地迁移到了CARPK上的车辆计数任务（6.27 MAE, 8.79 RMSE）。代码：https://github.com/r28112072-rgb/upcount

title: Investigation of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Approaches
comment: Published in 2023 5th International Conference on Sustainable Technologies for Industry 5.0 (STI), December 2023, Dhaka, Bangladesh
summary: Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS) is a widespread hormone problem for women of childbearing age. Women with PCOS may not ovulate; they might have high levels of androgens and have many small cysts on the ovaries. It can cause missed or irregular menstrual periods, excess hair growth, acne, infertility, and weight gain. Machine Learning (ML) can effectively diagnose this disease at an earlier stage as tons of medical data are available now. Traditional approaches to detect PCOS encompass a combination of clinical evaluation, medical history assessment, physical examination, and laboratory tests. These approaches aim to identify the characteristic symptoms and hormonal imbalances associated with PCOS. Physical examination requires good resources and costs time and money. In recent times, data-driven techniques have substantially advanced disease prediction within the medical field. We aim to utilize ML approaches, incorporating unique feature selection algorithms, to predict PCOS. This paper introduces a data-driven approach to PCOS diagnosis, combining Feature Engineering and ML. Several feature selection approaches have been considered to select sets of features for training the ML model, including CatBoost, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM), AdaBoost, Random Forest (RF). Results demonstrate that AdaBoost, with ten features selected by RF Feature Importance and Highest Correlation (HC), provides the highest test accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合特征工程与机器学习的多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）数据驱动诊断方法，通过多种特征选择算法（CatBoost、XGBoost、LGBM、AdaBoost、RF）筛选特征，实验表明AdaBoost结合RF特征重要性与最高相关性（HC）选择的10个特征实现了最高测试准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统PCOS检测方法依赖临床评估、病史、体格检查和实验室测试，耗时且成本高，亟需一种数据驱动的早期诊断方法。
AI.method: 采用数据驱动方法，结合特征工程与机器学习，使用CatBoost、XGBoost、LGBM、AdaBoost、随机森林（RF）等多种特征选择算法筛选特征子集，训练ML模型进行PCOS预测。
AI.result: AdaBoost结合RF特征重要性与最高相关性（HC）选择的10个特征，在测试集上取得了最高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结合特征工程和机器学习的PCOS数据驱动诊断方法有效，其中AdaBoost与特定特征选择策略的组合表现最优。
AI.abstract_zh: 多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是育龄女性中普遍存在的一种激素问题。PCOS患者可能不排卵、雄激素水平过高且卵巢上存在多个小囊肿。它可导致月经缺失或不规律、毛发过度生长、痤疮、不孕和体重增加。由于目前可获取大量医疗数据，机器学习（ML）可以在此疾病早期阶段进行有效诊断。传统的PCOS检测方法包括临床评估、病史评估、体格检查和实验室测试的综合运用。这些方法旨在识别与PCOS相关的特征性症状和激素失衡。体格检查需要良好的资源且耗时耗钱。近年来，数据驱动技术显著推进了医学领域的疾病预测。我们旨在利用ML方法，结合独特的特征选择算法，来预测PCOS。本文介绍了一种结合特征工程与机器学习的数据驱动PCOS诊断方法。研究考虑了多种特征选择方法来筛选特征子集以训练ML模型，包括CatBoost、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）、轻量梯度提升机（LGBM）、AdaBoost和随机森林（RF）。结果表明，采用RF特征重要性与最高相关性（HC）选择的10个特征的AdaBoost模型，在测试集上取得了最高的准确率。

title: UniNDM: A Unified Noise-driven Detection and Mitigation Framework Against Sexual Content in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Despite the impressive generative capabilities of text-to-image diffusion models, they remain vulnerable to implicit sexual prompts, where subtle cues disguised as benign terms or adversarial tokens unexpectedly generate the inappropriate content due to model biases or latent correlations in training data. Existing safety mechanisms face fundamental limitations: detection methods primarily identify explicit content and fail to capture implicit malicious intent, while mitigation approaches rely on static negative prompts inadequate for diverse implicit scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose UniNDM, a unified noise-driven framework that rethinks safety mechanisms through the lens of noise dynamics in diffusion processes. Our key insight is that early-stage predicted noise exhibits inherent separability between normal and sexually explicit content, which we theoretically demonstrates quadratically increasing semantic concentration with timestep. Leveraging this property, we develop a lightweight noise-based detector achieving superior accuracy with virtually no computational overhead. For mitigation, we introduce noise-enhanced adaptive negative guidance: dynamically generating context-specific negative prompts via large language models to handle diverse implicit content, while optimizing initial noise by suppressing attention concentration on explicit tokens to provide comprehensive protection. Besides the U-Net-based diffusion models, we further extend our framework to emerging Diffusion Transformer architectures through region-constrained semantic guidance tailored for their unified multimodal attention. Comprehensive experiments across U-Net models and DiT models on both natural and adversarial datasets demonstrate substantial improvements over state-of-the-art methods, including SLD, UCE, Safree, etc. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Aries-iai/UniNDM.

AI.tldr: 提出UniNDM统一噪声驱动框架，利用扩散过程早期预测噪声的可分离性，实现隐式性内容的高效检测与缓解，在U-Net和DiT模型上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型易受隐式性提示攻击，而现有安全机制（检测方法无法捕捉隐式恶意意图，缓解方法依赖静态负面提示）存在根本性局限。
AI.method: 核心发现：早期预测噪声在正常与性内容间存在固有可分离性（理论上证明语义浓度随时间步二次增长）。据此构建：(1)轻量级基于噪声的检测器；(2)噪声增强的自适应负面引导：用大语言模型动态生成上下文特定负面提示，同时通过抑制显式词元的注意力浓度来优化初始噪声。并针对DiT架构设计了区域约束语义引导。
AI.result: 在U-Net模型（如SD）和DiT模型上的自然与对抗数据集上，在检测与缓解任务中均显著优于SLD、UCE、Safree等SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过从噪声动力学角度重新审视扩散模型的安全机制，UniNDM统一了隐式性内容的检测与缓解框架，且可扩展到新兴的Diffusion Transformer架构。
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管文本到图像扩散模型具有令人印象深刻的生成能力，它们仍然容易受到隐式性提示的攻击——这些提示通过伪装成良性术语或对抗性词元的微妙线索，由于模型偏差或训练数据中的潜在相关性，意外地生成不当内容。现有安全机制面临根本性局限：检测方法主要识别显式内容，无法捕捉隐式恶意意图；而缓解方法依赖于静态负面提示，不足以应对多样化的隐式场景。为应对这些挑战，我们提出UniNDM，一个统一的噪声驱动框架，通过扩散过程中噪声动力学的视角重新思考安全机制。我们的关键洞察是，早期阶段预测的噪声在正常内容与性暴露内容之间表现出固有的可分离性，我们从理论上证明了语义浓度随时间步呈二次增长。利用这一性质，我们开发了一个轻量级的基于噪声的检测器，在几乎没有计算开销的情况下实现了优越的准确率。在缓解方面，我们引入了噪声增强的自适应负面引导：通过大语言模型动态生成上下文相关的负面提示以处理多样化的隐式内容，同时通过抑制显式词元上的注意力浓度来优化初始噪声，从而提供全面的保护。除了基于U-Net的扩散模型，我们还将框架进一步扩展到新兴的Diffusion Transformer架构，通过针对其统一多模态注意力定制的区域约束语义引导。在U-Net模型和DiT模型上的自然与对抗数据集上的全面实验表明，我们的方法显著优于SLD、UCE、Safree等最先进方法。我们的代码已在https://github.com/Aries-iai/UniNDM公开。

title: CADENCE: Closing the Reasoning Gap via Coverage-Adaptive On-Policy Distillation
summary:
On-policy knowledge distillation transfers reasoning from large teachers to compact students, but existing approaches suffer three compounding failure modes: (i) cold-start collapse, where a fresh student assigns near-zero mass to teacher-preferred tokens; (ii) state-agnostic divergence scheduling, where time-only forward/reverse-KL interpolation ignores the student's coverage state; and (iii) binary reward sparsity, where pass/fail signals discard information from partially correct traces.
  We present CADENCE, a unified framework with a targeted fix for each. Its DRIFT mechanism schedules a per-token convex mixture of forward-KL and reverse-KL surrogate objectives on student-sampled trajectories (per-token surrogates, not sequence-level KL gradient estimators). Six components extend it: (A) COVA, a coverage-adaptive $β$ schedule accelerating the forward-to-reverse transition; (B) FTB, a forking-token boost concentrating gradient at high-entropy positions via a globally-normalized entropy reference; (C) CCD, a dense reward adding numerical-proximity partial credit for incorrect-but-close traces; (D) LAP, brevity-preferential correct-rollout reinforcement; (E) EMR, an entropy-matching calibration regularizer; (F) BSD, a bootstrapped self-distillation phase.
  On GSM8K and MATH-500 (corrected 512-token protocol, 5 seeds, reported std), CADENCE distills a 0.5B student from a 1.5B teacher to 69.8 $\pm$ 0.5% GSM8K pass@1 (from 48.7% pretrained; 63.2% of the teacher gap closed) and to 72.1 $\pm$ 0.4% with a 3B teacher (76.2% closed), beating the strongest matched-compute label-using baseline (DRIFT+binary reward) by +4.4 $\pm$ 0.7 points. All experiments run on a single Apple Mac Studio (M-series, 64GB unified memory), showing principled distillation reaches strong reasoning quality without datacenter-scale hardware.

AI.tldr: CADENCE 通过三个针对性修复（DRIFT 逐令牌凸混合、COVA 覆盖自适应调度、CCD 稠密奖励等）解决了同策略知识蒸馏中的冷启动崩溃、状态无关散度调度和二元奖励稀疏问题，在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上显著提升了小模型的推理能力，且仅需单台 Mac Studio 即可运行。
AI.motivation: 现有同策略知识蒸馏存在三个复合失败模式：(i) 冷启动崩溃——新学生模型对教师偏好令牌赋予近乎零的概率；(ii) 状态无关的散度调度——仅基于时间的前向/反向KL插值忽略了学生模型的覆盖状态；(iii) 二元奖励稀疏——通过/失败信号丢弃了部分正确轨迹中的信息。这些问题限制了从大模型向小模型高效蒸馏推理能力。
AI.method: 提出 CADENCE 统一框架，核心是 DRIFT 机制——在学生采样轨迹上对前向KL和反向KL替代目标进行逐令牌凸混合（逐令牌替代目标，而非序列级KL梯度估计）。六个扩展组件：(A) COVA：覆盖自适应的 β 调度，加速前向到反向的过渡；(B) FTB：分叉令牌提升，通过全局归一化熵参考在高熵位置集中梯度；(C) CCD：稠密奖励，为不正确但接近的轨迹添加数值邻近的部分分数；(D) LAP：优先简短正确轨迹的强化；(E) EMR：熵匹配校准正则化器；(F) BSD：引导式自蒸馏阶段。
AI.result: 在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上（5个种子，报告标准差），CADENCE 将 0.5B 学生模型从 1.5B 教师蒸馏到 69.8±0.5% GSM8K pass@1（预训练基线的 48.7%；缩小了 63.2% 的教师差距）；使用 3B 教师达到 72.1±0.4%（缩小 76.2% 差距），超过最强的匹配计算量的标签使用基线（DRIFT+二元奖励）4.4±0.7 个点。所有实验在单台 Apple Mac Studio（M系列，64GB统一内存）上运行。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE 证明了原则性的蒸馏方法无需数据中心级硬件即可达到强推理质量，通过针对性修复同策略蒸馏中的三个关键失败模式，显著提升了知识蒸馏的效果和效率。
AI.abstract_zh: 同策略知识蒸馏将推理能力从大教师模型迁移到紧凑学生模型，但现有方法存在三个复合失败模式：(i) 冷启动崩溃——新初始化的学生模型对教师偏好的令牌分配近乎零的概率；(ii) 状态无关的散度调度——仅基于时间的前向KL/反向KL插值忽略了学生模型的覆盖状态；(iii) 二元奖励稀疏——通过/失败信号丢弃了部分正确轨迹中的信息。我们提出 CADENCE，一个统一框架，为每个问题提供针对性修复。其 DRIFT 机制在学生采样轨迹上对前向KL和反向KL替代目标进行逐令牌凸混合（逐令牌替代目标，而非序列级KL梯度估计）。六个扩展组件：(A) COVA——覆盖自适应的 β 调度，加速前向到反向的过渡；(B) FTB——分叉令牌提升，通过全局归一化熵参考在高熵位置集中梯度；(C) CCD——稠密奖励，为不正确但接近的轨迹添加数值邻近的部分分数；(D) LAP——优先简短正确轨迹的强化；(E) EMR——熵匹配校准正则化器；(F) BSD——引导式自蒸馏阶段。在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上（校正后的512令牌协议，5个种子，报告标准差），CADENCE 将 0.5B 学生模型从 1.5B 教师蒸馏到 69.8 ± 0.5% GSM8K pass@1（从预训练基线的 48.7% 提升；缩小了 63.2% 的教师差距），使用 3B 教师达到 72.1 ± 0.4%（缩小 76.2% 差距），超过最强的匹配计算量的标签使用基线（DRIFT+二元奖励）4.4 ± 0.7 个点。所有实验在单台 Apple Mac Studio（M系列，64GB统一内存）上运行，展示了原则性蒸馏无需数据中心级硬件即可达到强推理质量。

title: Robust PnP on a Neuromorphic Processor for Object Pose Estimation
summary: Neuromorphic computing is gaining attention in robotic perception due to its higher energy efficiency. While neural network-based methods can more readily exploit the distributed and parallelized structure of neuromorphic computers, crafting neuromorphic solutions for non-learning tasks is less straightforward. This hampers the usage of neuromorphic computing for perception pipelines that depend on both learning and non-learning components, such as object pose estimation (OPE) where state-of-the-art methods use a deep network to predict 2D landmarks and nonlinear optimization to solve perspective-n-point (PnP). In this paper, we propose a novel neuromorphic-deployable formulation for robust PnP, where given outlier-prone 2D-3D correspondences, the object pose with the largest number of inliers is determined. Underpinning our method is a distributed algorithm for robust least squares estimation of rigid body pose that can be executed on a neuromorphic processor. We also design a spiking neural network (SNN) to predict 2D landmarks from event data, where the main layers of the SNN were designed according to the principles of spiking neurons. Overall, our work enables neuromorphic treatment of the major stages of an OPE pipeline, from event sensing and learned landmark prediction, to geometric optimization for robust PnP. Results on neuromophic hardware (Intel Loihi 2) indicate the higher energy efficiency our neuromorphic robust PnP, while achieving competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可部署于神经形态硬件的鲁棒PnP求解方法，结合脉冲神经网络（SNN）从事件数据预测2D landmarks，实现了从事件感知到几何优化的完整神经形态物体位姿估计（OPE）流水线，在Intel Loihi 2上实现了高能效且精度具有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 神经形态计算在机器人感知中具有高能效优势，但现有OPE方法中，学习部分（深度网络预测2D landmarks）和非学习部分（非线性优化求解PnP）难以统一部署到神经形态硬件上，阻碍了神经形态计算的全面应用。本文旨在解决这一鸿沟，提出神经形态可部署的鲁棒PnP求解方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出一种基于分布式算法的鲁棒最小二乘估计方法，用于求解刚体位姿，可部署于神经形态处理器；2) 设计了一种脉冲神经网络（SNN）从事件数据预测2D landmarks，其主要层遵循脉冲神经元原理设计；3) 将SNN预测与神经形态PnP求解器整合，形成完整的OPE流水线。
AI.result: 在Intel Loihi 2神经形态硬件上的实验表明，所提出的神经形态鲁棒PnP方法在实现竞争性精度的同时，具有更高的能效。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次实现了OPE流水线主要阶段（事件感知、学习型landmark预测、几何优化求解鲁棒PnP）的完整神经形态化处理，证明了神经形态计算在结合学习和非学习组件的感知任务中的可行性与能效优势。
AI.abstract_zh: 神经形态计算因其更高的能效在机器人感知领域日益受到关注。虽然基于神经网络的方法能更自然地利用神经形态计算机的分布式与并行化结构，但为非学习任务设计神经形态解决方案则不那么直接。这阻碍了神经形态计算在依赖学习和非学习组件的感知流水线中的应用，例如物体位姿估计（OPE）——当前最先进的方法使用深度网络预测2D landmark，并通过非线性优化求解透视n点问题（PnP）。本文提出了一种新颖的、可部署于神经形态硬件的鲁棒PnP求解方法：给定易受离群点污染的2D-3D对应关系，该方法确定具有最大内点数量的物体位姿。我们方法的核心是一种可在神经形态处理器上执行的分布式鲁棒最小二乘刚体位姿估计算法。我们还设计了一种脉冲神经网络（SNN）从事件数据预测2D landmark，该SNN的主要层根据脉冲神经元原理设计。总体而言，我们的工作使得OPE流水线的主要阶段——从事件感知、学习的landmark预测，到几何优化求解鲁棒PnP——均可采用神经形态方式处理。在神经形态硬件（Intel Loihi 2）上的实验结果表明，我们的神经形态鲁棒PnP方法在实现竞争性精度的同时，具有更高的能效。

title: SurvCF(t): Counterfactual Explanations for Survival Analysis in Predictive Maintenance Multivariate Time Series Data
summary: Predictive maintenance relies on accurate Remaining Useful Life estimation, often formulated using survival analysis over multivariate time-series data. While modern deep survival models achieve strong predictive performance, their black-box nature limits their use in safety-critical settings where actionable insight is required. In this work, we introduce \textit{SurvCF(t)}, the first framework for generating counterfactual explanations for survival models operating on time-series data. \textit{SurvCF(t)} identifies minimal, plausible, and temporally consistent changes to an asset's operational history that increase its predicted life time, framing explanation as a constrained optimization problem combining validity, proximity, sparsity, and plausibility. We evaluate the method on multiple benchmarks, including C-MAPSS, N-CMAPSS, and a real-world case study of the Scania Component\_X dataset, demonstrating its ability to produce actionable and interpretable interventions. Our results show that \textit{SurvCF(t)} bridges the gap between survival prediction and prescriptive maintenance, enabling explainable and decision-oriented AI for maintenance strategies.

AI.tldr: SurvCF(t)是首个为时间序列数据的生存模型生成反事实解释的框架，通过最小化、合理且时间一致的干预操作来延长设备预测寿命，弥合了生存预测与规范维护之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现代深度生存模型在剩余寿命预测中表现优异，但其黑箱特性限制了在安全关键场景中的应用，无法提供可操作的洞察。因此需要一种能够生成可解释、可干预的反事实解释方法。
AI.method: 将反事实解释构建为一个约束优化问题，同时优化有效性（validity）、邻近性（proximity）、稀疏性（sparsity）和合理性（plausibility），寻找对设备运行历史的最小化、合理且时间一致的修改，以延长预测寿命。
AI.result: 在C-MAPSS、N-CMAPSS以及真实世界Scania Component_X数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够生成可操作、可解释的干预策略，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SurvCF(t)有效弥合了生存预测与规范维护之间的鸿沟，为实现可解释且面向决策的AI维护策略提供了可行方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 预测性维护依赖于准确的剩余寿命估计，通常通过多变量时间序列数据的生存分析来建模。尽管现代深度生存模型取得了强大的预测性能，但其黑箱特性限制了在需要可操作洞察的安全关键场景中的应用。本文提出 SurvCF(t)，这是首个为时间序列数据的生存模型生成反事实解释的框架。SurvCF(t) 通过识别对设备运行历史的最小化、合理且时间一致的更改来延长其预测寿命，将解释构建为一个结合有效性、邻近性、稀疏性和合理性的约束优化问题。我们在多个基准数据集上评估了该方法，包括 C-MAPSS、N-CMAPSS 以及真实世界案例 Scania Component_X 数据集，证明了其生成可操作且可解释干预策略的能力。实验结果表明，SurvCF(t) 弥合了生存预测与规范维护之间的鸿沟，为实现可解释且面向决策的AI维护策略提供了可行方案。

title: TopoGS: Planar Reconstruction via Topology-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: European Conference on Computer Vision (Proceedings of ECCV 2026); Project page: https://vcc.tech/research/2026/TopoGS
summary: Extracting structured, parametric 3D representations from raw images remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and graphics. While recent advancements in the 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipeline integrate planar primitives to yield compact and editable geometry, these approaches typically treat planes as isolated, discrete sets. This lack of topological connectivity hinders robust geometric reasoning, leading to fragmented reconstructions and misaligned boundaries that fall short of the precision for rigorous spatial analysis and professional design workflows. To address this, we introduce TopoGS, the first 3DGS framework to explicitly integrate both planar and topological constraints for coherent 3D reconstruction. Specifically, we extract global 2D topological relationships from multi-view image segmentations and anchor Gaussian primitives to these structural elements. This formulation enables the joint optimization of plane parameters, rendering fidelity, and topological adjacency. By enforcing strict multi-view consistency alongside these topological constraints, our method significantly mitigates geometric misalignments and produces connected, structured 3D models. Extensive evaluations on the ScanNet++ dataset demonstrate that TopoGS achieves state-of-the-art performance, providing a highly robust solution for generating accurate, topologically sound, and visually faithful scene representations.

AI.tldr: TopoGS是首个在3D高斯溅射（3DGS）框架中显式集成平面约束与拓扑约束的方法，通过从多视图图像分割中提取全局2D拓扑关系并将高斯原语锚定到这些结构元素上，联合优化平面参数、渲染保真度和拓扑邻接性，在ScanNet++数据集上达到了最先进的性能，生成拓扑连贯且视觉保真的3D场景表示。
AI.motivation: 现有的3DGS方法虽然引入了平面基元以获得紧凑可编辑的几何结构，但这些方法将平面视为孤立的离散集合，缺乏拓扑连接性，导致重建结果碎片化、边界错位，无法满足严谨空间分析和专业设计工作流对精度的要求。
AI.method: 首先从多视图图像分割中提取全局2D拓扑关系，然后将高斯原语锚定到这些结构元素上，通过联合优化平面参数、渲染保真度和拓扑邻接性，并在多视图一致性约束下实现拓扑连贯的3D重建。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++数据集上的大量评估表明，TopoGS达到了最先进的性能，能够生成准确、拓扑连贯且视觉保真的场景表示，显著减轻了几何错位问题。
AI.conclusion: TopoGS通过显式集成拓扑约束，有效解决了现有3DGS方法中缺乏拓扑连接性导致的碎片化重建和边界错位问题，为生成结构化且鲁棒的3D场景表示提供了高效解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 从原始图像中提取结构化的、参数化的3D表示仍然是计算机视觉和图形学中的一个基本挑战。尽管近年来3D高斯溅射（3DGS）管线的进展通过集成平面基元生成了紧凑且可编辑的几何结构，但这些方法通常将平面视为孤立的离散集合。这种拓扑连接性的缺失阻碍了鲁棒的几何推理，导致重建碎片化、边界错位，无法满足严谨空间分析和专业设计工作流对精度的要求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TopoGS——首个在3DGS框架中显式集成平面约束和拓扑约束以实现连贯3D重建的方法。具体而言，我们从多视图图像分割中提取全局2D拓扑关系，并将高斯原语锚定到这些结构元素上。该公式使得平面参数、渲染保真度和拓扑邻接性能够联合优化。通过在这些拓扑约束之外强制执行严格的多视图一致性，我们的方法显著减轻了几何错位，并生成了连通的、结构化的3D模型。在ScanNet++数据集上的大量评估表明，TopoGS达到了最先进的性能，为生成准确、拓扑连贯且视觉保真的场景表示提供了高度鲁棒的解决方案。

title: TurboVec: A Case Study in Cost-Efficient Private Retrieval for Enterprise RAG via Codebook-Oblivious Quantization
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly power enterprise LLM applications, yet the vector retrieval layer introduces two underexplored challenges: (1) trained codebook quantizers may expose corpus statistics during index construction, creating a leakage channel in multi-tenant deployments, and (2) post-hoc filtering for tenant isolation degrades recall on selective queries. We study TurboVec, an open-source vector index built on TurboQuant - a codebook-oblivious scalar quantizer requiring no corpus-dependent training. On the DBpedia OpenAI embeddings benchmark (d=1536, 100K-999K vectors), TurboQuant 4-bit outperforms trained FAISS Product Quantization at the same memory budget by 8.5-8.9 percentage points in Recall@5 across all scales. Compared to HNSW (R@5=0.991) and IVF-PQ (R@5=0.840), TurboQuant occupies a distinct design point: higher recall than IVF-PQ without training, at 4-8x less memory than HNSW. Deployed on Snowpark Container Services, TurboVec achieves 11ms median query latency at 100K vectors versus 707ms for warehouse brute-force scan. Kernel-level allowlist filtering maintains 0.86-0.93 Recall@10 across 10-1000 tenant workloads versus 0.09-0.19 for post-filter baselines. Codebook-oblivious design reduces membership inference accuracy to near-random (50.0%) versus 57.3% for PQ codebooks. Limitations include single dataset evaluation, uncompressed HNSW comparison, and privacy evaluation on synthetic data only.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TurboVec，一种基于TurboQuant码本无关标量量化器的开源向量索引，解决了RAG系统中向量检索层的两个挑战：多租户部署下的语料统计泄露和租户隔离过滤导致的召回率下降。在DBpedia基准上，4-bit TurboQuant在相同内存下比FAISS乘积量化Recall@5高8.5-8.9个百分点，在Snowpark Container Services上实现11ms中位查询延迟，且码本无关设计将成员推断准确率降至随机水平（50%）。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统的向量检索层存在两个未充分探索的问题：(1) 需要训练的有码本量化器在索引构建过程中可能泄露语料统计信息，在多租户部署中形成信息泄漏通道；(2) 为租户隔离而使用的后过滤方法严重降低了选择性查询的召回率。
AI.method: 提出TurboVec，基于TurboQuant——一种码本无关的标量量化器，无需依赖语料库的训练。采用内核级白名单过滤（kernel-level allowlist filtering）实现租户隔离，而非后过滤。整个索引构建过程不暴露任何语料统计信息。
AI.result: (1) 在DBpedia OpenAI嵌入基准上，4-bit TurboQuant在相同内存预算下，Recall@5比FAISS乘积量化高8.5-8.9个百分点；(2) TurboVec在Snowpark Container Services上，100K向量时中位查询延迟为11ms，而仓库暴力扫描为707ms；(3) 内核级白名单过滤在10-1000租户工作负载下Recall@10为0.86-0.93，而后过滤基线仅为0.09-0.19；(4) 成员推断准确率降至近随机水平（50.0%），而PQ码本为57.3%。
AI.conclusion: TurboVec通过码本无关设计有效解决了RAG系统中向量检索的隐私泄露和召回率下降问题，在召回率、延迟、内存效率和隐私保护之间取得了良好的平衡。但局限性包括仅在单一数据集上评估、与未压缩HNSW比较以及仅在合成数据上进行隐私评估。
AI.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成系统日益成为企业级大语言模型应用的核心支撑，然而向量检索层引入了两个尚未充分探索的挑战：（1）基于训练的有码本量化器可能在索引构建过程中暴露语料统计信息，在多租户部署中形成泄漏通道；（2）为租户隔离而采用的后过滤方法会降低选择性查询的召回率。我们研究了TurboVec——一种基于TurboQuant的开源向量索引，TurboQuant是一种无需依赖语料库训练的码本无关标量量化器。在DBpedia OpenAI嵌入基准测试（d=1536，100K-999K向量）上，相同内存预算下，4-bit TurboQuant在所有规模下的Recall@5均比经过训练的FAISS乘积量化高出8.5-8.9个百分点。与HNSW（R@5=0.991）和IVF-PQ（R@5=0.840）相比，TurboQuant占据了独特的设计空间：无需训练即可获得比IVF-PQ更高的召回率，同时内存占用仅为HNSW的1/4至1/8。部署在Snowpark Container Services上，TurboVec在100K向量时实现11ms中位查询延迟，而仓库暴力扫描为707ms。内核级白名单过滤在10-1000租户工作负载下保持0.86-0.93的Recall@10，而后过滤基线仅为0.09-0.19。码本无关设计将成员推断准确率降至近随机水平（50.0%），而PQ码本为57.3%。局限性包括仅在单一数据集上评估、与未压缩HNSW比较以及仅在合成数据上进行隐私评估。

title: Look Clearly Before Answering: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding. However, they remain prone to hallucinations, generating responses that are inconsistent with the visual evidence. Existing mitigation methods largely address language-prior bias or cross-modal imbalance, while progressive visual degradation across perception and memory remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment (SDPR), a training-free framework that mitigates the degradation of visual awareness throughout inference. Specifically, we first introduce saliency-driven attention redistribution to release attention hijacked by non-semantic sink tokens, thereby recovering critical visual evidence. Second, we identify spatial distortion in the KV cache and propose saliency-driven cache alignment to preserve query-relevant visual features during generation. Finally, we introduce prior-constrained contrastive decoding to penalize unfaithful predictions induced by dominant language priors. Our proposed SDPR is robust against hallucinations due to its holistic alignment of visual awareness across the entire generative trajectory. Extensive experiments across diverse LVLM architectures show that SDPR outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both hallucination and general-purpose benchmarks, requiring no additional training and incurring minimal runtime overhead. The code is available \href{https://github.com/PengSyuChen/SDPR}{\color{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: 提出SDPR，一种无需训练、通过显著性驱动的注意力重分配、缓存对齐和对比解码来缓解LVLM视觉幻觉的框架。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要处理语言先验偏差或跨模态不平衡，但视觉信息在感知和记忆中逐步退化的问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 1) 显著性驱动的注意力重分配，释放被非语义sink token劫持的注意力；2) 显著性驱动的KV缓存对齐，保留查询相关的视觉特征；3) 先验约束的对比解码，惩罚由主导语言先验引起的不忠实预测。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM架构上的实验表明，SDPR在幻觉基准和通用基准上均优于现有方法，无需额外训练且运行时开销极小。
AI.conclusion: SDPR通过在整个生成轨迹中整体对齐视觉意识，有效抑制幻觉，是一种鲁棒且高效的训练-free缓解方案。
AI.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态理解中展现出卓越能力。然而，它们仍然容易产生幻觉，生成与视觉证据不一致的响应。现有的缓解方法主要处理语言先验偏差或跨模态不平衡，而视觉信息在感知和记忆中的逐步退化问题仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们提出显著性驱动的感知重对齐（SDPR），一种无需训练的框架，用于缓解推理过程中视觉意识的退化。具体地，我们首先引入显著性驱动的注意力重分配，以释放被非语义sink token劫持的注意力，从而恢复关键视觉证据。其次，我们识别了KV缓存中的空间失真问题，并提出显著性驱动的缓存对齐，以在生成过程中保留与查询相关的视觉特征。最后，我们引入先验约束的对比解码，以惩罚由主导语言先验引起的不忠实预测。所提出的SDPR通过在整个生成轨迹中整体对齐视觉意识，对幻觉具有鲁棒性。在多种LVLM架构上的大量实验表明，SDPR在幻觉基准和通用基准上均优于最先进的方法，无需额外训练且运行时开销极小。

title: Periodic Bootstrap Thompson Sampling For Periodically Non-Stationary Bandit Problems
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, Accepted to 2025 3rd International Conference on Data Science, Advanced Algorithms, and Intelligent Computing
summary: This paper introduces Periodic Bootstrap Thompson Sampling (PBTS), an innovative extension of the classic Thompson Sampling (TS) algorithm tailored for bandit problems with periodic non-stationarity. Conventional TS accumulates all past observations, leading to biased posteriors when reward distributions cycle over time. PBTS overcomes this by synchronizing belief resets with known or inferred period intervals and embedding structured bootstrap exploration phases, effectively purging obsolete data while preserving uncertainty estimates. PBTS is tested in artificially constructed environments, which include skewed and balanced reward distributions, along with different bootstrap proportions and misaligned periodic intervals. Results indicate that PBTS generally achieves statistically significant reductions in cumulative regret against traditional TS in periodic non-stationary environments. Subsequent discussion further articulates the potential of PBTS's real-world deployment. The study mentions limitations like extreme periodic misalignment and proposes future research such as self-adjusting cycle-recognition. With memory reset and bootstrap phase, PBTS introduces a novel approach to optimizing bandit algorithms in periodic reward contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出周期性自助汤普森采样（PBTS），通过周期性重置信念和引入结构化自助探索阶段，解决经典汤普森采样在周期性非平稳奖励分布下的偏差问题，实验证明PBTS能显著降低累积遗憾。
AI.motivation: 经典汤普森采样在周期性非平稳环境中，由于累积所有历史观测数据，导致后验分布产生偏差，无法适应奖励分布的周期性变化。
AI.method: PBTS通过将信念重置与已知或推断的周期区间同步，并嵌入结构化的自助探索阶段，从而清除过时数据同时保留不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在人工构造的包含偏斜/平衡奖励分布、不同自助比例及错位周期区间的环境中，PBTS相比传统TS在周期性非平稳环境下取得了统计上显著的累积遗憾降低。
AI.conclusion: PBTS通过记忆重置与自助探索阶段，为周期性奖励情境下的赌博机算法优化提供了新方法；未来工作可向自适应周期识别方向拓展。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了周期性自助汤普森采样（PBTS），这是经典汤普森采样（TS）算法的一种创新扩展，专门针对具有周期性非平稳性的赌博机问题。传统TS累积所有历史观测，当奖励分布随时间循环时会导致有偏的后验。PBTS通过将信念重置与已知或推断的周期区间同步，并嵌入结构化的自助探索阶段来克服这一问题，从而在保留不确定性估计的同时有效清除过时数据。PBTS在人工构造的环境中进行测试，包括偏斜和平衡的奖励分布，以及不同的自助比例和错位的周期区间。结果表明，在周期性非平稳环境中，PBTS相比传统TS通常能实现统计上显著的累积遗憾降低。后续讨论进一步阐述了PBTS在实际部署中的潜力。该研究提到了极端周期错位等局限性，并提出了诸如自适应周期识别等未来研究方向。通过记忆重置和自助阶段，PBTS为周期性奖励情境下的赌博机算法优化引入了一种新方法。

title: Dataset Distillation by Influence Matching
summary: We revisit dataset distillation from an outcome-centric perspective. Rather than aligning process surrogates (per-step gradients or training trajectories), Influence Matching (Inf-Match) aligns the final outcome of training: it learns a compact synthetic set whose effect on the converged parameters matches that of the full dataset. Concretely, we introduce a fully differentiable, sample-level influence estimator that quantifies parameter shifts from adding or removing data, without time-consuming inverse-Hessian products or convexity assumptions. The estimator runs in linear time by unrolling the optimization dynamics and applying a first-order Taylor approximation. We then learn the synthetic set by minimizing the mismatch between its influence and that of the real dataset, yielding outcome alignment rather than heuristic process imitation. Inf-Match delivers the best accuracy across standard classification benchmarks. For instance, on Tiny-ImageNet (IPC=10), Inf-Match attains 31.5\%, a +4.7\% improvement over NCFM. Beyond classification, Inf-Match scales to vision-language distillation on Flickr30K, outperforming strong process-matching baselines. For instance, with 200 to 1000 synthetic samples, our method achieved a leading impressive average on image/text retrieval tasks, higher than NCFM by 2.5\%. The code will be released via https://github.com/hrtan/infmatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出影响匹配（Inf-Match）方法，从结果中心视角进行数据集蒸馏，通过可微的样本级影响估计器对齐合成集与真实数据集对收敛参数的影响，避免模仿过程代理，在分类和视觉-语言蒸馏任务上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏方法多通过匹配每步梯度或训练轨迹等过程代理来模拟真实数据，这种过程模仿是启发式的且可能偏离最终目标。作者希望直接从最终训练结果（收敛参数）出发，对齐合成数据与真实数据对模型收敛参数的影响，从而实现更有效的蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出一种全可微的样本级影响估计器，通过展开优化动力学并应用一阶泰勒近似，在线性时间内量化添加或移除数据点引起的参数变化，避免了耗时的逆Hessian乘积或凸性假设。然后通过最小化合成数据的影响与真实数据的影响之间的差异来学习合成集，实现结果对齐而非过程模仿。
AI.result: 在标准分类基准上达到最优精度，如Tiny-ImageNet (IPC=10) 上达到31.5%，比NCFM提高4.7%；在Flickr30K视觉-语言蒸馏任务上，使用200到1000个合成样本时，图像/文本检索平均性能领先NCFM 2.5%。
AI.conclusion: Inf-Match通过结果对齐而非过程模仿，为数据集蒸馏提供了更有效的范式，不仅在分类任务上表现优异，还能扩展到视觉-语言等更复杂的跨模态蒸馏场景。
AI.abstract_zh: 我们从结果中心的视角重新审视数据集蒸馏。与对齐过程代理（每步梯度或训练轨迹）不同，影响匹配（Inf-Match）对齐训练的最终结果：它学习一个紧凑的合成集，使其对收敛参数的影响与完整数据集相匹配。具体而言，我们引入了一个全可微的样本级影响估计器，能够量化添加或移除数据点引起的参数偏移，无需耗时的逆Hessian乘积或凸性假设。该估计器通过展开优化动力学并应用一阶泰勒近似，以线性时间运行。然后，我们通过最小化合成集与真实数据集影响之间的差异来学习合成集，从而实现结果对齐而非启发式过程模仿。Inf-Match在标准分类基准上达到了最优精度。例如，在Tiny-ImageNet（IPC=10）上，Inf-Match达到31.5%，比NCFM提升了4.7%。除分类任务外，Inf-Match可扩展到Flickr30K上的视觉-语言蒸馏，性能优于强过程匹配基线。例如，使用200到1000个合成样本时，我们的方法在图像/文本检索任务上取得了领先的出色平均值，比NCFM高出2.5%。代码将通过https://github.com/hrtan/infmatch 发布。

title: Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment
summary: The Credit Assignment Problem (CAP) is fundamental to developing efficient and explainable Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. Existing frameworks, whether relying on temporal contiguity or hindsight-conditioned reward reweighting, frequently fail to attribute properly between an agent's policy (skill) and environmental stochasticity (luck). A principled approach to CAP must isolate the true causal drivers of observed outcomes from spurious correlations and environmental randomness. We introduce Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment, a novel framework grounded in causal theory that attributes credit and blame via the Counterfactual Shapley Value ($φ$-value). By redistributing environmental rewards, $φ$-values enhance temporal credit assignment across three critical dimensions: sparse causality, high stochasticity, and delayed rewards, all while preserving the optimal policy. We derive a consistent estimator that computes $φ$-values efficiently, enabling a new class of policy gradient methods, $φ$-PPO, combined with Prioritized Trajectory Replay (PTR). Empirical results demonstrate that $φ$-values align precisely to the ground truth causes of task rewards with superior sample efficiency in challenging environments where prior state-of-the-art methods fail to converge.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于反事实Shapley值的信用分配框架，通过反事实推理将奖励归因于智能体的策略而非环境随机性，并据此设计了高效的策略梯度方法φ-PPO，在稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励环境中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有信用分配方法（如基于时间邻近性或后见之明的奖励重加权）无法正确区分智能体策略（技能）与环境随机性（运气）对结果的贡献，导致在稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励场景下性能不佳。
AI.method: 提出Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment框架，基于反事实Shapley值（φ值）进行因果驱动的信用分配；推导了一致性估计器高效计算φ值，并在此基础上设计了φ-PPO算法，结合优先轨迹回放（PTR）机制。
AI.result: φ值能够精确对齐任务奖励的真实因果归因，在稀疏因果、高随机性和延迟奖励的挑战性环境中，φ-PPO的样本效率显著优于现有最先进方法，且后者无法收敛时φ-PPO仍能稳定学习。
AI.conclusion: 反事实Shapley值为信用分配问题提供了一种原则性的因果理论解决方案，能够有效解耦技能与运气的影响，同时保持最优策略不变，开辟了基于因果推理的策略梯度方法新方向。
AI.abstract_zh: 信用分配问题是开发高效且可解释的强化学习智能体的基础。现有的框架——无论是依靠时间邻近性还是基于后见之明的奖励重加权——常常无法正确地在智能体的策略（技能）与环境随机性（运气）之间进行归因。一种原则性的信用分配方法必须将观察到的结果的真实因果驱动因素与虚假相关性和环境随机性分离开来。我们提出了反事实Shapley信用分配，这是一个基于因果理论的新框架，通过反事实Shapley值（φ值）来分配信用与责任。通过重新分配环境奖励，φ值在三个关键维度上增强了时间信用分配：稀疏因果性、高随机性和延迟奖励，同时保持了最优策略不变。我们推导出一个一致性估计器，可以高效地计算φ值，从而催生了一类新的策略梯度方法——φ-PPO，并结合了优先轨迹回放（PTR）。实验结果表明，φ值能够精确对齐任务奖励的真实因果归因，在先前最先进方法无法收敛的挑战性环境中展现出优越的样本效率。

title: InLiER: Learning-Free Heterogeneous LiDAR Place Recognition via Intermediate Mixed-Radix Structural Keypoint Tokenization
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). 8 pages, 8 figures
summary: LiDAR place recognition supports loop closure, relocalization, and multi-agent map management. As robotic platforms increasingly combine LiDARs with different fields of view, resolutions, and scanning patterns, existing descriptors degrade because they are tightly coupled to sensor-specific characteristics. We present InLiER, a learning-free pipeline based on an intermediate tokenization step. Height-sliced keypoints from structural elements receive mixed-radix token IDs encoding height, radial distance, local shape, and azimuth from local 3D geometry, in a compact sub-2KB representation. The same vocabulary is reorganized across three retrieval stages: height-ceiling histogram intersection for fast rotation-invariant shortlisting, binary bitmask alignment for yaw estimation and reranking, and token-guided geometric verification for 6-DoF pose estimation. InLiER achieves state-of-the-art performance on the HeLiPR dataset and in real-world field experiments, among modern handcrafted methods and outperforms the learning-based baseline on most cross-sensor configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于中间标记化步骤的无学习LiDAR地点识别方法InLiER，通过高度切片关键点的混合基数标记编码实现跨传感器泛化，在HeLiPR数据集和真实实验中达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR地点识别描述子与传感器特性（视场角、分辨率、扫描模式）紧密耦合，导致不同LiDAR配置下的跨传感器性能退化，需要一种不依赖传感器特性的通用方法。
AI.method: 提出InLiER无学习管线，包含：1) 从结构元素提取高度切片关键点并分配混合基数标记ID（编码高度、径向距离、局部形状和方位角），生成紧凑的<2KB表示；2) 三级检索：高度直方图交集的旋转不变预筛选、二进制位掩码对齐的偏航估计与重排序、标记引导的几何验证进行6自由度位姿估计。
AI.result: 在HeLiPR数据集上达到最先进性能，在现代手工方法中表现最佳，并在大多数跨传感器配置下超越基于学习的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: InLiER通过解耦传感器特性的标记化策略，有效解决了跨传感器LiDAR地点识别问题，且无需学习即可实现鲁棒的位姿估计。
AI.abstract_zh: LiDAR地点识别支持回环检测、重定位和多智能体地图管理。随着机器人平台越来越多地结合具有不同视场角、分辨率和扫描模式的LiDAR传感器，现有描述子因与传感器特定特征紧密耦合而性能退化。本文提出InLiER，一种基于中间标记化步骤的无学习管线。从结构元素中提取的高度切片关键点接收混合基数标记ID，编码来自局部3D几何的高度、径向距离、局部形状和方位角，形成紧凑的<2KB表示。同一词汇表在三个检索阶段重新组织：高度直方图交集实现快速旋转不变候选筛选、二进制位掩码对齐进行偏航估计与重排序、以及标记引导的几何验证实现6自由度位姿估计。InLiER在HeLiPR数据集和真实世界野外实验中，在现代手工方法中达到最先进性能，并在大多数跨传感器配置下超越基于学习的基线方法。

title: Scalable Causal Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning enables learning a policy in an unknown environment with a latent reward signal using expert demonstrations, but it struggles when the imitator's and expert's observations are mismatched and unobserved confounders are present in expert demonstrations. By identifying appropriate adjustment sets via the sequential $π$-backdoor criterion, causal imitation learning (CIL) provides a framework for approximating the expert's policy from confounded data. However, existing CIL methods, Causal Behavioral Cloning (Causal BC) and Causal Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning (Causal GAIL), are designed for short-horizon, low-dimensional settings. When applied to continuous control tasks with long horizons and high-dimensional state-action spaces, these methods exhibit poor performance: Causal BC suffers from compounding errors, Causal GAIL is unstable and sample-inefficient, and sequential $π$-backdoor adjustment becomes impractical. We introduce Causal Soft Q Imitation Learning (SQIL) and Causal Inverse soft-Q Learning (IQ-Learn), two off-policy causal imitation learning algorithms that combine the causal adjustment framework with state-of-the-art inverse reinforcement learning objectives. Both algorithms operate on causally-adjusted state representations produced by an efficient approximation of the sequential $π$-backdoor criterion, exploiting the causal structure of continuous control environments to reduce the full-horizon adjustment to a fixed-size sliding window. We evaluate all methods in a suite of confounded environments and find that Causal SQIL and Causal IQ-Learn substantially outperform prior CIL algorithms on long-horizon tasks, sometimes surpassing the expert, whereas all causally unaware imitation methods fail to learn meaningful behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种离策略因果模仿学习算法（Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn），通过结合因果调整框架与前沿逆强化学习目标，并利用滑窗近似高效实现序列π-后门准则，显著提升了在长视界、高维连续控制任务上的性能，超越了现有因果模仿学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果模仿学习方法（Causal BC和Causal GAIL）仅适用于短视界、低维场景，在长视界、高维连续控制任务中表现不佳：Causal BC存在复合误差累积，Causal GAIL训练不稳定且样本效率低，序列π-后门调整计算成本过高。
AI.method: 将序列π-后门准则近似为固定大小的滑窗，生成因果调整后的状态表示；在此基础上，将因果调整框架与离策略逆强化学习目标SQIL和IQ-Learn相结合，提出Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn两种离策略因果模仿学习算法。
AI.result: 在混杂环境套件中评估，Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn在长视界任务上显著优于先前的因果模仿学习算法，有时甚至超越专家；而所有不考虑因果关系的模仿学习方法均无法学习到有意义的行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过有效近似序列π-后门准则并引入离策略学习目标，因果模仿学习可成功扩展到长视界、高维连续控制任务，且优于忽视因果关系的模仿学习方法。
AI.abstract_zh: 模仿学习能够利用专家演示在具有隐式奖励信号的未知环境中学习策略，但当模仿者与专家的观测不匹配且专家演示中存在未观测混杂因素时，模仿学习效果不佳。通过识别序列π-后门准则下的适当调整集，因果模仿学习（CIL）提供了一种从混杂数据中近似专家策略的框架。然而，现有CIL方法——因果行为克隆（Causal BC）和因果生成对抗模仿学习（Causal GAIL）——是为短视界、低维场景设计的。当应用于具有长视界和高维状态-动作空间的连续控制任务时，这些方法表现不佳：Causal BC遭受复合误差累积，Causal GAIL训练不稳定且样本效率低下，序列π-后门调整变得不切实际。我们提出了因果软Q模仿学习（Causal SQIL）和因果逆软Q学习（Causal IQ-Learn），这是两种离策略因果模仿学习算法，将因果调整框架与前沿的逆强化学习目标相结合。两种算法均对由序列π-后门准则的高效近似生成的因果调整状态表示进行操作，利用连续控制环境的因果结构将全视界调整简化为固定大小的滑窗。我们在混杂环境套件中评估所有方法，发现Causal SQIL和Causal IQ-Learn在长视界任务上显著优于先前的CIL算法，有时甚至超越专家，而所有忽视因果关系的模仿方法均无法学习到有意义的行为。

title: InfoDense: Density-Aware Regional Decisive Replay for Memory-Efficient Incremental Face Forgery Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of face forgery techniques has introduced an increasing variety of manipulations. Incremental Face Forgery Detection (IFFD), which incrementally adds new forgery data to fine-tune previously trained models, has emerged as a promising approach to handle evolving forgery threats. However, conventional replay-based IFFD methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Storing full historical images under limited memory often either fails to preserve subtle forgery cues or introduces domain bias, reducing the model's ability to learn intrinsic and transferable manipulation characteristics. In this paper, we propose a Density-Aware Regional Decisive replay strategy, termed InfoDense, to address these challenges. InfoDense prioritizes artifact-dense and forgery-critical regions, significantly reducing storage requirements while maintaining high-fidelity forgery evidence. We first introduce InfoDense Cut to localize decisive patches using CLIP-based embeddings. Then, InfoDense Select ranks candidate segments by combining latent-space representativeness and decisive patch counts, ensuring both diversity and information density in the replay buffer. Finally, InfoDense Fuse reconstructs unbiased training inputs by adaptively merging stored segments with current-task samples, enhancing knowledge retention and generalization. Extensive experiments on challenging incremental deepfake benchmarks demonstrate that InfoDense effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting while improving cross-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为InfoDense的密度感知区域决定性回放策略，用于渐进式人脸伪造检测，以解决传统回放方法因存储有限导致的灾难性遗忘和领域偏差问题。InfoDense通过定位伪造密集区域、选择高信息密度片段并自适应重构训练输入，在减少存储需求的同时保持了高保真的伪造证据。
AI.motivation: 现有渐进式人脸伪造检测（IFFD）方法在有限内存下存储完整历史图像时，要么难以保留细微伪造线索，要么引入领域偏差，导致模型难以学习内在且可迁移的操作特征，遭受灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: 提出InfoDense框架，包含三个模块：1）InfoDense Cut：利用CLIP嵌入定位关键伪造密集区域；2）InfoDense Select：结合潜在空间代表性和关键区域数量对候选片段进行排序，确保回放缓冲区的多样性和信息密度；3）InfoDense Fuse：通过自适应融合存储片段与当前任务样本来重构无偏训练输入，增强知识保留与泛化能力。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的渐进式深度伪造基准测试上的大量实验表明，InfoDense有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，同时提升了跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: InfoDense通过密度感知的区域决定性回放策略，在降低存储开销的同时保留了高保真伪造证据，显著改善了增量学习场景下的人脸伪造检测性能。
AI.abstract_zh: 人脸伪造技术的快速演进引入了日益多样化的操作手段。增量式人脸伪造检测（IFFD）通过逐步添加新的伪造数据来微调先前训练的模型，已成为应对不断演变的伪造威胁的一种有前景的方法。然而，传统的基于回放的IFFD方法存在灾难性遗忘问题。在有限内存下存储完整历史图像时，要么难以保留细微的伪造线索，要么引入领域偏差，从而削弱了模型学习内在且可迁移的操作特征的能力。本文提出了一种密度感知的区域决定性回放策略，称为InfoDense，以应对这些挑战。InfoDense优先选择伪造成密集且对检测关键的区域，在显著降低存储需求的同时保持了高保真的伪造证据。我们首先引入InfoDense Cut，利用基于CLIP的嵌入定位决定性关键区域。然后，InfoDense Select通过结合潜在空间代表性和关键区域数量对候选片段进行排序，确保回放缓冲区的多样性和信息密度。最后，InfoDense Fuse通过自适应融合存储片段与当前任务样本来重构无偏训练输入，增强知识保留与泛化能力。在具有挑战性的渐进式深度伪造基准测试上进行的大量实验表明，InfoDense有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，同时提升了跨领域泛化能力。

title: Regularize or Localize: When Training-Time KV-Cache Geometry Pays Under Quantization
summary: We study whether \sigreg -- LeJEPA's anti-collapse objective -- can reshape representations during standard autoregressive language-model pretraining, and when the resulting geometry helps \kv-cache quantization.
